154	func unlockedCheck(unlocked Fact) AuditCheck {
155		if !unlocked.Known {
156			return check(CheckWorktreeUnlocked, AuditUnknown, "worktree lock state was not inspected")
157		}
158		if !unlocked.Value {
159			return check(CheckWorktreeUnlocked, AuditBlocked, "worktree is locked")
160		}
161		return check(CheckWorktreeUnlocked, AuditEligible, "worktree is not locked")
162	}
163	
164	func branchNamedCheck(named Fact) AuditCheck {
165		if !named.Known {
166			return check(CheckBranchNamed, AuditUnknown, "worktree branch identity was not inspected")
167		}
168		if !named.Value {
169			return check(CheckBranchNamed, AuditBlocked, "linked worktree is detached or unnamed")
170		}
171		return check(CheckBranchNamed, AuditEligible, "worktree has a named branch")
172	}
173	
174	func identityCheck(matches Fact) AuditCheck {
175		if !matches.Known {
176			return check(CheckTaskIdentity, AuditUnknown, "task/worktree identity was not inspected")
177		}
178		if !matches.Value {
179			return check(CheckTaskIdentity, AuditBlocked, "task branch does not match the live worktree branch")
180		}
181		return check(CheckTaskIdentity, AuditEligible, "task and worktree identity agree")
182	}
183	
184	func pathCheck(exists Fact) AuditCheck {
185		if !exists.Known {
186			return check(CheckPathExists, AuditUnknown, "checkout path existence was not inspected")
187		}
188		if exists.Value {
189			return check(CheckPathExists, AuditEligible, "checkout path exists")
190		}
191		return check(CheckPathExists, AuditEligible, "checkout path is already absent")
192	}
193	
194	func statusCheck(input AuditInput) AuditCheck {
195		if !input.PathExists.Known {
196			return check(CheckStatusAvailable, AuditUnknown, "checkout path existence is unknown")
197		}
198		if !input.PathExists.Value {
199			return check(CheckStatusAvailable, AuditNotApplicable, "checkout path is absent")
200		}
201		if input.StatusError != "" {
202			return check(CheckStatusAvailable, AuditUnknown, "checkout status inspection failed: "+input.StatusError)
203		}
204		if !input.Dirty.Known {
205			return check(CheckStatusAvailable, AuditUnknown, "checkout status was not inspected")
206		}
207		return check(CheckStatusAvailable, AuditEligible, "checkout status is available")
208	}

211		if input.PathExists.Known && !input.PathExists.Value {
212			return check(CheckClean, AuditNotApplicable, "checkout path is absent")
213		}
214		if input.StatusError != "" || !input.Dirty.Known {
215			return check(CheckClean, AuditUnknown, "checkout cleanliness is unknown")
216		}
217		if input.Dirty.Value {
218			return check(CheckClean, AuditBlocked, "checkout has uncommitted changes")
219		}
220		return check(CheckClean, AuditEligible, "checkout is clean")
221	}

225			return check(CheckGitOperation, AuditNotApplicable, "checkout path is absent")
226		}
227		if !input.InProgress.Known {
228			return check(CheckGitOperation, AuditUnknown, "in-progress Git operations were not inspected")
229		}
230		if input.InProgress.Value {
231			return check(CheckGitOperation, AuditBlocked, "a Git operation is in progress")
232		}
233		return check(CheckGitOperation, AuditEligible, "no Git operation is in progress")
234	}

236	func baseCheck(known bool) AuditCheck {
237		if !known {
238			return check(CheckBaseKnown, AuditUnknown, "base branch is unknown")
239		}
240		return check(CheckBaseKnown, AuditEligible, "base branch is known")
241	}
242	
243	func containmentCheck(input AuditInput) AuditCheck {
244		if !input.BaseKnown {
245			return check(CheckBranchContained, AuditUnknown, "branch containment cannot be checked without a known base")
246		}
247		if !input.Contained.Known {
248			return check(CheckBranchContained, AuditUnknown, "branch containment was not inspected")
249		}
250		if !input.Contained.Value {
251			return check(CheckBranchContained, AuditBlocked, "branch is not contained in its base")
252		}
253		return check(CheckBranchContained, AuditEligible, "branch is contained in its base")
254	}
255	
256	func taskCheck(input AuditInput) AuditCheck {
257		present := input.TaskPresent
258		if !present.Known && input.TaskState != "" {
259			present = KnownFact(true)
260		}
261		if !present.Known {
262			return check(CheckTaskState, AuditUnknown, "task presence was not inspected")
263		}
264		state := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskState))
265		if !present.Value {
266			if state != "" {
267				return check(CheckTaskState, AuditUnknown, "task presence conflicts with the supplied task state")
268			}
269			return check(CheckTaskState, AuditEligible, "checkout has no persisted task")
270		}
271		switch state {
272		case "done":
273			return check(CheckTaskState, AuditEligible, "persisted task is done")
274		case "":
275			return check(CheckTaskState, AuditUnknown, "persisted task state is unknown")
276		default:
277			return check(CheckTaskState, AuditBlocked, "persisted task is not done")
278		}
279	}
280	
281	func artifactKnownCheck(known bool) AuditCheck {
282		if !known {
283			return check(CheckArtifactKnown, AuditUnknown, "artifact reachability was not inspected")
284		}
285		return check(CheckArtifactKnown, AuditEligible, "artifact reachability is known")
286	}
287	
288	func artifactFinalizedCheck(input AuditInput) AuditCheck {
289		if !input.ArtifactKnown {
290			return check(CheckArtifactFinalized, AuditUnknown, "artifact finalization is unknown")
291		}
292		if !input.Finalized {
293			return check(CheckArtifactFinalized, AuditBlocked, "artifacts are not finalized and reachable")
294		}
295		return check(CheckArtifactFinalized, AuditEligible, "artifacts are finalized and reachable")
296	}
297	
298	func runtimeKnownCheck(known bool) AuditCheck {
299		if !known {
300			return check(CheckRuntimeKnown, AuditUnknown, "runtime coverage was not inspected")
301		}
302		return check(CheckRuntimeKnown, AuditEligible, "runtime coverage is known")
303	}
304	
305	func runtimeReadyCheck(input AuditInput) AuditCheck {
306		if !input.RuntimeKnown {
307			return check(CheckRuntimeReady, AuditUnknown, "runtime close eligibility is unknown")
308		}
309		if !input.RuntimeReady {
310			return check(CheckRuntimeReady, AuditBlocked, "runtime closure is blocked")
311		}
312		return check(CheckRuntimeReady, AuditEligible, "runtime is structurally ready for closure")
313	}
314	
315	func notApplicableAudit(detail string) AuditResult {
316		ids := []string{
317			CheckTargetKind,
318			CheckRegistered,
319			CheckWorktreeUnlocked,
320			CheckBranchNamed,
321			CheckTaskIdentity,
322			CheckPathExists,
323			CheckStatusAvailable,
324			CheckClean,
325			CheckGitOperation,
326			CheckBaseKnown,
327			CheckBranchContained,
328			CheckTaskState,
329			CheckArtifactKnown,
330			CheckArtifactFinalized,
331			CheckRuntimeKnown,
332			CheckRuntimeReady,
333		}
334		checks := make([]AuditCheck, 0, len(ids))
335		for _, id := range ids {
336			checks = append(checks, check(id, AuditNotApplicable, detail))
337		}
338		return AuditResult{Status: AuditNotApplicable, Checks: checks}
339	}
340	
341	func aggregateAuditStatus(checks []AuditCheck) AuditStatus {
342		status := AuditEligible
343		for _, c := range checks {
344			switch c.Status {
345			case AuditBlocked:
346				return AuditBlocked
347			case AuditUnknown:
348				status = AuditUnknown
349			}
350		}
351		return status
352	}
353	
354	func check(id string, status AuditStatus, detail string) AuditCheck {
355		return AuditCheck{ID: id, Status: status, Detail: detail}
356	}

1	package retire
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"os"
8	
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
10		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
11		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
13	)
14	
15	// Target is the live Git/task identity retirement must revalidate before every
16	// destructive stage.
17	type Target struct {
18		TaskID         string
19		RepoPath       string
20		CheckoutPath   string
21		Branch         string
22		Base           string
23		LinkedWorktree bool
24	}
25	
26	// Request is one externally coordinated retirement attempt.
27	type Request struct {
28		Target       Target
29		Safety       Options
30		DeleteBranch bool
31	}
32	
33	// Result records which terminal resources were removed.
34	type Result struct {
35		ClosedSessions  int
36		RemovedWorktree bool
37		DeletedBranch   bool
38		DeletedTask     bool
39	}
40	
41	// Service owns cleanup policy; every caller must use a freshly selected runtime.
42	type Service struct {
43		Runtime runtime.Runtime
44		Tasks   *task.Store
45	}
46	
47	// Retire closes live runtime surfaces, waits for them to release the checkout,
48	// then removes only a validated linked worktree and finally its task record.
49	func (s *Service) Retire(ctx context.Context, req Request) (Result, error) {
50		target, err := s.validateTarget(ctx, req.Target)
51		if err != nil {
52			return Result{}, err
53		}
54		inspection, err := CloseAndWait(ctx, s.Runtime, target.CheckoutPath, req.Safety)
55		if err != nil {
56			return Result{}, err
57		}
58		result := Result{ClosedSessions: inspection.ClosedSessions}
59	
60		// Reality may change while a runtime is draining. Never carry the earlier
61		// worktree/dirty/ancestry proof across that boundary.
62		target, err = s.validateTarget(ctx, target)
63		if err != nil {
64			return result, fmt.Errorf("revalidate after runtime close: %w", err)
65		}
66		finalInspection, err := Inspect(ctx, s.Runtime, target.CheckoutPath, req.Safety)
67		if err != nil {
68			return result, fmt.Errorf("reinspect after runtime close: %w", err)
69		}
70		if !finalInspection.Ready() || len(finalInspection.Sessions) > 0 {
71			return result, fmt.Errorf("runtime reclaimed the checkout after closure; refusing worktree removal")
72		}
73		if target.LinkedWorktree {
74			if err := gitx.RemoveWorktree(ctx, target.RepoPath, target.CheckoutPath, false); err != nil {
75				return result, err
76			}
77			result.RemovedWorktree = true
78		}
79		if req.DeleteBranch && target.Branch != "" && target.Branch != target.Base && gitx.BranchExists(ctx, target.RepoPath, target.Branch) {
80			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, target.RepoPath, "branch", "-d", target.Branch); err != nil {
81				return result, fmt.Errorf("delete merged branch %s: %w", target.Branch, err)
82			}
83			result.DeletedBranch = true
84		}
85		if target.TaskID != "" && s.Tasks != nil {
86			if err := s.validateTaskIdentity(target); err != nil {
87				return result, fmt.Errorf("revalidate task before deletion: %w", err)
88			}
89			if err := s.Tasks.Delete(target.TaskID); err != nil {
90				return result, fmt.Errorf("delete retired task %s: %w", target.TaskID, err)
91			}
92			result.DeletedTask = true
93		}
94		return result, nil
95	}
96	
97	func (s *Service) validateTarget(ctx context.Context, target Target) (Target, error) {
98		if target.RepoPath == "" || target.CheckoutPath == "" {
99			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("retirement target needs repository and checkout paths")
100		}
101		var err error
102		target.RepoPath, err = pathx.Canonical(target.RepoPath)
103		if err != nil {
104			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize repository: %w", err)
105		}
106		target.CheckoutPath, err = pathx.Canonical(target.CheckoutPath)
107		if err != nil {
108			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize checkout: %w", err)
109		}
110		if target.Base == "" {
111			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("cannot prove integration without a base branch")
112		}
113		if err := s.validateTaskIdentity(target); err != nil {
114			return Target{}, err
115		}
116		if _, statErr := os.Stat(target.CheckoutPath); statErr == nil {
117			if operation, active, operationErr := gitx.InProgress(target.CheckoutPath); operationErr != nil {
118				return Target{}, operationErr
119			} else if active {
120				return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("refusing retirement while Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
121			}
122		} else if !errors.Is(statErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
123			return Target{}, statErr
124		}
125		if target.LinkedWorktree && target.Branch == "" {
126			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("refusing to retire a detached linked worktree")
127		}
128		if target.Branch != "" && target.Branch != target.Base {
129			if !gitx.BranchExists(ctx, target.RepoPath, target.Branch) {
130				if target.TaskID == "" {
131					return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("branch %s no longer exists; only a persisted done task may reconcile it", target.Branch)
132				}
133			} else if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, target.RepoPath, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", target.Branch, target.Base); err != nil {
134				return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("branch %s is not contained in %s", target.Branch, target.Base)
135			}
136		}
137	
138		if !target.LinkedWorktree {
139			return target, nil
140		}
141		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, target.RepoPath)
142		if err != nil {
143			return Target{}, err
144		}
145		registered := false
146		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
147			path, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
148			if canonicalErr != nil || path != target.CheckoutPath {
149				continue
150			}
151			registered = true
152			if worktree.Main {
153				return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("refusing to retire main checkout %s", target.CheckoutPath)
154			}
155			if worktree.Branch != target.Branch {
156				return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("worktree %s is on %s, expected %s", target.CheckoutPath, worktree.Branch, target.Branch)
157			}
158			break
159		}
160		if !registered {
161			if _, statErr := os.Stat(target.CheckoutPath); errors.Is(statErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
162				if err := gitx.PruneWorktrees(ctx, target.RepoPath); err != nil {
163					return Target{}, err
164				}
165				target.LinkedWorktree = false
166				return target, nil
167			}
168			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("path %s exists but Git no longer registers it; preserve orphaned artifacts before cleanup", target.CheckoutPath)
169		}
170		dirty, status, err := wtDirty(ctx, target.CheckoutPath)
171		if err != nil {
172			return Target{}, err
173		}
174		if dirty {
175			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("worktree %s is not clean: %s", target.CheckoutPath, status.Breakdown())
176		}
177		return target, nil
178	}
179	
180	func (s *Service) validateTaskIdentity(target Target) error {
181		if target.TaskID == "" {
182			return nil
183		}
184		if s.Tasks == nil {
185			return fmt.Errorf("retirement target %s needs its task store for identity revalidation", target.TaskID)
186		}
187		current, err := s.Tasks.Get(target.TaskID)
188		if err != nil {
189			return fmt.Errorf("reload retirement task %s: %w", target.TaskID, err)
190		}
191		if current.State != task.Done {
192			return fmt.Errorf("task %s changed state to %s during retirement", target.TaskID, current.State)
193		}
194		repoPath, err := pathx.Canonical(current.RepoPath)
195		if err != nil {
196			return err
197		}
198		checkoutPath := current.RepoPath
199		if current.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && current.WorktreePath != "" {
200			checkoutPath = current.WorktreePath
201		}
202		checkoutPath, err = pathx.Canonical(checkoutPath)
203		if err != nil {
204			return err
205		}
206		if repoPath != target.RepoPath || checkoutPath != target.CheckoutPath || current.Branch != target.Branch {
207			return fmt.Errorf("task %s checkout identity changed during retirement", target.TaskID)
208		}
209		if current.Base != "" && current.Base != target.Base {
210			return fmt.Errorf("task %s base changed from %s to %s during retirement", target.TaskID, target.Base, current.Base)
211		}
212		return nil
213	}
214	
215	func wtDirty(ctx context.Context, path string) (bool, gitx.Status, error) {
216		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, path)
217		if err != nil {
218			return false, status, err
219		}
220		return status.Dirty(), status, nil
221	}

1	// Package retire coordinates destructive cleanup from outside the runtime and
2	// worktree being retired.
3	package retire
4	
5	import (
6		"context"
7		"fmt"
8		"os"
9		"sort"
10		"strings"
11		"time"
12	
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
15	)
16	
17	// AgentCloseClass is the runtime-closure meaning of one observed agent state.
18	type AgentCloseClass string
19	
20	const (
21		AgentCloseEligible AgentCloseClass = "eligible"
22		AgentCloseBlocked  AgentCloseClass = "blocked"
23		AgentCloseUnknown  AgentCloseClass = "unknown"
24	)
25	
26	// ClassifyAgentStatus is the shared interpretation used by enforcement and
27	// read-only closeout reports. A settled turn is eligible for runtime closure
28	// only; it says nothing about task or Git completion.
29	func ClassifyAgentStatus(status string) AgentCloseClass {
30		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status)) {
31		case "idle", "done":
32			return AgentCloseEligible
33		case "working", "running", "busy", "blocked", "waiting":
34			return AgentCloseBlocked
35		default:
36			return AgentCloseUnknown
37		}
38	}
39	
40	// Options controls only fail-closed observations. Caller protection and active
41	// agent states are never bypassable.
42	type Options struct {
43		CWD               string
44		CallerWorkspaceID string
45		CallerPaneID      string
46		CloseUnknown      bool
47		AssumeNoRuntime   bool
48		PollInterval      time.Duration
49		Timeout           time.Duration
50	}
51	
52	// Session is one runtime session that currently covers the target checkout.
53	type Session struct {
54		Runtime runtime.Session
55		Panes   []runtime.Pane
56		Mixed   []runtime.Pane
57	}
58	
59	// Inspection is a fresh view of every runtime surface covering a checkout.
60	type Inspection struct {
61		Target          string
62		Sessions        []Session
63		ClosedSessions  int
64		Blockers        []string
65		RuntimeUnknown  bool
66		CallerContained bool
67	}
68	
69	// Ready reports whether destructive cleanup may proceed.
70	func (i Inspection) Ready() bool { return len(i.Blockers) == 0 }
71	
72	// Inspect discovers covering sessions and applies caller, mixed-workspace, and
73	// agent-state safety policy.
74	func Inspect(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
75		result, opts, err := prepareInspection(target, opts)
76		if err != nil {
77			return Inspection{}, err
78		}
79		if rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
80			return dedupe(result), nil
81		}
82		sessions, err := rt.List(ctx)
83		if err != nil {
84			if !opts.AssumeNoRuntime {
85				return Inspection{}, fmt.Errorf("list %s runtime sessions: %w", rt.Name(), err)
86			}
87			result.RuntimeUnknown = true
88			return dedupe(result), nil
89		}
90		return inspectSessions(result, sessions, opts)
91	}
92	
93	// InspectSessions applies the exact same safety policy to a caller-supplied
94	// runtime snapshot. Read-only reports use this to classify many checkouts after
95	// one runtime enumeration; destructive callers continue to use Inspect so they
96	// always collect fresh state.
97	func InspectSessions(target string, sessions []runtime.Session, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
98		result, opts, err := prepareInspection(target, opts)
99		if err != nil {
100			return Inspection{}, err
101		}
102		return inspectSessions(result, sessions, opts)
103	}
104	
105	func prepareInspection(target string, opts Options) (Inspection, Options, error) {
106		canonicalTarget, err := pathx.Canonical(target)
107		if err != nil {
108			return Inspection{}, opts, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize retirement target: %w", err)
109		}
110		result := Inspection{Target: canonicalTarget}
111		cwd := opts.CWD
112		if cwd == "" {
113			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
114			if err != nil {
115				return Inspection{}, opts, fmt.Errorf("resolve caller directory: %w", err)
116			}
117		}
118		if inside, compareErr := pathx.Contains(canonicalTarget, cwd); compareErr != nil {
119			return Inspection{}, opts, fmt.Errorf("compare caller directory: %w", compareErr)
120		} else if inside {
121			result.CallerContained = true
122			result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
123				fmt.Sprintf("caller is inside target checkout %s", canonicalTarget))
124		}
125		if opts.CallerWorkspaceID == "" {
126			opts.CallerWorkspaceID = os.Getenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID")
127		}
128		if opts.CallerPaneID == "" {
129			opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")
130			if opts.CallerPaneID == "" {
131				opts.CallerPaneID = os.Getenv("TMUX_PANE")
132			}
133		}
134		return result, opts, nil
135	}
136	
137	func inspectSessions(result Inspection, sessions []runtime.Session, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
138		for _, observed := range sessions {
139			covering, mixed, err := classifySession(result.Target, observed)
140			if err != nil {
141				return Inspection{}, err
142			}
143			if len(covering) == 0 {
144				continue
145			}
146			result.Sessions = append(result.Sessions, Session{Runtime: observed, Panes: covering, Mixed: mixed})
147			if observed.Handle == opts.CallerWorkspaceID || panePresent(observed.Panes, opts.CallerPaneID) {
148				result.CallerContained = true
149				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
150					fmt.Sprintf("caller runtime %s contains the target checkout", observed.Handle))
151			}
152			if len(mixed) > 0 {
153				result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
154					fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s also contains %d pane(s) outside the target", observed.Handle, len(mixed)))
155			}
156			statuses := coveringAgentStatuses(covering, observed.AgentStatus)
157			for _, status := range statuses {
158				switch ClassifyAgentStatus(status) {
159				case AgentCloseEligible:
160					// Eligible after all structural checks pass.
161				case AgentCloseBlocked:
162					result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
163						fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has agent status %s", observed.Handle, status))
164				case AgentCloseUnknown:
165					if status == "" || status == "unknown" {
166						if !opts.CloseUnknown {
167							result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
168								fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unknown agent status; pass --close-unknown from outside it", observed.Handle))
169						}
170					} else {
171						result.Blockers = append(result.Blockers,
172							fmt.Sprintf("runtime %s has unrecognized agent status %s", observed.Handle, status))
173					}
174				}
175			}
176		}
177		return dedupe(result), nil
178	}
179	
180	// CloseAndWait closes every eligible covering session and proves that no
181	// runtime surface still covers target before returning.
182	func CloseAndWait(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, target string, opts Options) (Inspection, error) {
183		inspection, err := Inspect(ctx, rt, target, opts)
184		if err != nil {
185			return inspection, err
186		}
187		if !inspection.Ready() {
188			return inspection, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked: %s", strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; "))
189		}
190		if inspection.RuntimeUnknown || rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" {
191			return inspection, nil
192		}
193		interval := opts.PollInterval
194		if interval <= 0 {
195			interval = 100 * time.Millisecond
196		}
197		timeout := opts.Timeout
198		if timeout <= 0 {
199			timeout = 5 * time.Second
200		}
201		deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
202		closed := make(map[string]bool)
203		for {
204			fresh, inspectErr := Inspect(ctx, rt, inspection.Target, opts)
205			if inspectErr != nil {
206				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("reinspect before %s runtime close: %w", rt.Name(), inspectErr)
207			}
208			if !fresh.Ready() {
209				return fresh, fmt.Errorf("retirement blocked after runtime state changed: %s", strings.Join(fresh.Blockers, "; "))
210			}
211			if len(fresh.Sessions) == 0 {
212				inspection.Sessions = nil
213				inspection.ClosedSessions = len(closed)
214				return inspection, nil
215			}
216			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
217				return inspection, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for %d %s session(s) to release %s",
218					len(fresh.Sessions), rt.Name(), inspection.Target)
219			}
220			for _, session := range fresh.Sessions {
221				handle := session.Runtime.Handle
222				if closed[handle] {
223					continue
224				}
225				if err := rt.Close(ctx, handle); err != nil {
226					return inspection, fmt.Errorf("close %s runtime %s: %w", rt.Name(), handle, err)
227				}
228				closed[handle] = true
229				break // re-list before authorizing the next destructive close.
230			}
231			select {
232			case <-ctx.Done():
233				return inspection, ctx.Err()
234			case <-time.After(interval):
235			}
236		}
237	}
238	
239	func classifySession(target string, session runtime.Session) ([]runtime.Pane, []runtime.Pane, error) {
240		panes := session.Panes
241		if len(panes) == 0 {
242			for i, dir := range session.Dirs {
243				panes = append(panes, runtime.Pane{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.Handle, i), CWD: dir})
244			}
245		}
246		var covering, mixed []runtime.Pane
247		for _, pane := range panes {
248			paths := []string{pane.CWD}
249			if pane.ShellCWD != "" && pane.ShellCWD != pane.CWD {
250				paths = append(paths, pane.ShellCWD)
251			}
252			paneCovers, paneOutside, observed := false, false, false
253			for _, path := range paths {
254				if path == "" {
255					continue
256				}
257				observed = true
258				inside, err := pathx.Contains(target, path)
259				if err != nil {
260					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare runtime pane %s path: %w", pane.ID, err)
261				}
262				if inside {
263					paneCovers = true
264				} else {
265					paneOutside = true
266				}
267			}
268			if paneCovers {
269				covering = append(covering, pane)
270			}
271			if paneOutside || !observed {
272				mixed = append(mixed, pane)
273			}
274		}
275		return covering, mixed, nil
276	}
277	
278	func coveringAgentStatuses(panes []runtime.Pane, fallback string) []string {
279		set := make(map[string]bool)
280		for _, pane := range panes {
281			if pane.Agent != "" || pane.AgentSession != "" || pane.AgentStatus != "" {
282				set[strings.ToLower(pane.AgentStatus)] = true
283			}
284		}
285		if len(set) == 0 {
286			set[strings.ToLower(fallback)] = true
287		}
288		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
289		for status := range set {
290			out = append(out, status)
291		}
292		sort.Strings(out)
293		return out
294	}
295	
296	func panePresent(panes []runtime.Pane, id string) bool {
297		if id == "" {
298			return false
299		}
300		for _, pane := range panes {
301			if pane.ID == id {
302				return true
303			}
304		}
305		return false
306	}
307	
308	func dedupe(inspection Inspection) Inspection {
309		seen := make(map[string]bool)
310		out := inspection.Blockers[:0]
311		for _, blocker := range inspection.Blockers {
312			if !seen[blocker] {
313				seen[blocker] = true
314				out = append(out, blocker)
315			}
316		}
317		inspection.Blockers = out
318		return inspection
319	}

24	func (m *mutatingRuntime) Open(context.Context, string, string) (runtime.OpenResult, error) {
25		return runtime.OpenResult{}, nil
26	}

30		}
31		m.closed = true
32		return nil
33	}

36			return nil, nil
37		}

39	}

42	func TestRetireRevalidatesTaskIdentityAfterRuntimeClose(t *testing.T) {
43		t.Setenv("GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL", os.DevNull)
44		t.Setenv("GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM", os.DevNull)
45		r := gittest.New(t)
46		worktree := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(r.Root), "feature")
47		r.Git("worktree", "add", "-b", "feat/retire", worktree)
48		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(worktree, "feature.txt"), []byte("feature\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
49			t.Fatal(err)
50		}
51		r.GitIn(worktree, "add", "feature.txt")
52		r.GitIn(worktree, "commit", "-m", "feat: retire")
53		r.Git("merge", "--ff-only", "feat/retire")
54	
55		store := task.NewStore(t.TempDir())
56		record := &task.Task{
57			ID: "repo__feat-retire", Name: "retire", Repo: "repo", RepoPath: r.Root,
58			Branch: "feat/retire", Base: "main", WorktreePath: worktree,
59			Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Done,
60		}
61		if err := store.Save(record); err != nil {
62			t.Fatal(err)
63		}

65			session: runtime.Session{Handle: "w1", Panes: []runtime.Pane{{ID: "p1", CWD: worktree, Agent: "codex", AgentStatus: "idle"}}},
66			close: func() error {
67				current, err := store.Get(record.ID)
68				if err != nil {
69					return err
70				}
71				current.State = task.Warm

75		service := &retire.Service{Runtime: rt, Tasks: store}

1	// Package gittest builds throwaway git repositories for tests. It is a test
2	// helper that lives in a normal package so every package's tests can share it.
3	package gittest
4	
5	import (
6		"context"
7		"os"
8		"os/exec"
9		"path/filepath"
10		"strings"
11		"testing"
12	)
13	
14	// Repo is a scratch repository under t.TempDir().
15	type Repo struct {
16		T    *testing.T
17		Root string
18	}
19	
20	// New initialises a repository with one commit on branch "main".
21	func New(t *testing.T) *Repo {
22		t.Helper()
23		// Windows hands back an 8.3 short path (C:\Users\RUNNER~1\...) that git then
24		// reports in its long form, so canonicalize once up front.
25		tempDir := t.TempDir()
26		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(tempDir); err == nil {
27			tempDir = resolved
28		}
29		root := filepath.Join(tempDir, "repo")
30		if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0o755); err != nil {
31			t.Fatal(err)
32		}
33		r := &Repo{T: t, Root: root}
34		r.Git("init", "--initial-branch=main")
35		// Identity and signing are configured locally so the test never depends on
36		// (or is broken by) the developer's global git config.
37		r.Git("config", "user.email", "dev@example.test")
38		r.Git("config", "user.name", "dev test")
39		r.Git("config", "commit.gpgsign", "false")
40		// Keep line endings and symlinks byte-for-byte on every platform; the
41		// Windows CI runner defaults core.autocrlf to true.
42		r.Git("config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
43		r.Git("config", "core.symlinks", "true")
44		r.Write("README.md", "# test repo\n")
45		r.Git("add", "README.md")
46		r.Git("commit", "-m", "chore: initial commit")
47		return r
48	}
49	
50	// Git runs a git command in the repo root and fails the test on error.
51	func (r *Repo) Git(args ...string) string {
52		r.T.Helper()
53		return r.GitIn(r.Root, args...)
54	}
55	
56	// GitIn runs a git command in an arbitrary directory (e.g. a linked worktree).
57	func (r *Repo) GitIn(dir string, args ...string) string {
58		r.T.Helper()
59		cmd := exec.Command("git", args...)
60		cmd.Dir = dir
61		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(),
62			"GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL="+os.DevNull, // ignore the developer's ~/.gitconfig
63			"GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM="+os.DevNull,
64			"GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
65			"GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
66		)
67		out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
68		if err != nil {
69			r.T.Fatalf("git %s in %s: %v\n%s", strings.Join(args, " "), dir, err, out)
70		}
71		return strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
72	}
73	
74	// Write creates or replaces a file relative to the repo root.
75	func (r *Repo) Write(rel, content string) string {
76		r.T.Helper()
77		p := filepath.Join(r.Root, rel)
78		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {
79			r.T.Fatal(err)
80		}
81		if err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {
82			r.T.Fatal(err)
83		}
84		return p
85	}
86	
87	// Commit writes a file and commits it.
88	func (r *Repo) Commit(rel, content, message string) {
89		r.T.Helper()
90		r.Write(rel, content)
91		r.Git("add", rel)
92		r.Git("commit", "-m", message)
93	}
94	
95	// Branch creates and checks out a new branch from the current HEAD.
96	func (r *Repo) Branch(name string) {
97		r.T.Helper()
98		r.Git("switch", "-c", name)
99	}
100	
101	// WithRemote turns a second bare repository into "origin" and pushes main,
102	// so tests can exercise ahead/behind and published-branch logic.
103	func (r *Repo) WithRemote() string {
104		r.T.Helper()
105		remote := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(r.Root), "origin.git")
106		r.GitIn(filepath.Dir(r.Root), "init", "--bare", "--initial-branch=main", remote)
107		r.Git("remote", "add", "origin", remote)
108		r.Git("push", "-u", "origin", "main")
109		return remote
110	}
111	
112	// Ctx is a convenience background context for gitx calls in tests.
113	func Ctx() context.Context { return context.Background() }

// Package ephemeral audits and removes provider-verified, turn-scoped Git
// worktrees. Provider metadata is evidence, never authority by itself: mutation
// is allowed only after every independent Git, task, artifact, caller, and
// runtime proof is freshly re-collected under a repository-scoped lock.
package ephemeral

import (
	"context"
	"time"
)

const SchemaVersion = 1

type Classification string

const (
	Eligible      Classification = "eligible"
	Blocked       Classification = "blocked"
	Unknown       Classification = "unknown"
	NotApplicable Classification = "not-applicable"
)

// Fact is a three-state boolean. The zero value is unknown so omitted evidence
// can never accidentally authorize cleanup.
type Fact struct {
	Known bool `json:"known"`
	Value bool `json:"value"`
}

func KnownFact(value bool) Fact { return Fact{Known: true, Value: value} }

// RepositoryIdentity is the canonical repository scope of a report.
type RepositoryIdentity struct {
	Root      string `json:"root"`
	CommonDir string `json:"common_dir"`
	Name      string `json:"name"`
	Bare      bool   `json:"bare"`
}

// Target is one candidate checkout. Hint is discovery-only and is never used
// as proof that a provider owns the path.
type Target struct {
	Path           string `json:"path"`
	Branch         string `json:"branch,omitempty"`
	RegistryHead   string `json:"registry_head,omitempty"`
	Main           bool   `json:"main"`
	Bare           bool   `json:"bare"`
	Detached       bool   `json:"detached"`
	Locked         bool   `json:"locked"`
	LockedReason   string `json:"locked_reason,omitempty"`
	Prunable       bool   `json:"prunable"`
	PrunableReason string `json:"prunable_reason,omitempty"`
	Registered     bool   `json:"registered"`
	Hint           bool   `json:"hint"`
}

// SourceQuery limits provider inspection to one repository and its current Git
// candidates. Now is supplied so future timestamps can be rejected
// deterministically.
type SourceQuery struct {
	Repository RepositoryIdentity
	Targets    []Target
	Now        time.Time
}

// Claim is the normalized, privacy-preserving evidence for one provider-owned
// checkout. It contains identifiers, states, and timestamps only; providers
// must never place prompts, scripts, logs, transcript content, or result bodies
// here.
type Claim struct {
	Provider          string    `json:"provider"`
	SessionID         string    `json:"session_id"`
	RunID             string    `json:"run_id"`
	AgentID           string    `json:"agent_id"`
	WorktreePath      string    `json:"worktree_path"`
	Owned             Fact      `json:"owned"`
	Unique            Fact      `json:"unique"`
	Mapping           Fact      `json:"mapping"`
	WorkflowState     string    `json:"workflow_state"`
	WorkflowTerminal  Fact      `json:"workflow_terminal"`
	AgentState        string    `json:"agent_state"`
	AgentDone         Fact      `json:"agent_done"`
	JournalStarted    Fact      `json:"journal_started"`
	JournalResult     Fact      `json:"journal_result"`
	NotResumed        Fact      `json:"not_resumed"`
	LastActivity      time.Time `json:"last_activity,omitempty"`
	LastActivityKnown bool      `json:"last_activity_known"`
}

// Capability and Diagnostic are stable, bounded report metadata. Diagnostics
// identify a class of failure without echoing private provider content.
type Capability struct {
	Name      string `json:"name"`
	Available bool   `json:"available"`
	Detail    string `json:"detail,omitempty"`
}

type Diagnostic struct {
	Source  string `json:"source"`
	Code    string `json:"code"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
}

// SourceResult is a complete provider scan. Complete=false means absence of a
// claim is unknown rather than proof that a candidate is not provider-owned.
type SourceResult struct {
	Provider    string
	Complete    bool
	Claims      []Claim
	Capabilities []Capability
	Diagnostics []Diagnostic
}

// OwnershipSource adapts one provider's bounded metadata into normalized
// claims. Implementations are report-only and must not mutate provider state.
type OwnershipSource interface {
	Collect(context.Context, SourceQuery) SourceResult
}

// GitFacts records every checkout observation used by the audit and stable
// fingerprint. Counts are included instead of paths so reports cannot leak
// filenames from a checkout.
type GitFacts struct {
	Registered       Fact   `json:"registered"`
	PathPresent      Fact   `json:"path_present"`
	LinkedWorktree   Fact   `json:"linked_worktree"`
	NonMain          Fact   `json:"non_main"`
	BranchNamed      Fact   `json:"branch_named"`
	CommonDirMatches Fact   `json:"common_dir_matches"`
	HeadMatches      Fact   `json:"head_matches"`
	Unlocked         Fact   `json:"unlocked"`
	NotPrunable      Fact   `json:"not_prunable"`
	Clean            Fact   `json:"clean"`
	IgnoredEmpty     Fact   `json:"ignored_empty"`
	SubmodulesClean  Fact   `json:"submodules_clean"`
	NoGitOperation   Fact   `json:"no_git_operation"`
	LiveHead         string `json:"live_head,omitempty"`
	CommonDir        string `json:"common_dir,omitempty"`
	Staged           int    `json:"staged"`
	Unstaged         int    `json:"unstaged"`
	Conflicted       int    `json:"conflicted"`
	Untracked        int    `json:"untracked"`
	Ignored          int    `json:"ignored"`
	DirtySubmodules  int    `json:"dirty_submodules"`
	Operation        string `json:"operation,omitempty"`
}

// SafetyFacts joins non-provider ownership systems without exposing their
// private records.
type SafetyFacts struct {
	TaskUnclaimed  Fact `json:"task_unclaimed"`
	TaskClaims     int  `json:"task_claims"`
	ArtifactsKnown Fact `json:"artifacts_known"`
	ArtifactsSafe  Fact `json:"artifacts_safe"`
	ArtifactIntents int `json:"artifact_intents"`
	CallerOutside  Fact `json:"caller_outside"`
	RuntimeKnown   Fact `json:"runtime_known"`
	RuntimeClear   Fact `json:"runtime_clear"`
	CoveringSessions int `json:"covering_sessions"`
}

// AuditInput contains only already-collected facts. Audit performs no I/O.
type AuditInput struct {
	ProviderOwned    Fact
	ProviderUnique   Fact
	ProviderMapping  Fact
	WorkflowState    string
	WorkflowTerminal Fact
	AgentState       string
	AgentDone        Fact
	JournalStarted   Fact
	JournalResult    Fact
	NotResumed       Fact
	ProviderInactive Fact

	Registered       Fact
	PathPresent      Fact
	LinkedWorktree   Fact
	NonMain          Fact
	BranchNamed      Fact
	CommonDirMatches Fact
	HeadMatches      Fact
	Unlocked         Fact
	NotPrunable      Fact
	Clean            Fact
	IgnoredEmpty     Fact
	SubmodulesClean  Fact
	NoGitOperation   Fact
	TaskUnclaimed    Fact
	ArtifactsKnown   Fact
	ArtifactsSafe    Fact
	CallerOutside    Fact
	RuntimeKnown     Fact
	RuntimeClear     Fact
}

type Check struct {
	ID             string         `json:"id"`
	Classification Classification `json:"classification"`
	Detail         string         `json:"detail"`
}

type AuditResult struct {
	Classification Classification `json:"classification"`
	Checks         []Check        `json:"checks"`
}

// BranchDeletion is a separate action audit. It never controls whether the
// clean worktree itself may be removed, because retaining the named branch
// preserves unique commits.
type BranchDeletion struct {
	Requested    bool           `json:"requested"`
	BaseExplicit bool           `json:"base_explicit"`
	BaseRef      string         `json:"base_ref,omitempty"`
	BaseHead     string         `json:"base_head,omitempty"`
	BranchTip    string         `json:"branch_tip,omitempty"`
	RelationKnown bool          `json:"relation_known"`
	BaseOnly     int            `json:"base_only"`
	BranchOnly   int            `json:"branch_only"`
	Safe         bool           `json:"safe"`
	Checks       []Check        `json:"checks"`
}

type PlannedAction struct {
	Kind   string `json:"kind"`
	Target string `json:"target"`
	Status string `json:"status"`
	Detail string `json:"detail"`
}

type Candidate struct {
	Provider       string           `json:"provider,omitempty"`
	SessionID      string           `json:"session_id,omitempty"`
	RunID          string           `json:"run_id,omitempty"`
	AgentID        string           `json:"agent_id,omitempty"`
	WorkflowState  string           `json:"workflow_state,omitempty"`
	AgentState     string           `json:"agent_state,omitempty"`
	LastActivity   time.Time        `json:"last_activity,omitempty"`
	LastActivityKnown bool          `json:"last_activity_known"`
	Path           string           `json:"path"`
	Branch         string           `json:"branch,omitempty"`
	RegistryHead   string           `json:"registry_head,omitempty"`
	Git            GitFacts         `json:"git"`
	Safety         SafetyFacts      `json:"safety"`
	Classification Classification   `json:"classification"`
	Checks         []Check          `json:"checks"`
	BranchDeletion BranchDeletion   `json:"branch_deletion"`
	PlannedActions []PlannedAction  `json:"planned_actions"`
	Fingerprint    string           `json:"fingerprint"`
}

type Summary struct {
	Total         int `json:"total"`
	Eligible      int `json:"eligible"`
	Blocked       int `json:"blocked"`
	Unknown       int `json:"unknown"`
	NotApplicable int `json:"not_applicable"`
}

type Report struct {
	SchemaVersion int                `json:"schema_version"`
	GeneratedAt   time.Time          `json:"generated_at"`
	Repository    RepositoryIdentity `json:"repository"`
	StaleDays     int                `json:"stale_days"`
	Capabilities  []Capability       `json:"capabilities"`
	Diagnostics   []Diagnostic       `json:"diagnostics"`
	Candidates    []Candidate        `json:"candidates"`
	Summary       Summary            `json:"summary"`
}

type ApplyStatus string

const (
	ApplyRemoved        ApplyStatus = "removed"
	ApplyPartial        ApplyStatus = "partial"
	ApplySkippedChanged ApplyStatus = "skipped-changed"
	ApplyFailed         ApplyStatus = "failed"
)

type ApplyCandidateResult struct {
	Path            string      `json:"path"`
	Branch          string      `json:"branch,omitempty"`
	Status          ApplyStatus `json:"status"`
	RemovedWorktree bool        `json:"removed_worktree"`
	DeletedBranch   bool        `json:"deleted_branch"`
	BranchRetained  bool        `json:"branch_retained"`
	Detail          string      `json:"detail"`
}

type ApplyResult struct {
	SchemaVersion int                    `json:"schema_version"`
	Repository    RepositoryIdentity     `json:"repository"`
	Results       []ApplyCandidateResult `json:"results"`
}

type ReportRequest struct {
	RepoPath      string
	StaleDays     int
	BaseRef       string
	BaseExplicit  bool
	DeleteBranches bool
}

type ApplyRequest struct {
	Report       Report
	Fingerprints []string
}

package ephemeral

const (
	CheckProviderOwned    = "provider-owned"
	CheckProviderUnique   = "provider-claim-unique"
	CheckProviderMapping  = "provider-mapping"
	CheckWorkflowTerminal = "workflow-terminal"
	CheckAgentDone        = "agent-done"
	CheckJournalStarted   = "journal-started"
	CheckJournalResult    = "journal-result"
	CheckNotResumed       = "agent-not-resumed"
	CheckProviderInactive = "provider-inactive"
	CheckRegistered       = "registered"
	CheckPathPresent      = "path-present"
	CheckLinkedWorktree   = "linked-worktree"
	CheckNonMain          = "non-main"
	CheckBranchNamed      = "branch-named"
	CheckCommonDir        = "common-dir-matches"
	CheckHeadMatches      = "head-matches"
	CheckUnlocked         = "worktree-unlocked"
	CheckNotPrunable      = "worktree-not-prunable"
	CheckClean            = "clean"
	CheckIgnoredEmpty     = "ignored-empty"
	CheckSubmodulesClean  = "submodules-clean"
	CheckNoGitOperation   = "no-git-operation"
	CheckTaskUnclaimed    = "task-unclaimed"
	CheckArtifactsKnown   = "artifacts-known"
	CheckArtifactsSafe    = "artifacts-safe"
	CheckCallerOutside    = "caller-outside"
	CheckRuntimeKnown     = "runtime-known"
	CheckRuntimeClear     = "runtime-clear"
)

// Audit applies pure V1 policy to already-collected facts. Known blockers
// outrank unknown observations. A structurally absent/prunable/non-provider
// target is report-only and therefore not applicable rather than eligible.
func Audit(in AuditInput) AuditResult {
	checks := []Check{
		booleanCheck(CheckProviderOwned, in.ProviderOwned, "provider ownership is verified", "candidate is not owned by the provider", "provider ownership was not verified", NotApplicable),
		booleanCheck(CheckProviderUnique, in.ProviderUnique, "provider claim is unique", "provider claims are duplicated or ambiguous", "provider claim uniqueness is unknown", Blocked),
		booleanCheck(CheckProviderMapping, in.ProviderMapping, "provider mapping exactly matches", "provider mapping does not match", "provider mapping is unknown", Blocked),
		v1UnknownCheck(CheckWorkflowTerminal, in.WorkflowTerminal, "workflow is terminal", "workflow is non-terminal or has ambiguous terminal state", "workflow terminal state is unknown"),
		v1UnknownCheck(CheckAgentDone, in.AgentDone, "agent state is done", "agent state is not done", "agent state is unknown"),
		v1UnknownCheck(CheckJournalStarted, in.JournalStarted, "matching started record exists", "matching started record is absent", "matching started record is unknown"),
		v1UnknownCheck(CheckJournalResult, in.JournalResult, "matching result record exists", "matching result record is absent", "matching result record is unknown"),
		v1UnknownCheck(CheckNotResumed, in.NotResumed, "same-ID resumed transcript is absent", "same-ID resumed transcript exists", "same-ID resume state is unknown"),
		booleanCheck(CheckProviderInactive, in.ProviderInactive, "provider activity is older than the threshold", "provider activity is newer than the threshold", "provider activity time is unknown", Blocked),
		booleanCheck(CheckRegistered, in.Registered, "checkout is registered", "provider path is not registered", "worktree registration is unknown", NotApplicable),
		booleanCheck(CheckPathPresent, in.PathPresent, "checkout path is present", "checkout path is missing", "checkout path presence is unknown", NotApplicable),
		booleanCheck(CheckLinkedWorktree, in.LinkedWorktree, "checkout is a linked worktree", "checkout is not a linked worktree", "linked-worktree identity is unknown", NotApplicable),
		booleanCheck(CheckNonMain, in.NonMain, "checkout is not canonical", "canonical checkout removal is not applicable", "canonical-checkout identity is unknown", NotApplicable),
		booleanCheck(CheckBranchNamed, in.BranchNamed, "worktree has a named branch", "worktree is detached or unnamed", "branch identity is unknown", Blocked),
		booleanCheck(CheckCommonDir, in.CommonDirMatches, "checkout common-dir matches the repository", "checkout belongs to another common-dir", "checkout common-dir is unknown", Blocked),
		booleanCheck(CheckHeadMatches, in.HeadMatches, "registry and live HEAD agree", "registry and live HEAD differ", "live HEAD agreement is unknown", Blocked),
		booleanCheck(CheckUnlocked, in.Unlocked, "worktree is unlocked", "worktree is locked", "worktree lock state is unknown", Blocked),
		booleanCheck(CheckNotPrunable, in.NotPrunable, "worktree registration is not prunable", "worktree registration is prunable", "prunable state is unknown", NotApplicable),
		booleanCheck(CheckClean, in.Clean, "checkout has no staged, unstaged, conflicted, or untracked paths", "checkout has staged, unstaged, conflicted, or untracked paths", "checkout cleanliness is unknown", Blocked),
		booleanCheck(CheckIgnoredEmpty, in.IgnoredEmpty, "checkout has no ignored files", "checkout contains ignored files", "ignored-file inventory is unknown", Blocked),
		booleanCheck(CheckSubmodulesClean, in.SubmodulesClean, "submodule state is clean", "submodule state is dirty or conflicted", "submodule state is unknown", Blocked),
		booleanCheck(CheckNoGitOperation, in.NoGitOperation, "no Git operation is in progress", "a Git operation is in progress", "Git operation state is unknown", Blocked),
		booleanCheck(CheckTaskUnclaimed, in.TaskUnclaimed, "no task claims the checkout or branch", "a persisted task claims the checkout or branch", "task claims are unknown", Blocked),
		knownCheck(CheckArtifactsKnown, in.ArtifactsKnown, "artifact inventory is known", "artifact inventory is unknown"),
		booleanCheck(CheckArtifactsSafe, in.ArtifactsSafe, "all artifact intents are discarded or finalized and reachable", "an artifact intent is not discarded or finalized and reachable", "artifact safety is unknown", Blocked),
		booleanCheck(CheckCallerOutside, in.CallerOutside, "caller is outside the target", "caller is inside the target", "caller containment is unknown", Blocked),
		knownCheck(CheckRuntimeKnown, in.RuntimeKnown, "every available runtime was inventoried", "runtime inventory is unknown"),
		booleanCheck(CheckRuntimeClear, in.RuntimeClear, "no runtime session covers the target", "a runtime session covers the target", "runtime coverage is unknown", Blocked),
	}

	// Explicit report-only structural outcomes dominate ordinary eligibility but
	// never turn unknown provider evidence into not-applicable.
	for _, id := range []string{CheckProviderOwned, CheckRegistered, CheckPathPresent, CheckLinkedWorktree, CheckNonMain, CheckNotPrunable} {
		if status(checks, id) == NotApplicable {
			return AuditResult{Classification: NotApplicable, Checks: checks}
		}
	}
	return AuditResult{Classification: aggregate(checks), Checks: checks}
}

func booleanCheck(id string, fact Fact, yes, no, unknown string, falseClass Classification) Check {
	if !fact.Known {
		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
	}
	if fact.Value {
		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
	}
	return Check{ID: id, Classification: falseClass, Detail: no}
}

func knownCheck(id string, fact Fact, yes, unknown string) Check {
	if !fact.Known {
		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
	}
	if !fact.Value {
		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
	}
	return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
}

// V1 refuses to distinguish a known absent liveness record from uncertainty:
// both require stronger upstream evidence and have no attestation bypass.
func v1UnknownCheck(id string, fact Fact, yes, no, unknown string) Check {
	if !fact.Known {
		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
	}
	if !fact.Value {
		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: no}
	}
	return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
}

func aggregate(checks []Check) Classification {
	result := Eligible
	for _, check := range checks {
		switch check.Classification {
		case Blocked:
			return Blocked
		case Unknown:
			result = Unknown
		}
	}
	return result
}

func status(checks []Check, id string) Classification {
	for _, check := range checks {
		if check.ID == id {
			return check.Classification
		}
	}
	return Unknown
}

func TestAdapterCompletedAndKilledClaims(t *testing.T) {
	for _, status := range []string{"completed", "killed"} {
		t.Run(status, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newFixture(t)
			f.writeWorkflow(status, `,"unknown":{"prompt":"TOP SECRET PROMPT"}`)
			f.writeMeta("done", `,"newUpstreamField":[1,2,3]`)
			f.writeJournal(true, `,"result":{"body":"TOP SECRET RESULT"}`)

			got := f.collect()
			if !got.Complete || len(got.Claims) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("result = %+v", got)
			}
			claim := got.Claims[0]
			if claim.WorkflowState != status || !claim.WorkflowTerminal.Value || !claim.AgentDone.Value ||
				!claim.JournalStarted.Value || !claim.JournalResult.Value || !claim.NotResumed.Value ||
				!claim.LastActivityKnown {
				t.Fatalf("claim = %+v", claim)
			}
			encoded, err := json.Marshal(got)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			for _, secret := range []string{"TOP SECRET PROMPT", "TOP SECRET RESULT"} {
				if strings.Contains(string(encoded), secret) {
					t.Fatalf("adapter output leaked %q: %s", secret, encoded)

			}
		})
	}
}

func TestAdapterStrictV1Liveness(t *testing.T) {
	tests := map[string]struct {
		workflow string
		agent    string
		result   bool
		resume   bool
		assert   func(*testing.T, ephemeral.Claim)
	}{
		"progress": {workflow: "progress", agent: "done", result: true, assert: func(t *testing.T, c ephemeral.Claim) {
			if c.WorkflowTerminal.Value || !c.WorkflowTerminal.Known {
				t.Fatalf("workflow terminal = %+v", c.WorkflowTerminal)
			}
		}},
		"no result": {workflow: "killed", agent: "done", result: false, assert: func(t *testing.T, c ephemeral.Claim) {
			if c.JournalResult.Value || !c.JournalResult.Known {
				t.Fatalf("journal result = %+v", c.JournalResult)
			}
		}},
		"agent not done": {workflow: "completed", agent: "progress", result: true, assert: func(t *testing.T, c ephemeral.Claim) {
			if c.AgentDone.Value || !c.AgentDone.Known {
				t.Fatalf("agent done = %+v", c.AgentDone)
			}
		}},
		"resumed": {workflow: "completed", agent: "done", result: true, resume: true, assert: func(t *testing.T, c ephemeral.Claim) {
			if c.NotResumed.Value || !c.NotResumed.Known {
				t.Fatalf("not resumed = %+v", c.NotResumed)
			}
		}},
	}
	for name, tc := range tests {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newFixture(t)
			f.writeWorkflow(tc.workflow, "")
			f.writeMeta(tc.agent, "")
			f.writeJournal(tc.result, "")
			if tc.resume {
				f.writeResume("TOP SECRET TRANSCRIPT")
			}
			got := f.collect()
			if !got.Complete || len(got.Claims) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("result = %+v", got)
			}
			tc.assert(t, got.Claims[0])
		})
	}
}

	t.Run("traversal", func(t *testing.T) {

		f.writeWorkflow("completed", "")
		f.writeMetaAs("agent-agent-1.meta.json", "agent-1", filepath.Join(f.repo, ".claude", "worktrees", "..", "escape"), "wf_run-1", "wf_run-1", "done", "")
		f.writeJournal(true, "")
		got := f.collect()
		if got.Complete || !hasCode(got, "invalid-worktree-path") {
			t.Fatalf("traversal should fail closed: %+v", got)
		}
	})

	if runtime.GOOS != "windows" {
		t.Run("symlink", func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newFixture(t)
			f.writeWorkflow("completed", "")
			f.writeMeta("done", "")
			f.writeJournal(true, "")
			meta := f.metaPath("agent-agent-1.meta.json")
			target := meta + ".target"
			if err := os.Rename(meta, target); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := os.Symlink(target, meta); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			got := f.collect()
			if got.Complete || !hasCode(got, "unsafe-metadata") {
				t.Fatalf("symlink should fail closed: %+v", got)
			}
		})

		t.Run("group writable", func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newFixture(t)
			f.writeWorkflow("completed", "")
			f.writeMeta("done", "")
			f.writeJournal(true, "")
			if err := os.Chmod(f.metaPath("agent-agent-1.meta.json"), 0o660); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			got := f.collect()
			if got.Complete || !hasCode(got, "unsafe-metadata") {
				t.Fatalf("group-writable file should fail closed: %+v", got)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestAdapterEnforcesSizeCountAndMutationBounds(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("oversized", func(t *testing.T) {
		f := newFixture(t)
		f.writeWorkflowRaw(strings.Repeat("x", 257))
		adapter := New(f.root, WithLimits(Limits{MaxProjects: 8, MaxSessions: 8, MaxWorkflows: 8, MaxAgents: 8, MaxJSONBytes: 256, MaxJournalBytes: 1024, MaxJournalRecords: 8}))
		got := adapter.Collect(context.Background(), f.query())
		if got.Complete || !hasCode(got, "metadata-bound") {
			t.Fatalf("oversized metadata should fail closed: %+v", got)
		}
	})

	t.Run("over count", func(t *testing.T) {
		f := newFixture(t)
		f.writeWorkflow("completed", "")
		f.writeMeta("done", "")
		f.writeJournal(true, "")
		adapter := New(f.root, WithLimits(Limits{MaxProjects: 8, MaxSessions: 8, MaxWorkflows: 8, MaxAgents: 0, MaxJSONBytes: 4096, MaxJournalBytes: 4096, MaxJournalRecords: 8}))
		got := adapter.Collect(context.Background(), f.query())
		if got.Complete || !hasCode(got, "metadata-bound") {
			t.Fatalf("over-count metadata should fail closed: %+v", got)
		}
	})

	t.Run("mutation", func(t *testing.T) {
		f := newFixture(t)
		f.writeWorkflow("completed", "")
		f.writeMeta("done", "")
		f.writeJournal(true, "")
		mutated := false
		adapter := New(f.root, withAfterRead(func(path string) {
			if mutated || path != f.metaPath("agent-agent-1.meta.json") {
				return
			}
			mutated = true
			_ = os.WriteFile(path, []byte(`{"changed":true}`), 0o600)
		}))
		got := adapter.Collect(context.Background(), f.query())
		if got.Complete || !hasCode(got, "metadata-mutated") {
			t.Fatalf("source mutation should fail closed: %+v", got)
		}
	})
}

func TestAdapterConservativeTimestamps(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("future", func(t *testing.T) {
		f := newFixture(t)
		f.workflowTime = fixtureNow.Add(time.Minute)
		f.writeWorkflow("completed", "")
		f.writeMeta("done", "")
		f.writeJournal(true, "")
		got := f.collect()
		if !got.Complete || len(got.Claims) != 1 || got.Claims[0].LastActivityKnown {
			t.Fatalf("future time should make activity unknown: %+v", got)
		}
	})

	t.Run("conflicting order", func(t *testing.T) {
		f := newFixture(t)
		f.writeWorkflow("completed", "")
		f.writeMeta("done", "")
		f.writeJournalTimes(fixtureNow.Add(-time.Hour), fixtureNow.Add(-2*time.Hour), "")
		got := f.collect()
		if !got.Complete || len(got.Claims) != 1 || got.Claims[0].LastActivityKnown {
			t.Fatalf("result before start should make activity unknown: %+v", got)
		}
	})
}

func TestAdapterNeverReadsResumeTranscriptContent(t *testing.T) {
	f := newFixture(t)
	f.writeWorkflow("completed", "")
	f.writeMeta("done", "")
	f.writeJournal(true, "")
	transcript := f.resumePath()
	if err := os.WriteFile(transcript, []byte("TOP SECRET TRANSCRIPT"), 0); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Existence and lstat must suffice; unreadable content cannot prevent resume
	// detection. On privileged Windows runners mode 000 is not meaningful, but
	// the same assertion still proves no decode is attempted.
	got := f.collect()
	if !got.Complete || len(got.Claims) != 1 || got.Claims[0].NotResumed.Value {
		t.Fatalf("resume transcript existence should be detected without reading it: %+v", got)
	}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(got)
	if strings.Contains(string(encoded), "TOP SECRET TRANSCRIPT") {
		t.Fatalf("transcript content leaked: %s", encoded)
	}
}

func quote(value string) string {
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(value)
	return string(encoded)

func hasCode(result ephemeral.SourceResult, code string) bool {
	for _, diagnostic := range result.Diagnostics {
		if diagnostic.Code == code {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
