345	// orphanSuggestions handles the residue of a worktree removed while its
346	// transcript writer was still running: the path exists, Git has no record of
347	// it, and it holds only agent artifacts. Removing it is offered only once every
348	// file in it is proven byte-identical to one the repository already has.
349	func orphanSuggestions(app *App, r inventory.Row) []suggestion {
350		t := r.Task
351		if t.WorktreePath == "" || !r.WorktreeMissing || !r.CheckoutExists {
352			return nil
353		}
354		orphan, ok, err := retirement.InspectOrphan(t.WorktreePath)
355		if err != nil || !ok {
356			return nil
357		}
358		unsalvaged, err := retirement.Unsalvaged(orphan, t.RepoPath)
359		if err != nil {
360			return nil
361		}
362		if len(unsalvaged) > 0 {
363			return []suggestion{{
364				row: r,
365				reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace holding %d file(s) the repository does not have",
366					config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(unsalvaged)),
367				action: fmt.Sprintf("salvage %s first — not removed automatically", strings.Join(unsalvaged, ", ")),
368			}}
369		}
370		return []suggestion{{
371			row:    r,
372			reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace git does not know", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
373			action: fmt.Sprintf("remove the empty shell %s (its %d artifact file(s) are already in the repository)",
374				config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(orphan.Files)),
375			apply: func() error { return os.RemoveAll(t.WorktreePath) },
376		}}
377	}

379	func suggestMergedWorktrees(app *App, ctx context.Context, rows []inventory.Row, requestedBase string, options sweepRetireOptions) ([]suggestion, error) {

437	
438			synthetic := &task.Task{
439				ID: task.MakeID(repository.Name, worktree.Branch), Name: worktree.Branch,
440				Repo: repository.Name, RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, Branch: worktree.Branch,
441				Base: base, WorktreePath: canonical, Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Done,
442			}
443			row := inventory.Row{Task: synthetic, Checkout: canonical, CheckoutExists: true}
444			if worktree.Locked {
445				reason := "worktree is locked"
446				if worktree.LockedReason != "" {
447					reason += ": " + worktree.LockedReason
448				}
449				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, reason))
450				continue
451			}
452			if worktree.Prunable {
453				reason := "worktree registration is prunable"
454				if worktree.PrunableReason != "" {
455					reason += ": " + worktree.PrunableReason
456				}
457				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, reason))
458				continue
459			}
460			worktreeStatus, statusErr := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, canonical)
461			if statusErr != nil {
462				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, statusErr.Error()))
463				continue
464			}
465			row.Status = worktreeStatus
466			if worktreeStatus.Dirty() {
467				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
468					fmt.Sprintf("worktree is dirty (%s)", worktreeStatus.Breakdown())))
469				continue
470			}
471			if operation, active, operationErr := gitx.InProgress(canonical); operationErr != nil {
472				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, operationErr.Error()))
473				continue
474			} else if active {
475				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
476					fmt.Sprintf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)))
477				continue
478			}
479			if artifactErr := ensureArtifactsFinalized(app, canonical); artifactErr != nil {
480				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, artifactErr.Error()))
481				continue
482			}
483			inspection, inspectErr := retirement.Inspect(ctx, app.Runtime(), canonical, retirement.Options{
484				CloseUnknown: options.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.assumeNoRuntime,
485			})
486			if inspectErr != nil {
487				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, inspectErr.Error()))
488				continue
489			}
490			if !inspection.Ready() {
491				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; ")))
492				continue
493			}
494	
495			branch := worktree.Branch
496			checkout := canonical
497			action := fmt.Sprintf("retire merged worktree %s", config.Contract(checkout))
498			if options.deleteBranches {
499				action += fmt.Sprintf(" and delete %s", branch)
500			}
501			suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestion{
502				row: row, reason: fmt.Sprintf("untracked worktree branch is contained in %s", base), action: action,
503				apply: func() error {
504					service := &retirement.Service{Runtime: app.Runtime()}
505					_, err := service.Retire(ctx, retirement.Request{
506						Target: retirement.Target{
507							RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, CheckoutPath: checkout,
508							Branch: branch, Base: base, LinkedWorktree: true,
509						},
510						Safety: retirement.Options{
511							CloseUnknown: options.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.assumeNoRuntime,
512						},
513						DeleteBranch: options.deleteBranches,
514					})
515					return err
516				},
517			})
518		}
519		return suggestions, nil
520	}

522	func mergedWorktreeBlocker(row inventory.Row, base, blocker string) suggestion {
523		return suggestion{

525			action: blocker + " — not changed automatically",

529	func confirm(app *App, in *bufio.Reader, action string) bool {
530		s := app.outStyle()
531		prompt := s.prompt(action + "?")
532		lower := strings.ToLower(action)
533		if strings.Contains(lower, "delete") || strings.Contains(lower, "remove") ||
534			strings.Contains(lower, "discard") || strings.Contains(lower, "drop") {
535			prompt = s.danger(action + "?")
536		}
537		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s ", prompt, s.dim("[y/N]"))
538		line, err := in.ReadString('\n')
539		if err != nil {
540			return false
541		}
542		answer := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(line))
543		return answer == "y" || answer == "yes"
544	}

546	type ephemeralSweepOptions struct {
547		apply                  bool
548		staleDays              int
549		json                   bool
550		baseRef                string
551		baseExplicit           bool
552		yesChanged             bool
553		closeUnknownChanged    bool
554		assumeNoRuntimeChanged bool
555		deleteBranches         bool
556	}
557	
558	func runEphemeralSweep(ctx context.Context, app *App, _ *cobra.Command, options ephemeralSweepOptions) error {
559		switch {
560		case options.staleDays < 1:
561			return fmt.Errorf("--stale-days must be at least 1 for --ephemeral-worktrees")
562		case options.json && options.apply:
563			return fmt.Errorf("--json is report-only and cannot be combined with --apply")
564		case options.yesChanged:
565			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --yes; each item requires confirmation")
566		case options.closeUnknownChanged:
567			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --close-unknown")
568		case options.assumeNoRuntimeChanged:
569			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --assume-no-runtime")
570		case options.apply && app.noRuntime:
571			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees cannot apply with --no-runtime")
572		case options.deleteBranches && !options.apply:
573			return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branches with --ephemeral-worktrees requires --apply")
574		case options.deleteBranches && (!options.baseExplicit || strings.TrimSpace(options.baseRef) == ""):
575			return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branches with --ephemeral-worktrees requires an explicit --base")
576		case options.apply && !app.interactive():
577			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees --apply requires an interactive terminal")
578		}
579	
580		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
581		if err != nil || home == "" {
582			return fmt.Errorf("resolve home directory for Claude Workflow metadata")
583		}
584		service := ephemeral.NewService(
585			claudeworkflow.New(filepath.Join(home, ".claude", "projects")),
586			ephemeral.ServiceOptions{
587				Tasks: app.Tasks, Artifacts: artifactStore(app), Runtimes: ephemeralSweepRuntimes(app),
588				RuntimeDisabled: app.noRuntime,
589			},
590		)
591		report, err := service.Report(ctx, ephemeral.ReportRequest{
592			RepoPath: mustGetwd(), StaleDays: options.staleDays,
593			BaseRef: options.baseRef, BaseExplicit: options.baseExplicit, DeleteBranches: options.deleteBranches,
594		})
595		if err != nil {
596			return err
597		}
598		if options.json {
599			encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
600			encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
601			return encoder.Encode(report)
602		}
603		renderEphemeralReport(app, report)
604		if !options.apply {
605			return nil
606		}
607	
608		reader := bufio.NewReader(app.In)
609		var approved []string
610		for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
611			if candidate.Classification != ephemeral.Eligible {
612				continue
613			}
614			action := "remove ephemeral worktree " + config.Contract(candidate.Path) + " (branch retained)"
615			if candidate.BranchDeletion.Requested && candidate.BranchDeletion.Safe {
616				action = "remove ephemeral worktree " + config.Contract(candidate.Path) + " and delete branch " + candidate.Branch
617			}
618			if confirm(app, reader, action) {
619				approved = append(approved, candidate.Fingerprint)
620			}
621		}
622		if len(approved) == 0 {
623			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, app.outStyle().dim("No eligible worktree was approved; nothing changed."))
624			return nil
625		}
626		result, err := service.Apply(ctx, ephemeral.ApplyRequest{Report: report, Fingerprints: approved})
627		if err != nil {
628			return err
629		}
630		renderEphemeralApply(app, result)
631		return nil
632	}

634	func ephemeralSweepRuntimes(app *App) []runtime.Runtime {
635		if app.runtimeInstance != nil {
636			return []runtime.Runtime{app.runtimeInstance}
637		}
638		out := make([]runtime.Runtime, 0, 3)
639		for _, name := range []string{"herdr", "tmux", "zellij"} {
640			out = append(out, app.runtimeNamed(name))
641		}
642		return out
643	}
644	
645	func renderEphemeralReport(app *App, report ephemeral.Report) {
646		style := app.outStyle()
647		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%s\n", style.title("Verified ephemeral worktree report (schema v1)"))
648		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "Repository: %s\n", config.Contract(report.Repository.Root))
649		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "Candidates: %d (%d eligible, %d blocked, %d unknown, %d report-only)\n",
650			report.Summary.Total, report.Summary.Eligible, report.Summary.Blocked,
651			report.Summary.Unknown, report.Summary.NotApplicable)
652		for _, capability := range report.Capabilities {
653			if !capability.Available {
654				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  capability unavailable: %s\n", capability.Name)
655			}
656		}
657		for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
658			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n  %-14s %s\n", strings.ToUpper(string(candidate.Classification)), config.Contract(candidate.Path))
659			if candidate.Provider != "" {
660				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    provider=%s run=%s agent=%s workflow=%s agent-state=%s\n",
661					candidate.Provider, candidate.RunID, candidate.AgentID, candidate.WorkflowState, candidate.AgentState)
662			}
663			if candidate.LastActivityKnown {
664				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    last activity: %s\n", candidate.LastActivity.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339))
665			} else {
666				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "    last activity: unknown")
667			}
668			for _, check := range candidate.Checks {
669				if check.Classification != ephemeral.Eligible {
670					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    %s: %s — %s\n", check.ID, check.Classification, check.Detail)
671				}
672			}
673			for _, action := range candidate.PlannedActions {
674				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    %s: %s (%s)\n", action.Kind, action.Status, action.Detail)
675			}
676		}
677		if report.Summary.Eligible == 0 {
678			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("\nNo eligible ephemeral worktree was found; report-only entries were not changed."))
679		} else {
680			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("\nRe-run with --apply from an interactive terminal; every eligible item is confirmed separately."))
681		}
682	}
683	
684	func renderEphemeralApply(app *App, result ephemeral.ApplyResult) {
685		style := app.outStyle()
686		for _, item := range result.Results {
687			switch item.Status {
688			case ephemeral.ApplyRemoved:
689				branch := "branch retained"
690				if item.DeletedBranch {
691					branch = "branch deleted"
692				}
693				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s (%s)\n", style.success("removed:"), config.Contract(item.Path), branch)
694			case ephemeral.ApplyPartial:
695				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s — %s\n", style.warning("partial:"), config.Contract(item.Path), item.Detail)
696			case ephemeral.ApplySkippedChanged:
697				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s — %s\n", style.warning("skipped-changed:"), config.Contract(item.Path), item.Detail)
698			default:
699				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s — %s\n", style.warning("failed:"), config.Contract(item.Path), item.Detail)
700			}
701		}
702	}

18	// CheckoutOwnership says who is expected to clean up a checkout. Canonical and

31	// RepoCheckout is one checkout in a repository context. The first checkout is
32	// always the canonical checkout; the rest are linked worktrees in Git order.
33	type RepoCheckout struct {
34		Worktree gitx.Worktree
35		Status   gitx.Status
36		// StatusErr is retained so a prunable or unreadable checkout can remain
37		// visible without pretending its Git state was successfully inspected.
38		StatusErr    error
39		Exists       bool
40		LastActivity time.Time
41		LastCommit   time.Time
42		LastSubject  string
43		Sessions     []runtime.Session
44		Tasks        []*task.Task
45		Ownership    CheckoutOwnership
46	}

48	// Branch returns the named branch, falling back to the live status for the
49	// synthetic canonical checkout.
50	func (c RepoCheckout) Branch() string {
51		if c.Worktree.Branch != "" {
52			return c.Worktree.Branch
53		}
54		return c.Status.Branch

57	// RepoContext is the complete operational context for one discovered repo.
58	type RepoContext struct {
59		Repo repo.Repo
60		// Checkouts contains the canonical checkout followed by linked worktrees.
61		Checkouts []RepoCheckout
62		// OtherTasks are tracked branches which are not checked out here (for
63		// example cold or branch-only tasks on another branch).
64		OtherTasks []*task.Task
65		Runtime    string
66		// WorktreeCount is kept separately so a failed Git query can still explain
67		// the number shown from the administrative worktrees directory.
68		WorktreeCount int
69		WorktreeErr   error
70		LastActivity  time.Time
71	}

73	// Main returns the canonical checkout.
74	func (c RepoContext) Main() (RepoCheckout, bool) {
75		if len(c.Checkouts) == 0 {
76			return RepoCheckout{}, false
77		}
78		return c.Checkouts[0], true
79	}
80	
81	// Linked returns only linked worktrees.
82	func (c RepoContext) Linked() []RepoCheckout {
83		if len(c.Checkouts) < 2 {
84			return nil
85		}
86		return c.Checkouts[1:]
87	}

89	// Sessions returns the repo's live sessions once each, preserving checkout
90	// order so a pasted context reads canonical-first.
91	func (c RepoContext) Sessions() []runtime.Session {
92		seen := map[string]bool{}
93		var out []runtime.Session
94		for _, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
95			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
96				key := session.Handle
97				if key == "" {
98					key = session.Label + "\x00" + strings.Join(session.Dirs, "\x00")
99				}
100				if seen[key] {
101					continue
102				}
103				seen[key] = true
104				out = append(out, session)
105			}
106		}
107		return out
108	}

110	// CollectRepoContext joins Git, task and runtime state for one repository.
111	// Repositories with no linked-worktree admin entries deliberately skip
112	// `git worktree list`; this keeps the common whole-machine inventory path fast.
113	func CollectRepoContext(ctx context.Context, r repo.Repo, tasks []*task.Task,
114		sessions []runtime.Session, runtimeName string) RepoContext {
115	
116		out := RepoContext{Repo: r, Runtime: runtimeName}
117		main := RepoCheckout{
118			Worktree: gitx.Worktree{Path: r.Path, Main: true},
119			Exists:   pathIsDir(r.Path), Ownership: CheckoutCanonical,
120		}
121		if r.Bare {
122			main.Worktree.Bare = true
123		} else {
124			main.Status, main.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
125			main.Worktree.Branch = main.Status.Branch
126			main.Worktree.Detached = main.Status.Detached
127			main.LastActivity, main.LastCommit, main.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, r.Path, main.Status)
128		}
129		out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, main)
130	
131		out.WorktreeCount = linkedAdminCount(r.CommonDir)
132		if !r.Bare && out.WorktreeCount > 0 {
133			worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, r.Path)
134			if err != nil {
135				out.WorktreeErr = err
136			} else {
137				out.WorktreeCount = 0
138				for _, w := range worktrees {
139					if w.Main {
140						continue
141					}
142					checkout := RepoCheckout{
143						Worktree: w, Exists: pathIsDir(w.Path), Ownership: CheckoutExternal,
144					}
145					if checkout.Exists && !w.Prunable {
146						checkout.Status, checkout.StatusErr = gitx.StatusOf(ctx, w.Path)
147						checkout.LastActivity, checkout.LastCommit, checkout.LastSubject = checkoutActivity(ctx, w.Path, checkout.Status)
148					}
149					if LooksEphemeralWorktree(w.Path, w.Branch) {
150						checkout.Ownership = CheckoutEphemeral
151					}
152					out.Checkouts = append(out.Checkouts, checkout)
153					out.WorktreeCount++
154				}
155			}
156		}
157	
158		assignTasks(&out, tasks)
159		assignSessions(&out, sessions)
160		for _, checkout := range out.Checkouts {
161			if checkout.LastActivity.After(out.LastActivity) {
162				out.LastActivity = checkout.LastActivity
163			}
164			for _, t := range checkout.Tasks {
165				if t.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
166					out.LastActivity = t.Updated
167				}
168			}
169		}
170		for _, t := range out.OtherTasks {
171			if t.Updated.After(out.LastActivity) {
172				out.LastActivity = t.Updated
173			}
174		}
175		return out
176	}

178	// LooksEphemeralWorktree recognizes a path or branch convention commonly used
179	// by turn-scoped agent isolation. It is a display and candidate-discovery hint
180	// only; cleanup must independently verify provider ownership and every safety
181	// fact.
182	func LooksEphemeralWorktree(path, branch string) bool {
183		slashPath := filepath.ToSlash(path)
184		return strings.Contains(slashPath, "/.claude/worktrees/") ||
185			strings.HasPrefix(branch, "worktree-")
186	}

188	// IsEphemeralWorktree is retained for source compatibility. Callers must treat
189	// its result with the same hint-only semantics as LooksEphemeralWorktree.
190	func IsEphemeralWorktree(path, branch string) bool {
191		return LooksEphemeralWorktree(path, branch)
192	}

194	func linkedAdminCount(commonDir string) int {
195		if commonDir == "" {
196			return 0
197		}
198		entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(commonDir, "worktrees"))
199		if err != nil {
200			return 0
201		}
202		n := 0
203		for _, entry := range entries {

207		}

216	func checkoutActivity(ctx context.Context, path string, status gitx.Status) (time.Time, time.Time, string) {
217		latest := status.LatestChange
218		var commit time.Time
219		var subject string
220		if unix, lastSubject, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, path); err == nil && unix > 0 {
221			commit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
222			if commit.After(latest) {
223				latest = commit
224			}
225			subject = lastSubject
226		}
227		return latest, commit, subject
228	}

230	func assignTasks(out *RepoContext, tasks []*task.Task) {
231		for _, t := range tasks {
232			assigned := false
233			if t.WorktreePath != "" {
234				for i := 1; i < len(out.Checkouts); i++ {
235					if samePath(t.WorktreePath, out.Checkouts[i].Worktree.Path) {
236						out.Checkouts[i].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, t)
237						out.Checkouts[i].Ownership = CheckoutDev
238						assigned = true
239						break
240					}
241				}
242			} else if len(out.Checkouts) > 0 && t.Branch == out.Checkouts[0].Branch() {
243				out.Checkouts[0].Tasks = append(out.Checkouts[0].Tasks, t)
244				assigned = true
245			}
246			if !assigned {
247				out.OtherTasks = append(out.OtherTasks, t)
248			}
249		}
250		for i := range out.Checkouts {
251			sort.SliceStable(out.Checkouts[i].Tasks, func(a, b int) bool {
252				return out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[a].ID < out.Checkouts[i].Tasks[b].ID
253			})
254		}
255		sort.SliceStable(out.OtherTasks, func(i, j int) bool {
256			return out.OtherTasks[i].ID < out.OtherTasks[j].ID
257		})
258	}

260	// assignSessions assigns each observed directory to the most-specific
261	// checkout. A session rooted in repo/.claude/worktrees/x therefore belongs to
262	// x, not to the canonical checkout which also happens to contain that path.
263	func assignSessions(out *RepoContext, sessions []runtime.Session) {
264		for _, session := range sessions {
265			assigned := map[int]bool{}
266			for _, dir := range session.Dirs {
267				best, bestLen := -1, -1
268				for i := range out.Checkouts {
269					for _, root := range checkoutRoots(out.Repo, i, out.Checkouts[i]) {
270						if pathContains(root, dir) && len(filepath.Clean(root)) > bestLen {
271							best, bestLen = i, len(filepath.Clean(root))
272						}
273					}
274				}
275				if best >= 0 {
276					assigned[best] = true
277				}
278			}
279			for i := range assigned {
280				out.Checkouts[i].Sessions = append(out.Checkouts[i].Sessions, session)
281			}
282		}
283	}

285	func checkoutRoots(r repo.Repo, index int, checkout RepoCheckout) []string {
286		roots := []string{checkout.Worktree.Path}
287		if index == 0 && r.RealPath != "" && !samePath(r.RealPath, r.Path) {
288			roots = append(roots, r.RealPath)
289		}
290		return roots
291	}
292	
293	func pathContains(root, path string) bool {
294		if root == "" || path == "" {
295			return false
296		}
297		rel, err := filepath.Rel(normalizePath(root), normalizePath(path))
298		if err != nil || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
299			return false
300		}
301		return rel == "." || !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
302	}
303	
304	func samePath(a, b string) bool {
305		return a != "" && b != "" && normalizePath(a) == normalizePath(b)
306	}
307	
308	// normalizePath resolves symlinks in the longest existing prefix. macOS temp
309	// paths commonly arrive as both /var/... and /private/var/...; runtime CWDs may
310	// also name a not-yet-created descendant, so EvalSymlinks on the whole string
311	// is not sufficient.
312	func normalizePath(path string) string {
313		clean := filepath.Clean(path)
314		cur := clean
315		for {
316			if real, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cur); err == nil {
317				rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(cur, clean)
318				if relErr == nil && rel != "." {
319					return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(real, rel))
320				}
321				return filepath.Clean(real)
322			}
323			parent := filepath.Dir(cur)
324			if parent == cur {
325				return clean
326			}
327			cur = parent
328		}
329	}
330	
331	// FormatRepoContext renders the deterministic Markdown used by both the CLI
332	// and the TUI's yy binding. checkoutIndex < 0 means the whole repository.
333	func FormatRepoContext(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
334		var b strings.Builder
335		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
336			checkout := c.Checkouts[checkoutIndex]
337			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev worktree context: %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout))
338			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, false)
339			return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
340		}
341	
342		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# dev repo context: %s\n\n", c.Repo.Display())
343		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Repository: `%s`\n", c.Repo.Display())
344		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Main path: `%s`\n", c.Repo.Path)
345		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Linked worktrees: %d\n", c.WorktreeCount)
346		if c.Runtime != "" && c.Runtime != "none" {
347			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Runtime: `%s`\n", c.Runtime)
348		}
349		if c.WorktreeErr != nil {
350			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Worktree inventory error: %s\n", c.WorktreeErr)
351		}
352		b.WriteString("\n## Checkouts\n")
353		for i, checkout := range c.Checkouts {
354			b.WriteString("\n")
355			writeCheckoutMarkdown(&b, c, checkout, i == 0)
356		}
357		if len(c.OtherTasks) > 0 {
358			b.WriteString("\n## Other tracked tasks\n\n")
359			for _, t := range c.OtherTasks {
360				writeTaskMarkdown(&b, t)
361			}
362		}
363		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String()) + "\n"
364	}
365	
366	func writeCheckoutMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, c RepoContext, checkout RepoCheckout, canonical bool) {
367		label := string(checkout.Ownership)
368		if canonical {
369			label = "canonical"
370		}
371		fmt.Fprintf(b, "### %s — %s\n\n", displayBranch(checkout), label)
372		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Path: `%s`\n", checkout.Worktree.Path)
373		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Branch: `%s`\n", displayBranch(checkout))
374		if checkout.Worktree.Bare {
375			b.WriteString("- Git: bare repository\n")
376		} else if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
377			b.WriteString("- Git: unavailable (checkout path is missing)\n")
378		} else if checkout.StatusErr != nil {
379			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: unavailable (%s)\n", checkout.StatusErr)
380		} else {
381			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Git: %s", checkout.Status.Summary())
382			if checkout.Status.Dirty() {
383				fmt.Fprintf(b, " — %s", checkout.Status.Breakdown())
384			}
385			b.WriteString("\n")
386			if checkout.Status.Upstream != "" {
387				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Upstream: `%s`\n", checkout.Status.Upstream)
388			} else {
389				b.WriteString("- Upstream: not published\n")
390			}
391		}
392		if checkout.Worktree.Locked {
393			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.LockedReason)
394			if reason == "" {
395				reason = "no reason recorded"
396			}
397			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: locked — %s\n", reason)
398		}
399		if checkout.Worktree.Prunable || !checkout.Exists {
400			reason := strings.TrimSpace(checkout.Worktree.PrunableReason)
401			if reason == "" {
402				reason = "checkout path is missing"
403			}
404			fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Worktree: prunable — %s\n", reason)
405		}
406		if len(checkout.Sessions) == 0 {
407			b.WriteString("- Runtime: closed\n")
408		} else {
409			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
410				status := session.AgentStatus
411				if status == "" {
412					status = "unknown"
413				}
414				fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Runtime: `%s %s` (%s)\n", c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
415				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
416					fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Agent sessions: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
417				}
418			}
419		}
420		if len(checkout.Tasks) == 0 {
421			b.WriteString("- Task: untracked\n")
422		} else {
423			for _, t := range checkout.Tasks {
424				writeTaskMarkdown(b, t)
425			}
426		}
427	}
428	
429	func writeTaskMarkdown(b *strings.Builder, t *task.Task) {
430		fmt.Fprintf(b, "- Task: `%s` — %s", t.ID, t.State)
431		if t.Next != "" {
432			fmt.Fprintf(b, "; next: %s", t.Next)
433		}
434		b.WriteString("\n")
435		if t.AgentSession != "" {
436			fmt.Fprintf(b, "  - Recorded agent: `%s`\n", t.AgentSession)
437		}
438	}
439	
440	func displayBranch(checkout RepoCheckout) string {
441		if branch := checkout.Branch(); branch != "" {
442			return branch
443		}
444		if checkout.Worktree.Detached || checkout.Status.Detached {
445			return "(detached HEAD)"
446		}
447		return "(unknown branch)"
448	}
449	
450	func markdownCodes(values []string) string {
451		quoted := make([]string, 0, len(values))
452		for _, value := range values {
453			quoted = append(quoted, "`"+value+"`")
454		}
455		return strings.Join(quoted, ", ")
456	}
457	
458	// FormatSessions renders the ys payload. checkoutIndex < 0 selects the whole
459	// repository; otherwise it selects one checkout.
460	func FormatSessions(c RepoContext, checkoutIndex int) string {
461		indices := make([]int, 0, len(c.Checkouts))
462		if checkoutIndex >= 0 && checkoutIndex < len(c.Checkouts) {
463			indices = append(indices, checkoutIndex)
464		} else {
465			for i := range c.Checkouts {
466				indices = append(indices, i)
467			}
468		}
469		var b strings.Builder
470		for _, i := range indices {
471			checkout := c.Checkouts[i]
472			for _, session := range checkout.Sessions {
473				status := session.AgentStatus
474				if status == "" {
475					status = "unknown"
476				}
477				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s`: `%s %s` (%s)\n",
478					checkout.Worktree.Path, c.Runtime, session.Handle, status)
479				if len(session.AgentSessions) > 0 {
480					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "  - agents: %s\n", markdownCodes(session.AgentSessions))
481				}
482			}
483		}
484		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String())
485	}
486	
487	// LinkedWorktreePaths returns the yw payload: absolute linked-worktree paths,
488	// one per line. The canonical checkout is intentionally excluded because WT
489	// counts linked worktrees only.
490	func LinkedWorktreePaths(c RepoContext) string {
491		paths := make([]string, 0, len(c.Linked()))
492		for _, checkout := range c.Linked() {
493			paths = append(paths, checkout.Worktree.Path)
494		}
495		return strings.Join(paths, "\n")
496	}

2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"crypto/sha256"
6		"encoding/hex"
7		"errors"
8		"fmt"
9		"io/fs"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
16	)
17	
18	// EphemeralCheckout is the read-only Git cleanliness evidence needed by the
19	// ephemeral cleanup service. It retains counts and a digest, never pathnames.
20	type EphemeralCheckout struct {
21		Status          Status
22		Ignored         int
23		DirtySubmodules int
24		Fingerprint     string
25	}
26	
27	// InspectEphemeralCheckout reads full porcelain status, including all
28	// untracked files and non-ignored submodule state, plus Git's ignored-file
29	// inventory. Initialized submodules are inspected recursively so ignored files
30	// cannot hide behind the parent repository boundary. No command changes an
31	// index or worktree.
32	func InspectEphemeralCheckout(ctx context.Context, dir string) (EphemeralCheckout, error) {
33		return inspectEphemeralCheckout(ctx, dir, make(map[string]bool))
34	}
35	
36	func inspectEphemeralCheckout(ctx context.Context, dir string, seen map[string]bool) (EphemeralCheckout, error) {
37		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
38		if err != nil {
39			return EphemeralCheckout{}, err
40		}
41		if seen[canonical] {
42			return EphemeralCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("recursive submodule checkout path %s", canonical)
43		}
44		seen[canonical] = true
45		defer delete(seen, canonical)
46	
47		statusOutput, err := run(ctx, canonical,
48			"status", "--porcelain=v2", "--branch", "--untracked-files=all", "--ignore-submodules=none", "-z")
49		if err != nil {
50			return EphemeralCheckout{}, err
51		}
52		ignoredOutput, err := run(ctx, canonical,
53			"ls-files", "--others", "--ignored", "--exclude-standard", "-z")
54		if err != nil {
55			return EphemeralCheckout{}, err
56		}
57		gitlinksOutput, err := run(ctx, canonical, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z")
58		if err != nil {
59			return EphemeralCheckout{}, err
60		}
61	
62		ignored := nonEmptyNULRecords(ignoredOutput)
63		dirtyPaths := submoduleDirtyPaths(statusOutput)
64		dirtySubmodules := 0
65		var childFingerprints []string
66		for _, submodulePath := range gitlinkPaths(gitlinksOutput) {
67			joined := filepath.Join(canonical, filepath.FromSlash(submodulePath))
68			child, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(canonical, joined)
69			if err != nil {
70				return EphemeralCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("validate submodule path: %w", err)
71			}
72			info, err := os.Lstat(child)
73			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
74				dirtySubmodules++
75				childFingerprints = append(childFingerprints, digestEphemeral(submodulePath, "missing"))
76				continue
77			}
78			if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.IsDir() {
79				return EphemeralCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect submodule checkout")
80			}
81			childInspection, err := inspectEphemeralCheckout(ctx, child, seen)
82			if err != nil {
83				return EphemeralCheckout{}, err
84			}
85			ignored += childInspection.Ignored
86			childDirty := dirtyPaths[submodulePath] || childInspection.Status.Dirty() ||
87				childInspection.Ignored > 0 || childInspection.DirtySubmodules > 0
88			if childDirty {
89				dirtySubmodules++
90			}
91			dirtySubmodules += childInspection.DirtySubmodules
92			childFingerprints = append(childFingerprints, digestEphemeral(submodulePath, childInspection.Fingerprint))
93		}
94		sort.Strings(childFingerprints)
95		fingerprintParts := []string{statusOutput, ignoredOutput, gitlinksOutput}
96		fingerprintParts = append(fingerprintParts, childFingerprints...)
97		return EphemeralCheckout{
98			Status:          statusFromOutput(canonical, statusOutput),
99			Ignored:         ignored,
100			DirtySubmodules: dirtySubmodules,
101			Fingerprint:     digestEphemeral(fingerprintParts...),
102		}, nil
103	}
104	
105	func nonEmptyNULRecords(output string) int {
106		count := 0
107		for _, record := range nulLines(output) {
108			if record != "" {
109				count++
110			}
111		}
112		return count
113	}
114	
115	func submoduleDirtyCount(output string) int { return len(submoduleDirtyPaths(output)) }
116	
117	func submoduleDirtyPaths(output string) map[string]bool {
118		paths := make(map[string]bool)
119		for _, record := range nulLines(output) {
120			if record == "" || (record[0] != '1' && record[0] != '2') {
121				continue
122			}
123			fields := strings.Fields(record)
124			if len(fields) > 2 && strings.HasPrefix(fields[2], "S") {
125				if path := statusPath(record); path != "" {
126					paths[filepath.ToSlash(path)] = true
127				}
128			}
129		}
130		return paths
131	}
132	
133	func gitlinkPaths(output string) []string {
134		var paths []string
135		for _, record := range nulLines(output) {
136			metadata, path, ok := strings.Cut(record, "\t")
137			if !ok || path == "" {
138				continue
139			}
140			fields := strings.Fields(metadata)
141			if len(fields) == 3 && fields[0] == "160000" && fields[2] == "0" {
142				paths = append(paths, filepath.ToSlash(path))
143			}
144		}
145		sort.Strings(paths)
146		return paths
147	}
148	
149	func digestEphemeral(parts ...string) string {
150		hash := sha256.New()
151		for _, part := range parts {
152			hash.Write([]byte(part))
153			hash.Write([]byte{0})
154		}
155		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))
156	}

16	type UncommitReceipt struct {
17		OldOID  string    `json:"old_oid"`
18		Parent  string    `json:"parent"`
19		Branch  string    `json:"branch"`
20		Created time.Time `json:"created"`
21	}
22	
23	type PullRebaseResult struct {
24		StashOID     string
25		Restored     bool
26		Dropped      bool
27		HadLocalWork bool
28	}

30	type AmendOptions struct {
31		RewritePublished bool

34	
35	func InProgress(dir string) (string, bool, error) {
36		repository, err := Discover(context.Background(), dir)
37		if err != nil {
38			return "", false, err
39		}
40		// REBASE_HEAD is deliberately absent: Git leaves it behind after a rebase
41		// *completes*, so treating it as evidence would permanently block every
42		// worktree that was ever rebased. Only the rebase state directories prove
43		// a rebase is still running.
44		for _, candidate := range []string{
45			"MERGE_HEAD", "CHERRY_PICK_HEAD", "REVERT_HEAD", "BISECT_LOG",
46			"rebase-merge", "rebase-apply", "sequencer",
47		} {
48			for _, root := range []string{repository.GitDir, repository.GitCommonDir} {
49				if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(root, candidate)); err == nil {
50					return candidate, true, nil
51				} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
52					return "", false, err
53				}
54			}
55		}
56		return "", false, nil
57	}
58	
59	func Uncommit(ctx context.Context, dir string, rewritePublished bool) (*UncommitReceipt, error) {
60		repository, status, err := transactionPreflight(ctx, dir, rewritePublished)
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, err
63		}
64		if status.Staged > 0 {
65			return nil, fmt.Errorf("uncommit requires an empty index so existing staged work is not mixed")
66		}
67		line, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", "HEAD")
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, err
70		}
71		fields := strings.Fields(line)
72		if len(fields) != 2 {
73			if len(fields) == 1 {
74				return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot uncommit the root commit")
75			}
76			return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot uncommit a merge commit; parent topology would be lost")
77		}
78		receipt := &UncommitReceipt{OldOID: fields[0], Parent: fields[1], Branch: status.Branch, Created: time.Now().UTC()}
79		path := uncommitReceiptPath(repository.GitDir)
80		if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
81			return nil, fmt.Errorf("an uncommit receipt already exists; run dev git recommit first")
82		} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
83			return nil, err
84		}
85		if err := writeJSONAtomic(path, receipt); err != nil {
86			return nil, err
87		}
88		if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "reset", "--soft", receipt.Parent); err != nil {
89			_ = os.Remove(path)
90			return nil, err
91		}
92		return receipt, nil
93	}
94	
95	func Recommit(ctx context.Context, dir string) (string, error) {
96		repository, err := Discover(ctx, dir)
97		if err != nil {
98			return "", err
99		}
100		if operation, active, err := InProgress(repository.Root); err != nil {
101			return "", err
102		} else if active {
103			return "", fmt.Errorf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
104		}
105		path := uncommitReceiptPath(repository.GitDir)
106		receipt, err := readReceipt(path)
107		if err != nil {
108			return "", err
109		}
110		status, err := StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
111		if err != nil {
112			return "", err
113		}
114		if status.Detached || status.Branch != receipt.Branch {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("branch changed from %s to %s", receipt.Branch, status.Branch)
116		}
117		if status.Staged == 0 {
118			return "", fmt.Errorf("nothing is staged to recommit")
119		}
120		head, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
121		if err != nil {
122			return "", err
123		}
124		if head != receipt.Parent {
125			return "", fmt.Errorf("HEAD changed since uncommit: expected %s, got %s", receipt.Parent, head)
126		}
127		if !RefExists(ctx, repository.Root, receipt.OldOID) {
128			return "", fmt.Errorf("original commit %s is no longer available", receipt.OldOID)
129		}
130		if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "commit", "-C", receipt.OldOID); err != nil {
131			return "", err
132		}
133		commit, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
134		if err != nil {
135			return "", err
136		}
137		if err := os.Remove(path); err != nil {
138			return "", fmt.Errorf("commit created, but remove uncommit receipt: %w", err)
139		}
140		return commit, nil
141	}
142	
143	func PullRebase(ctx context.Context, dir string) (PullRebaseResult, error) {
144		repository, status, err := transactionPreflight(ctx, dir, true)
145		if err != nil {
146			return PullRebaseResult{}, err
147		}
148		if status.Upstream == "" {
149			return PullRebaseResult{}, fmt.Errorf("branch %s has no upstream", status.Branch)
150		}
151		var result PullRebaseResult
152		lockDir := filepath.Join(repository.GitCommonDir, "dev-git-transactions")
153		err = lockx.WithDir(ctx, lockDir, "git transaction", func() error {
154			current, err := StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
155			if err != nil {
156				return err
157			}
158			if current.Dirty() {
159				result.HadLocalWork = true
160				tag := fmt.Sprintf("dev-pull-rebase-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
161				if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "stash", "push", "--include-untracked", "-m", tag); err != nil {
162					return err
163				}
164				result.StashOID, err = stashOIDForTag(ctx, repository.Root, tag)
165				if err != nil {
166					return fmt.Errorf("capture created stash oid: %w", err)
167				}
168				if result.StashOID == "" {
169					return fmt.Errorf("Git reported local work but created no stash; refusing to reuse an existing stash")
170				}
171			}
172			if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "-c", "rebase.autoStash=false", "pull", "--rebase"); err != nil {
173				return fmt.Errorf("pull --rebase failed; local work remains in stash %s: %w", result.StashOID, err)
174			}
175			if result.StashOID == "" {
176				return nil
177			}
178			if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "stash", "apply", "--index", result.StashOID); err != nil {
179				return fmt.Errorf("restore local work from stash %s failed; stash retained: %w", result.StashOID, err)
180			}
181			result.Restored = true
182			selector, ok, err := stashSelector(ctx, repository.Root, result.StashOID)
183			if err != nil {
184				return err
185			}
186			if !ok {
187				return nil // Applied bytes are safe; retaining an extra stash beats dropping the wrong one.
188			}
189			if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "stash", "drop", selector); err != nil {
190				return fmt.Errorf("local work restored, but exact stash %s was retained: %w", result.StashOID, err)
191			}
192			result.Dropped = true
193			return nil
194		})
195		return result, err
196	}
197	
198	func AmendAll(ctx context.Context, dir string, options AmendOptions) (string, []string, error) {
199		repository, _, err := transactionPreflight(ctx, dir, options.RewritePublished)
200		if err != nil {
201			return "", nil, err
202		}

204		args := []string{"add", "-A", "--", "."}

213			for _, path := range paths {

216				}

221			return "", excluded, err

225			if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, resetArgs...); err != nil {
226				return "", excluded, fmt.Errorf("unstage excluded agent artifacts: %w", err)
227			}
228		}
229		staged, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only")

233		if strings.TrimSpace(staged) == "" {
234			return "", excluded, fmt.Errorf("nothing is staged to amend")
235		}
236		if _, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "commit", "--amend", "--no-edit"); err != nil {
237			return "", excluded, err
238		}
239		commit, err := Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
240		return commit, excluded, err

243	func ChangedPaths(ctx context.Context, dir string) ([]string, error) {
244		out, err := Run(ctx, dir, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, err
247		}
248		var paths []string
249		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
250		for i := 0; i < len(fields); i++ {
251			entry := fields[i]
252			if len(entry) < 4 {
253				continue
254			}
255			code := entry[:2]
256			paths = append(paths, filepath.ToSlash(entry[3:]))
257			if code[0] == 'R' || code[0] == 'C' {
258				i++
259			}
260		}
261		return paths, nil
262	}

264	func IsAgentArtifact(path string) bool {

266		for _, prefix := range []string{
267			".specstory/history/", ".claude/plans/", ".cursor/plans/", ".cursor/rules/",
268			".opencode/plans/", ".specify/", ".codex/",
269		} {
270			if strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix) {
271				return true
272			}

284	func transactionPreflight(ctx context.Context, dir string, rewritePublished bool) (Repo, Status, error) {
285		repository, err := Discover(ctx, dir)
286		if err != nil {
287			return Repo{}, Status{}, err
288		}
289		if repository.Bare {
290			return Repo{}, Status{}, fmt.Errorf("transaction requires a working tree")
291		}
292		status, err := StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
293		if err != nil {
294			return Repo{}, Status{}, err
295		}
296		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
297			return Repo{}, Status{}, fmt.Errorf("transaction refuses detached HEAD")
298		}
299		if status.Conflicted > 0 {
300			return Repo{}, Status{}, fmt.Errorf("transaction refuses %d conflicted path(s)", status.Conflicted)
301		}
302		if operation, active, err := InProgress(repository.Root); err != nil {
303			return Repo{}, Status{}, err
304		} else if active {
305			return Repo{}, Status{}, fmt.Errorf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
306		}
307		if status.Published() && status.Ahead == 0 && !rewritePublished {
308			return Repo{}, Status{}, fmt.Errorf("HEAD is already contained in %s; pass --rewrite-published to acknowledge rewriting it", status.Upstream)
309		}
310		return repository, status, nil
311	}
312	
313	func uncommitReceiptPath(gitDir string) string { return filepath.Join(gitDir, "dev-uncommit.json") }
314	
315	func readReceipt(path string) (*UncommitReceipt, error) {
316		file, err := os.Open(path)
317		if err != nil {
318			return nil, err
319		}
320		defer file.Close()
321		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
322		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
323		var receipt UncommitReceipt
324		if err := decoder.Decode(&receipt); err != nil {
325			return nil, err
326		}
327		if receipt.OldOID == "" || receipt.Parent == "" || receipt.Branch == "" {
328			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid uncommit receipt")
329		}
330		return &receipt, nil
331	}
332	
333	func writeJSONAtomic(path string, value any) error {
334		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".dev-receipt-*.tmp")
335		if err != nil {
336			return err
337		}
338		name := tmp.Name()
339		defer os.Remove(name)
340		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
341			tmp.Close()
342			return err
343		}
344		if err := json.NewEncoder(tmp).Encode(value); err != nil {
345			tmp.Close()
346			return err
347		}
348		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
349			return err
350		}
351		return os.Rename(name, path)
352	}
353	
354	func stashSelector(ctx context.Context, dir, oid string) (string, bool, error) {
355		out, err := Run(ctx, dir, "stash", "list", "--format=%H%x09%gd")
356		if err != nil {
357			return "", false, err
358		}
359		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
360			got, selector, ok := strings.Cut(line, "\t")
361			if ok && got == oid {
362				return selector, true, nil
363			}
364		}
365		return "", false, nil
366	}
367	
368	func stashOIDForTag(ctx context.Context, dir, tag string) (string, error) {
369		out, err := Run(ctx, dir, "stash", "list", "--format=%H%x09%gs")
370		if err != nil {
371			return "", err
372		}
373		var match string
374		for _, line := range strings.Split(out, "\n") {
375			oid, subject, ok := strings.Cut(line, "\t")
376			if !ok || !strings.HasSuffix(subject, ": "+tag) {
377				continue
378			}
379			if match != "" && match != oid {
380				return "", fmt.Errorf("multiple stashes matched transaction tag %s", tag)
381			}
382			match = oid
383		}
384		return match, nil
385	}
386	
387	func sortStrings(values []string) {
388		for i := 1; i < len(values); i++ {
389			for j := i; j > 0 && values[j] < values[j-1]; j-- {
390				values[j], values[j-1] = values[j-1], values[j]
391			}
392		}
393	}

98	func (s *Service) Report(ctx context.Context, request ReportRequest) (Report, error) {
99		if request.StaleDays < 1 {
100			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("stale-days must be at least 1")
101		}
102		if s == nil || s.backend == nil {
103			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("ephemeral service has no live-state backend")
104		}
105		repository, err := s.backend.discover(ctx, request.RepoPath)
106		if err != nil {
107			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("discover canonical repository: %w", err)
108		}
109		if repository.Identity.Bare {
110			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("ephemeral worktree sweep requires a non-bare canonical checkout")
111		}
112		if repository.Linked {
113			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("ephemeral worktree sweep must run from the canonical checkout")
114		}
115		now := time.Now().UTC()
116		if s.now != nil {
117			now = s.now().UTC()
118		}
119		report := Report{

121			StaleDays: request.StaleDays, BaseRef: request.BaseRef, BaseExplicit: request.BaseExplicit,
122			DeleteBranches: request.DeleteBranches, Capabilities: []Capability{}, Diagnostics: []Diagnostic{}, Candidates: []Candidate{},
123		}
124	
125		targets, worktreeErr := s.backend.worktrees(ctx, repository)
126		worktreesKnown := worktreeErr == nil
127		report.Capabilities = append(report.Capabilities, Capability{
128			Name: "git-worktree-inventory", Available: worktreesKnown, Detail: availabilityDetail(worktreesKnown),
129		})
130		if worktreeErr != nil {
131			report.Diagnostics = append(report.Diagnostics, diagnostic("git", "worktree-inventory-failed", "Git worktree inventory could not be verified"))
132			targets = nil
133		}
134		for i := range targets {
135			targets[i].Registered = true
136			targets[i].RegistrationKnown = true
137		}
138	
139		source := SourceResult{Complete: false}
140		if s.source != nil {
141			source = s.source.Collect(ctx, SourceQuery{Repository: repository.Identity, Targets: targets, Now: now})
142		} else {
143			source.Diagnostics = append(source.Diagnostics, diagnostic("provider", "provider-unavailable", "provider ownership metadata is unavailable"))
144		}
145		report.Capabilities = append(report.Capabilities, source.Capabilities...)
146		report.Diagnostics = append(report.Diagnostics, source.Diagnostics...)
147	
148		byPath := make(map[string]Target, len(targets))
149		for _, target := range targets {
150			byPath[target.Path] = target
151		}
152		claimedPaths := make(map[string]bool)
153		for _, claim := range source.Claims {
154			target, exists := byPath[claim.WorktreePath]
155			if !exists {
156				target = Target{Path: claim.WorktreePath, Registered: false, RegistrationKnown: worktreesKnown, Hint: true}
157			}
158			claimedPaths[claim.WorktreePath] = true
159			candidate, diagnostics, states := s.collectCandidate(ctx, repository, target, &claim, source.Complete, worktreesKnown, request, now)
160			report.Candidates = append(report.Candidates, candidate)
161			report.Diagnostics = append(report.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
162			report.Capabilities = mergeEvidenceCapabilities(report.Capabilities, states)
163		}
164		for _, target := range targets {
165			if !target.Hint || claimedPaths[target.Path] {
166				continue
167			}
168			candidate, diagnostics, states := s.collectCandidate(ctx, repository, target, nil, source.Complete, worktreesKnown, request, now)
169			report.Candidates = append(report.Candidates, candidate)
170			report.Diagnostics = append(report.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
171			report.Capabilities = mergeEvidenceCapabilities(report.Capabilities, states)
172		}
173	
174		sort.Slice(report.Candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
175			left, right := report.Candidates[i], report.Candidates[j]
176			if left.Path != right.Path {
177				return left.Path < right.Path
178			}
179			if left.RunID != right.RunID {
180				return left.RunID < right.RunID
181			}
182			return left.AgentID < right.AgentID
183		})
184		report.Capabilities = stableCapabilities(report.Capabilities)
185		report.Diagnostics = stableDiagnostics(report.Diagnostics)
186		for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
187			report.Summary.Total++
188			switch candidate.Classification {
189			case Eligible:
190				report.Summary.Eligible++
191			case Blocked:
192				report.Summary.Blocked++
193			case Unknown:
194				report.Summary.Unknown++
195			case NotApplicable:
196				report.Summary.NotApplicable++
197			}
198		}
199		return report, nil
200	}

206	func (s *Service) collectCandidate(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, target Target, claim *Claim,
207		sourceComplete, worktreesKnown bool, request ReportRequest, now time.Time) (Candidate, []Diagnostic, evidenceCapabilities) {
208	
209		candidate := Candidate{Path: target.Path, Branch: target.Branch, RegistryHead: target.RegistryHead}
210		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
211		states := evidenceCapabilities{tasks: true, artifacts: true, caller: true, runtime: true}
212		providerOwned := Fact{}
213		providerUnique, providerMapping := Fact{}, Fact{}
214		workflowTerminal, agentDone, journalStarted, journalResult, notResumed, inactive := Fact{}, Fact{}, Fact{}, Fact{}, Fact{}, Fact{}
215		if claim != nil {
216			candidate.Provider, candidate.SessionID, candidate.RunID, candidate.AgentID = claim.Provider, claim.SessionID, claim.RunID, claim.AgentID
217			candidate.WorkflowState, candidate.AgentState = claim.WorkflowState, claim.AgentState
218			candidate.LastActivity, candidate.LastActivityKnown = claim.LastActivity, claim.LastActivityKnown
219			providerOwned, providerUnique, providerMapping = claim.Owned, claim.Unique, claim.Mapping
220			workflowTerminal, agentDone = claim.WorkflowTerminal, claim.AgentDone
221			journalStarted, journalResult, notResumed = claim.JournalStarted, claim.JournalResult, claim.NotResumed
222			if claim.LastActivityKnown {
223				threshold := now.Add(-time.Duration(request.StaleDays) * 24 * time.Hour)
224				inactive = KnownFact(!claim.LastActivity.After(threshold))
225			}
226		} else if sourceComplete {
227			providerOwned = KnownFact(false)
228		}
229	
230		gitFacts, err := s.backend.gitFacts(ctx, repository, target)
231		if err != nil {
232			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("git", "checkout-inspection-failed", "checkout Git facts could not be verified"))
233			gitFacts = mergeStructuralGitFacts(gitFacts, target, worktreesKnown)
234		}
235		candidate.Git = gitFacts
236	
237		tasks, err := s.backend.taskEvidence(ctx, repository, target)
238		if err != nil {
239			states.tasks = false
240			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("task", "task-inventory-failed", "task claims could not be verified"))
241		}
242		artifacts, err := s.backend.artifactEvidence(ctx, target)
243		if err != nil {
244			states.artifacts = false
245			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("artifact", "artifact-inventory-failed", "artifact intents could not be verified"))
246		}
247		caller, err := s.backend.callerEvidence(target)
248		if err != nil {
249			states.caller = false
250			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("caller", "caller-containment-failed", "caller containment could not be verified"))
251		}
252		runtimeFacts, err := s.backend.runtimeEvidence(ctx, target)
253		if err != nil {
254			states.runtime = false
255			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("runtime", "runtime-inventory-failed", "runtime coverage could not be verified"))
256		}
257		candidate.Safety = SafetyFacts{
258			TaskUnclaimed: tasks.Unclaimed, TaskClaims: tasks.Claims, TaskFingerprint: tasks.Fingerprint,
259			ArtifactsKnown: artifacts.Known, ArtifactsSafe: artifacts.Safe, ArtifactIntents: artifacts.Intents, ArtifactFingerprint: artifacts.Fingerprint,
260			CallerOutside: caller.Outside, CallerFingerprint: caller.Fingerprint,
261			RuntimeKnown: runtimeFacts.Known, RuntimeClear: runtimeFacts.Clear,
262			CoveringSessions: runtimeFacts.Covering, RuntimeFingerprint: runtimeFacts.Fingerprint,
263		}
264	
265		audit := Audit(AuditInput{
266			ProviderOwned: providerOwned, ProviderUnique: providerUnique, ProviderMapping: providerMapping,
267			WorkflowState: candidate.WorkflowState, WorkflowTerminal: workflowTerminal,
268			AgentState: candidate.AgentState, AgentDone: agentDone,
269			JournalStarted: journalStarted, JournalResult: journalResult, NotResumed: notResumed, ProviderInactive: inactive,
270			Registered: gitFacts.Registered, PathPresent: gitFacts.PathPresent, LinkedWorktree: gitFacts.LinkedWorktree,
271			NonMain: gitFacts.NonMain, BranchNamed: gitFacts.BranchNamed, BranchMatches: gitFacts.BranchMatches,
272			CommonDirMatches: gitFacts.CommonDirMatches,
273			HeadMatches:      gitFacts.HeadMatches, Unlocked: gitFacts.Unlocked, NotPrunable: gitFacts.NotPrunable,
274			Clean: gitFacts.Clean, IgnoredEmpty: gitFacts.IgnoredEmpty, SubmodulesClean: gitFacts.SubmodulesClean,
275			NoGitOperation: gitFacts.NoGitOperation, TaskUnclaimed: tasks.Unclaimed,
276			ArtifactsKnown: artifacts.Known, ArtifactsSafe: artifacts.Safe, CallerOutside: caller.Outside,
277			RuntimeKnown: runtimeFacts.Known, RuntimeClear: runtimeFacts.Clear,
278		})
279		candidate.Classification, candidate.Checks = audit.Classification, audit.Checks
280		candidate.BranchDeletion = s.auditBranchDeletion(ctx, repository, target, request)
281		candidate.PlannedActions = plannedActions(candidate)
282		candidate.Fingerprint = candidateFingerprint(candidate)
283		return candidate, diagnostics, states
284	}

286	func structuralGitFacts(target Target, worktreesKnown bool) GitFacts {
287		facts := GitFacts{NonMain: KnownFact(!target.Main)}
288		if worktreesKnown && target.RegistrationKnown {
289			facts.Registered = KnownFact(target.Registered)
290			facts.LinkedWorktree = KnownFact(target.Registered && !target.Main && !target.Bare)
291			facts.BranchNamed = KnownFact(target.Branch != "" && !target.Detached)
292			facts.Unlocked = KnownFact(!target.Locked)
293			facts.NotPrunable = KnownFact(!target.Prunable)
294		}
295		return facts
296	}
297	
298	func mergeStructuralGitFacts(facts GitFacts, target Target, worktreesKnown bool) GitFacts {
299		fallback := structuralGitFacts(target, worktreesKnown)
300		for current, replacement := range map[*Fact]Fact{
301			&facts.Registered: fallback.Registered, &facts.LinkedWorktree: fallback.LinkedWorktree,
302			&facts.NonMain: fallback.NonMain, &facts.BranchNamed: fallback.BranchNamed,
303			&facts.Unlocked: fallback.Unlocked, &facts.NotPrunable: fallback.NotPrunable,
304		} {
305			if !current.Known {
306				*current = replacement
307			}
308		}
309		return facts
310	}
311	
312	func (s *Service) auditBranchDeletion(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, target Target, request ReportRequest) BranchDeletion {
313		result := BranchDeletion{Requested: request.DeleteBranches, BaseExplicit: request.BaseExplicit, BaseRef: request.BaseRef, Checks: []Check{}}
314		if !request.DeleteBranches {
315			return result
316		}
317		result.Checks = append(result.Checks, branchCheck("base-explicit", request.BaseExplicit && request.BaseRef != "", "an explicit base was supplied", "branch deletion requires an explicit base"))
318		result.Checks = append(result.Checks, branchCheck("branch-distinct-from-base", target.Branch != "" && target.Branch != request.BaseRef, "branch is named and differs from base", "branch is absent or equals the base"))
319		if !request.BaseExplicit || request.BaseRef == "" || target.Branch == "" || target.Branch == request.BaseRef {
320			result.Checks = append(result.Checks,
321				Check{ID: "base-and-tip-resolve", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "base and branch tips were not resolved"},
322				Check{ID: "branch-contained", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "branch containment is unknown"},
323				Check{ID: "zero-unique-commits", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "unique commit count is unknown"})
324			return result
325		}
326		state, err := s.backend.branchState(ctx, repository, request.BaseRef, target.Branch)
327		if err != nil {
328			result.Checks = append(result.Checks,
329				Check{ID: "base-and-tip-resolve", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "base or branch tip could not be resolved"},
330				Check{ID: "branch-contained", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "branch containment is unknown"},
331				Check{ID: "zero-unique-commits", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "unique commit count is unknown"})
332			return result
333		}
334		result.BaseHead, result.BranchTip = state.BaseHead, state.BranchTip
335		result.RelationKnown, result.BaseOnly, result.BranchOnly = true, state.BaseOnly, state.BranchOnly
336		result.Checks = append(result.Checks,
337			Check{ID: "base-and-tip-resolve", Classification: Eligible, Detail: "base and branch tips resolve"},
338			branchCheck("branch-contained", state.BranchOnly == 0, "branch is contained in the explicit base", "branch is not contained in the explicit base"),
339			branchCheck("zero-unique-commits", state.BranchOnly == 0, "branch has zero commits unique from base", "branch has commits unique from base"))
340		result.Safe = checksEligible(result.Checks)
341		return result
342	}
343	
344	func branchCheck(id string, value bool, yes, no string) Check {
345		if value {
346			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
347		}
348		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Blocked, Detail: no}
349	}
350	
351	func checksEligible(checks []Check) bool {
352		if len(checks) == 0 {
353			return false
354		}
355		for _, check := range checks {
356			if check.Classification != Eligible {
357				return false
358			}
359		}
360		return true
361	}
362	
363	func plannedActions(candidate Candidate) []PlannedAction {
364		removeStatus := "blocked"
365		removeDetail := "candidate is not eligible; report only"
366		if candidate.Classification == Eligible {
367			removeStatus, removeDetail = "planned", "remove with plain non-force git worktree remove after locked revalidation"
368		}
369		actions := []PlannedAction{{Kind: "remove-worktree", Target: candidate.Path, Status: removeStatus, Detail: removeDetail}}
370		if candidate.BranchDeletion.Requested && candidate.BranchDeletion.Safe {
371			actions = append(actions, PlannedAction{Kind: "delete-branch", Target: candidate.Branch, Status: "planned", Detail: "delete with git branch -d after separate post-removal revalidation"})
372		} else {
373			detail := "branch is retained by default"
374			if candidate.BranchDeletion.Requested {
375				detail = "branch deletion proof is incomplete or unsafe; retain the branch"
376			}
377			actions = append(actions, PlannedAction{Kind: "retain-branch", Target: candidate.Branch, Status: "planned", Detail: detail})
378		}
379		return actions
380	}

382	func candidateFingerprint(candidate Candidate) string {
383		candidate.Fingerprint = ""
384		data, err := json.Marshal(candidate)
385		if err != nil {
386			return ""
387		}
388		sum := sha256.Sum256(data)
389		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
390	}

392	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, request ApplyRequest) (ApplyResult, error) {
393		if request.Report.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
394			return ApplyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported ephemeral report schema %d", request.Report.SchemaVersion)
395		}
396		if len(request.Fingerprints) == 0 {
397			return ApplyResult{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Repository: request.Report.Repository, Results: []ApplyCandidateResult{}}, nil
398		}
399		repository, err := s.backend.discover(ctx, request.Report.Repository.Root)
400		if err != nil {
401			return ApplyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("rediscover canonical repository: %w", err)
402		}
403		if repository.Linked || repository.Identity.Bare || repository.Identity.Root != request.Report.Repository.Root ||
404			repository.Identity.CommonDir != request.Report.Repository.CommonDir {
405			return ApplyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("repository identity changed since the report")
406		}
407		selected := make(map[string]bool, len(request.Fingerprints))
408		for _, fingerprint := range request.Fingerprints {
409			selected[fingerprint] = true
410		}
411		result := ApplyResult{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Repository: repository.Identity, Results: []ApplyCandidateResult{}}
412		err = s.backend.withCleanupLock(ctx, repository.Identity.CommonDir, func() error {
413			if s.beforeRevalidate != nil {
414				s.beforeRevalidate()
415			}
416			for _, prior := range request.Report.Candidates {
417				if !selected[prior.Fingerprint] {
418					continue
419				}
420				fresh, err := s.Report(ctx, ReportRequest{
421					RepoPath: request.Report.Repository.Root, StaleDays: request.Report.StaleDays,
422					BaseRef: request.Report.BaseRef, BaseExplicit: request.Report.BaseExplicit,
423					DeleteBranches: request.Report.DeleteBranches,
424				})
425				if err != nil {
426					return fmt.Errorf("recollect cleanup report: %w", err)
427				}
428				current, exists := findCandidate(fresh.Candidates, candidateKey(prior))
429				item := ApplyCandidateResult{Path: prior.Path, Branch: prior.Branch, BranchRetained: prior.Branch != ""}
430				if prior.Classification != Eligible || !exists || current.Classification != Eligible || current.Fingerprint != prior.Fingerprint {
431					item.Status = ApplySkippedChanged
432					item.Detail = "candidate evidence changed after the report; nothing was removed"
433					result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
434					continue
435				}
436				if err := s.backend.removeWorktree(ctx, repository, prior.Path); err != nil {
437					item.Status = ApplyFailed
438					item.Detail = "plain non-force worktree removal was refused"
439					result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
440					continue
441				}
442				item.RemovedWorktree = true
443				if err := s.backend.verifyRemoved(ctx, repository, prior.Path); err != nil {
444					item.Status = ApplyFailed
445					item.Detail = "worktree removal could not be verified; branch was retained"
446					result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
447					continue
448				}
449				if prior.BranchDeletion.Requested {
450					if !prior.BranchDeletion.Safe || !current.BranchDeletion.Safe {
451						item.Status = ApplyPartial
452						item.Detail = "worktree removed; branch retained because deletion proof was unsafe"
453						result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
454						continue
455					}
456					state, stateErr := s.backend.branchState(ctx, repository, prior.BranchDeletion.BaseRef, prior.Branch)
457					if stateErr != nil || state.BaseHead != prior.BranchDeletion.BaseHead || state.BranchTip != prior.BranchDeletion.BranchTip || state.BranchOnly != 0 {
458						item.Status = ApplyPartial
459						item.Detail = "worktree removed; branch or base proof changed, so the branch was retained"
460						result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
461						continue
462					}
463					if err := s.backend.deleteBranch(ctx, repository, prior.Branch); err != nil {
464						item.Status = ApplyPartial
465						item.Detail = "worktree removed; safe branch -d did not complete, so the branch was retained"
466						result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
467						continue
468					}
469					item.DeletedBranch, item.BranchRetained = true, false
470				}
471				item.Status = ApplyRemoved
472				item.Detail = "worktree removed after locked revalidation"
473				result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
474			}
475			return nil
476		})
477		if err != nil {
478			return result, err
479		}
480		return result, nil
481	}

483	func findCandidate(candidates []Candidate, key string) (Candidate, bool) {
484		for _, candidate := range candidates {
485			if candidateKey(candidate) == key {
486				return candidate, true
487			}
488		}
489		return Candidate{}, false
490	}
491	
492	func candidateKey(candidate Candidate) string {
493		return strings.Join([]string{candidate.Provider, candidate.SessionID, candidate.RunID, candidate.AgentID, candidate.Path}, "\x00")
494	}
495	
496	func availabilityDetail(available bool) string {
497		if available {
498			return "available"
499		}
500		return "unavailable"
501	}
502	
503	func diagnostic(source, code, message string) Diagnostic {
504		return Diagnostic{Source: source, Code: code, Message: message}
505	}
506	
507	func mergeEvidenceCapabilities(existing []Capability, states evidenceCapabilities) []Capability {
508		return append(existing,
509			Capability{Name: "task-inventory", Available: states.tasks, Detail: availabilityDetail(states.tasks)},
510			Capability{Name: "artifact-inventory", Available: states.artifacts, Detail: availabilityDetail(states.artifacts)},
511			Capability{Name: "caller-containment", Available: states.caller, Detail: availabilityDetail(states.caller)},
512			Capability{Name: "runtime-inventory", Available: states.runtime, Detail: availabilityDetail(states.runtime)},
513		)
514	}
515	
516	func stableCapabilities(values []Capability) []Capability {
517		byName := make(map[string]Capability)
518		for _, value := range values {
519			if value.Name == "" {
520				continue
521			}
522			current, exists := byName[value.Name]
523			if !exists {
524				byName[value.Name] = value
525				continue
526			}
527			current.Available = current.Available && value.Available
528			if !current.Available {
529				current.Detail = "unavailable"
530			}
531			byName[value.Name] = current
532		}
533		out := make([]Capability, 0, len(byName))
534		for _, value := range byName {
535			out = append(out, value)
536		}
537		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Name < out[j].Name })
538		return out
539	}
540	
541	func stableDiagnostics(values []Diagnostic) []Diagnostic {
542		seen := make(map[string]bool)
543		out := make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(values))
544		for _, value := range values {
545			key := value.Source + "\x00" + value.Code + "\x00" + value.Message
546			if seen[key] {
547				continue
548			}
549			seen[key] = true
550			out = append(out, value)
551		}
552		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
553			if out[i].Source != out[j].Source {
554				return out[i].Source < out[j].Source
555			}
556			if out[i].Code != out[j].Code {
557				return out[i].Code < out[j].Code
558			}
559			return out[i].Message < out[j].Message
560		})
561		return out
562	}

1	// Package ephemeral audits and removes provider-verified, turn-scoped Git
2	// worktrees. Provider metadata is evidence, never authority by itself: mutation
3	// is allowed only after every independent Git, task, artifact, caller, and
4	// runtime proof is freshly re-collected under a repository-scoped lock.
5	package ephemeral
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"time"
10	)
11	
12	const SchemaVersion = 1
13	
14	type Classification string
15	
16	const (
17		Eligible      Classification = "eligible"
18		Blocked       Classification = "blocked"
19		Unknown       Classification = "unknown"
20		NotApplicable Classification = "not-applicable"
21	)
22	
23	// Fact is a three-state boolean. The zero value is unknown so omitted evidence
24	// can never accidentally authorize cleanup.
25	type Fact struct {
26		Known bool `json:"known"`
27		Value bool `json:"value"`
28	}
29	
30	func KnownFact(value bool) Fact { return Fact{Known: true, Value: value} }
31	
32	// RepositoryIdentity is the canonical repository scope of a report.
33	type RepositoryIdentity struct {
34		Root      string `json:"root"`
35		CommonDir string `json:"common_dir"`
36		Name      string `json:"name"`
37		Bare      bool   `json:"bare"`
38	}
39	
40	// Target is one candidate checkout. Hint is discovery-only and is never used
41	// as proof that a provider owns the path.
42	type Target struct {
43		Path              string `json:"path"`
44		Branch            string `json:"branch,omitempty"`
45		RegistryHead      string `json:"registry_head,omitempty"`
46		Main              bool   `json:"main"`
47		Bare              bool   `json:"bare"`
48		Detached          bool   `json:"detached"`
49		Locked            bool   `json:"locked"`
50		LockedReason      string `json:"locked_reason,omitempty"`
51		Prunable          bool   `json:"prunable"`
52		PrunableReason    string `json:"prunable_reason,omitempty"`
53		Registered        bool   `json:"registered"`
54		RegistrationKnown bool   `json:"registration_known"`
55		Hint              bool   `json:"hint"`
56	}
57	
58	// SourceQuery limits provider inspection to one repository and its current Git
59	// candidates. Now is supplied so future timestamps can be rejected
60	// deterministically.
61	type SourceQuery struct {
62		Repository RepositoryIdentity
63		Targets    []Target
64		Now        time.Time
65	}
66	
67	// Claim is the normalized, privacy-preserving evidence for one provider-owned
68	// checkout. It contains identifiers, states, and timestamps only; providers
69	// must never place prompts, scripts, logs, transcript content, or result bodies
70	// here.
71	type Claim struct {
72		Provider          string    `json:"provider"`
73		SessionID         string    `json:"session_id"`
74		RunID             string    `json:"run_id"`
75		AgentID           string    `json:"agent_id"`
76		WorktreePath      string    `json:"worktree_path"`
77		Owned             Fact      `json:"owned"`
78		Unique            Fact      `json:"unique"`
79		Mapping           Fact      `json:"mapping"`
80		WorkflowState     string    `json:"workflow_state"`
81		WorkflowTerminal  Fact      `json:"workflow_terminal"`
82		AgentState        string    `json:"agent_state"`
83		AgentDone         Fact      `json:"agent_done"`
84		JournalStarted    Fact      `json:"journal_started"`
85		JournalResult     Fact      `json:"journal_result"`
86		NotResumed        Fact      `json:"not_resumed"`
87		LastActivity      time.Time `json:"last_activity,omitempty"`
88		LastActivityKnown bool      `json:"last_activity_known"`
89	}

91	// Capability and Diagnostic are stable, bounded report metadata. Diagnostics
92	// identify a class of failure without echoing private provider content.
93	type Capability struct {
94		Name      string `json:"name"`
95		Available bool   `json:"available"`
96		Detail    string `json:"detail,omitempty"`
97	}

99	type Diagnostic struct {
