1	// Package claudeworkflow adapts Claude Workflow's private, unversioned local
2	// metadata into provider-neutral ephemeral-worktree claims. It deliberately
3	// reads only bounded structural fields; prompts, scripts, logs, result bodies,
4	// and transcript content are never decoded.
5	package claudeworkflow
6	
7	import (
8		"bytes"
9		"context"
10		"encoding/json"
11		"errors"
12		"fmt"
13		"io"
14		"io/fs"
15		"os"
16		"path/filepath"
17		"sort"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"time"
21	
22		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/ephemeral"
23		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
24	)
25	
26	const providerName = "claude-workflow"
27	
28	type Limits struct {
29		MaxProjects       int
30		MaxSessions       int
31		MaxWorkflows      int
32		MaxAgents         int
33		MaxJSONBytes      int64
34		MaxJournalBytes   int64
35		MaxJournalRecords int
36	}
37	
38	var DefaultLimits = Limits{
39		MaxProjects: 256, MaxSessions: 2048, MaxWorkflows: 2048, MaxAgents: 8192,
40		MaxJSONBytes: 1 << 20, MaxJournalBytes: 4 << 20, MaxJournalRecords: 16_384,
41	}
42	
43	type Option func(*Adapter)
44	
45	func WithLimits(limits Limits) Option { return func(a *Adapter) { a.limits = limits } }
46	
47	// withAfterRead is a deterministic mutation-race seam kept package-private so
48	// production callers cannot weaken or alter the read protocol.
49	func withAfterRead(hook func(string)) Option { return func(a *Adapter) { a.afterRead = hook } }
50	
51	type Adapter struct {
52		root      string
53		limits    Limits
54		afterRead func(string)
55	}
56	
57	func New(root string, options ...Option) *Adapter {
58		a := &Adapter{root: root, limits: DefaultLimits}
59		for _, option := range options {
60			option(a)
61		}
62		return a
63	}
64	
65	type counts struct {
66		projects  int
67		sessions  int
68		workflows int
69		agents    int
70	}
71	
72	type workflowRecord struct {
73		id           string
74		status       string
75		activity     []time.Time
76		timeKnown    bool
77		mtime        time.Time
78		progressByID map[string]progressRecord
79	}
80	
81	type progressRecord struct {
82		agentID   string
83		isolation string
84		state     string
85		valid     bool
86		activity  []time.Time
87		timeKnown bool
88	}
89	
90	type metaRecord struct {
91		workflowID string
92		runID      string
93		agentID    string
94		path       string
95		spawned    bool
96		isolation  string
97		state      string
98		updatedAt  time.Time
99		timeKnown  bool
100		mtime      time.Time
101	}
102	
103	type journalEvent struct {
104		kind       string
105		workflowID string
106		runID      string
107		agentID    string
108		at         time.Time
109		timeKnown  bool
110	}
111	
112	type scanFailure struct {
113		code string
114	}
115	
116	func (e *scanFailure) Error() string { return e.code }
117	
118	func failure(code string) error { return &scanFailure{code: code} }
119	
120	func (a *Adapter) Collect(ctx context.Context, query ephemeral.SourceQuery) ephemeral.SourceResult {
121		result := ephemeral.SourceResult{Provider: providerName, Complete: true}
122		capability := ephemeral.Capability{Name: "claude-workflow-metadata", Available: true, Detail: "bounded local metadata"}
123		result.Capabilities = []ephemeral.Capability{capability}
124		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
125			return a.failed(result, "canceled")
126		}
127		if err := a.validateLimits(); err != nil {
128			return a.failed(result, "metadata-bound")
129		}
130		rootInfo, err := os.Lstat(a.root)
131		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
132			result.Capabilities[0].Detail = "metadata root absent"
133			return result
134		}
135		if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(a.root, rootInfo, true) {
136			return a.failed(result, "unsafe-metadata")
137		}
138	
139		var used counts
140		projects, err := a.directories(a.root, &used.projects, a.limits.MaxProjects)
141		if err != nil {
142			return a.failed(result, failureCode(err))
143		}
144		for _, project := range projects {
145			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
146				return a.failed(result, "canceled")
147			}
148			projectPath, err := fixedChild(a.root, project)
149			if err != nil {
150				return a.failed(result, "invalid-id")
151			}
152			sessions, err := a.directories(projectPath, &used.sessions, a.limits.MaxSessions)
153			if err != nil {
154				return a.failed(result, failureCode(err))
155			}
156			for _, session := range sessions {
157				claims, scanErr := a.collectSession(ctx, query, projectPath, session, &used)
158				if scanErr != nil {
159					return a.failed(result, failureCode(scanErr))
160				}
161				result.Claims = append(result.Claims, claims...)
162			}
163		}
164	
165		a.rejectDuplicateClaims(&result)
166		sort.Slice(result.Claims, func(i, j int) bool {
167			left, right := result.Claims[i], result.Claims[j]
168			if left.WorktreePath != right.WorktreePath {
169				return left.WorktreePath < right.WorktreePath
170			}
171			if left.RunID != right.RunID {
172				return left.RunID < right.RunID
173			}
174			return left.AgentID < right.AgentID
175		})
176		return result
177	}
178	
179	func (a *Adapter) failed(result ephemeral.SourceResult, code string) ephemeral.SourceResult {
180		result.Complete = false
181		result.Claims = nil
182		result.Capabilities[0].Available = false
183		result.Capabilities[0].Detail = "metadata could not be safely verified"
184		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ephemeral.Diagnostic{
185			Source: providerName, Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
186		})
187		return result
188	}
189	
190	func diagnosticMessage(code string) string {
191		switch code {
192		case "metadata-bound":
193			return "provider metadata exceeded a fixed V1 bound"
194		case "metadata-mutated":
195			return "provider metadata changed while it was inspected"
196		case "unsafe-metadata":
197			return "provider metadata was not a private regular non-link path"
198		case "invalid-workflow":
199			return "workflow metadata has an invalid required field"
200		case "invalid-agent-mapping":
201			return "agent mapping metadata has an invalid required field"
202		case "invalid-journal":
203			return "workflow journal has an invalid required record"
204		case "invalid-worktree-path":
205			return "agent mapping contains an invalid or unrelated worktree path"
206		case "invalid-id":
207			return "provider metadata contains an invalid identifier"
208		case "canceled":
209			return "provider metadata inspection was canceled"
210		default:
211			return "provider metadata could not be safely verified"
212		}
213	}
214	
215	func (a *Adapter) validateLimits() error {
216		values := []int{a.limits.MaxProjects, a.limits.MaxSessions, a.limits.MaxWorkflows, a.limits.MaxAgents, a.limits.MaxJournalRecords}
217		for _, value := range values {
218			if value < 0 {
219				return failure("metadata-bound")
220			}
221		}
222		if a.limits.MaxJSONBytes <= 0 || a.limits.MaxJournalBytes <= 0 {
223			return failure("metadata-bound")
224		}
225		return nil
226	}
227	
228	func (a *Adapter) collectSession(ctx context.Context, query ephemeral.SourceQuery, projectPath, session string, used *counts) ([]ephemeral.Claim, error) {
229		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(session); err != nil {
230			return nil, failure("invalid-id")
231		}
232		sessionPath, err := fixedChild(projectPath, session)
233		if err != nil {
234			return nil, failure("invalid-id")
235		}
236		workflowsPath := filepath.Join(sessionPath, "workflows")
237		if exists, err := safeOptionalDirectory(workflowsPath); err != nil {
238			return nil, err
239		} else if !exists {
240			return nil, nil
241		}
242		entries, err := os.ReadDir(workflowsPath)
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
245		}
246		var claims []ephemeral.Claim
247		for _, entry := range entries {
248			name := entry.Name()
249			if !strings.HasPrefix(name, "wf_") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".json") {
250				continue
251			}
252			used.workflows++
253			if used.workflows > a.limits.MaxWorkflows {
254				return nil, failure("metadata-bound")
255			}
256			runID := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".json")
257			if err := validateID(runID, "wf_"); err != nil {
258				return nil, failure("invalid-id")
259			}
260			workflowPath, err := fixedChild(workflowsPath, name)
261			if err != nil {
262				return nil, failure("invalid-id")
263			}
264			workflow, err := a.readWorkflow(workflowPath, runID)
265			if err != nil {
266				return nil, err
267			}
268			found, err := a.collectWorkflow(ctx, query, sessionPath, session, workflow, used)
269			if err != nil {
270				return nil, err
271			}
272			claims = append(claims, found...)
273		}
274		return claims, nil
275	}
276	
277	func (a *Adapter) collectWorkflow(ctx context.Context, query ephemeral.SourceQuery, sessionPath, session string, workflow workflowRecord, used *counts) ([]ephemeral.Claim, error) {
278		mappingPath := filepath.Join(sessionPath, "subagents", "workflows", workflow.id)
279		if exists, err := safeFixedDirectoryChain(sessionPath, "subagents", "workflows", workflow.id); err != nil {
280			return nil, err
281		} else if !exists {
282			return nil, failure("invalid-agent-mapping")
283		}
284		entries, err := os.ReadDir(mappingPath)
285		if err != nil {
286			return nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
287		}
288		journal, journalMtime, journalTimeKnown, err := a.readJournal(mappingPath, workflow.id)
289		if err != nil {
290			return nil, err
291		}
292		var claims []ephemeral.Claim
293		for _, entry := range entries {
294			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
295				return nil, failure("canceled")
296			}
297			name := entry.Name()
298			if !strings.HasPrefix(name, "agent-") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".meta.json") {
299				continue
300			}
301			used.agents++
302			if used.agents > a.limits.MaxAgents {
303				return nil, failure("metadata-bound")
304			}
305			filenameID := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(name, "agent-"), ".meta.json")
306			if err := validateID(filenameID, ""); err != nil {
307				return nil, failure("invalid-id")
308			}
309			metaPath, err := fixedChild(mappingPath, name)
310			if err != nil {
311				return nil, failure("invalid-id")
312			}
313			meta, mappingEntry, err := a.readMeta(metaPath, workflow.id, filenameID)
314			if err != nil {
315				return nil, err
316			}
317			if !mappingEntry {
318				continue
319			}
320			canonicalPath, err := validateWorktreePath(query, meta.path)
321			if err != nil {
322				return nil, failure("invalid-worktree-path")
323			}
324			progress, progressOK := workflow.progressByID[filenameID]
325			meta.isolation, meta.state = progress.isolation, progress.state
326			mappingOK := filenameID == meta.agentID && workflow.id == meta.workflowID && workflow.id == meta.runID &&
327				meta.spawned && progressOK && progress.valid && meta.isolation == "worktree"
328			started, result, startedAt, resultAt, eventTimesKnown := journalFacts(journal, workflow.id, meta.runID, meta.agentID)
329			resumed, resumeMtime, err := resumeExists(sessionPath, meta.agentID)
330			if err != nil {
331				return nil, err
332			}
333			activity := append([]time.Time(nil), workflow.activity...)
334			activity = append(activity, progress.activity...)
335			activity = append(activity, meta.updatedAt, startedAt, resultAt, workflow.mtime, meta.mtime, journalMtime, resumeMtime)
336			last, timeKnown := lastActivity(query.Now, activity,
337				workflow.timeKnown && progress.timeKnown && meta.timeKnown && journalTimeKnown && eventTimesKnown,
338			)
339			claims = append(claims, ephemeral.Claim{
340				Provider: providerName, SessionID: session, RunID: workflow.id, AgentID: filenameID,
341				WorktreePath: canonicalPath, Owned: ephemeral.KnownFact(true), Unique: ephemeral.KnownFact(true),
342				Mapping: ephemeral.KnownFact(mappingOK), WorkflowState: normalizeWorkflowState(workflow.status),
343				WorkflowTerminal: ephemeral.KnownFact(workflow.status == "completed" || workflow.status == "killed"),
344				AgentState:       normalizeAgentState(meta.state), AgentDone: ephemeral.KnownFact(meta.state == "done"),
345				JournalStarted: ephemeral.KnownFact(started), JournalResult: ephemeral.KnownFact(result),
346				NotResumed: ephemeral.KnownFact(!resumed), LastActivity: last, LastActivityKnown: timeKnown,
347			})
348		}
349		return claims, nil
350	}
351	
352	func (a *Adapter) readWorkflow(path, filenameID string) (workflowRecord, error) {
353		data, info, err := a.readStable(path, a.limits.MaxJSONBytes)
354		if err != nil {
355			return workflowRecord{}, err
356		}
357		object, err := decodeObject(data)
358		if err != nil {
359			return workflowRecord{}, failure("invalid-workflow")
360		}
361		runID, okRun := requiredString(object, "runId")
362		if !okRun || runID != filenameID {
363			return workflowRecord{}, failure("workflow-id-mismatch")
364		}
365		if _, present := object["id"]; present {
366			id, okID := requiredString(object, "id")
367			if !okID || id != filenameID {
368				return workflowRecord{}, failure("workflow-id-mismatch")
369			}
370		}
371		status, okStatus := requiredString(object, "status")
372		if !okStatus {
373			return workflowRecord{}, failure("invalid-workflow-status")
374		}
375		if err := validateID(runID, "wf_"); err != nil {
376			return workflowRecord{}, failure("invalid-id")
377		}
378		activity, timeKnown := timestampFields(object, []string{"timestamp", "updatedAt"}, []string{"startTime"})
379		progressByID, progressActivity, progressTimeKnown, err := decodeProgress(object["workflowProgress"])
380		if err != nil {
381			return workflowRecord{}, err
382		}
383		activity = append(activity, progressActivity...)
384		return workflowRecord{
385			id: runID, status: strings.ToLower(status), activity: activity,
386			timeKnown: timeKnown && progressTimeKnown, mtime: info.ModTime(), progressByID: progressByID,
387		}, nil
388	}
389	
390	func decodeProgress(raw json.RawMessage) (map[string]progressRecord, []time.Time, bool, error) {
391		if len(raw) == 0 {
392			return map[string]progressRecord{}, nil, true, nil
393		}
394		var entries []json.RawMessage
395		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &entries); err != nil {
396			return nil, nil, false, failure("invalid-workflow-progress")
397		}
398		byID := make(map[string]progressRecord, len(entries))
399		var allActivity []time.Time
400		allKnown := true
401		for _, entry := range entries {
402			object, err := decodeObject(entry)
403			if err != nil {
404				allKnown = false
405				continue
406			}
407			agentID, okAgent := requiredString(object, "agentId")
408			if !okAgent || validateID(agentID, "") != nil {
409				allKnown = false
410				continue
411			}
412			isolation, okIsolation := requiredString(object, "isolation")
413			state, okState := requiredString(object, "state")
414			valid := okIsolation && okState
415			if _, duplicate := byID[agentID]; duplicate {
416				return nil, nil, false, failure("duplicate-agent-progress")
417			}
418			queued, queuedKnown := optionalEpochMillis(object, "queuedAt")
419			started, startedKnown := optionalEpochMillis(object, "startedAt")
420			last, lastKnown := optionalEpochMillis(object, "lastProgressAt")
421			known := queuedKnown && startedKnown && lastKnown
422			if !queued.IsZero() && !started.IsZero() && started.Before(queued) {
423				known = false
424			}
425			if !started.IsZero() && !last.IsZero() && last.Before(started) {
426				known = false
427			}
428			activity := nonZeroTimes(queued, started, last)
429			byID[agentID] = progressRecord{
430				agentID: agentID, isolation: strings.ToLower(isolation), state: strings.ToLower(state), valid: valid,
431				activity: activity, timeKnown: known,
432			}
433			allActivity = append(allActivity, activity...)
434			allKnown = allKnown && known
435		}
436		return byID, allActivity, allKnown, nil
437	}
438	
439	func timestampFields(object map[string]json.RawMessage, stringKeys, millisKeys []string) ([]time.Time, bool) {
440		known := true
441		var values []time.Time
442		for _, key := range stringKeys {
443			value, ok := optionalTimestamp(object, key)
444			known = known && ok
445			if !value.IsZero() {
446				values = append(values, value)
447			}
448		}
449		for _, key := range millisKeys {
450			value, ok := optionalEpochMillis(object, key)
451			known = known && ok
452			if !value.IsZero() {
453				values = append(values, value)
454			}
455		}
456		return values, known
457	}
458	
459	func optionalEpochMillis(object map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) (time.Time, bool) {
460		raw, present := object[key]
461		if !present {
462			return time.Time{}, true
463		}
464		var number json.Number
465		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &number); err != nil {
466			return time.Time{}, false
467		}
468		millis, err := strconv.ParseInt(number.String(), 10, 64)
469		if err != nil || millis <= 0 {
470			return time.Time{}, false
471		}
472		return time.UnixMilli(millis).UTC(), true
473	}
474	
475	func nonZeroTimes(values ...time.Time) []time.Time {
476		out := make([]time.Time, 0, len(values))
477		for _, value := range values {
478			if !value.IsZero() {
479				out = append(out, value)
480			}
481		}
482		return out
483	}
484	
485	func (a *Adapter) readMeta(path, pathWorkflowID, filenameAgentID string) (metaRecord, bool, error) {
486		data, info, err := a.readStable(path, a.limits.MaxJSONBytes)
487		if err != nil {
488			return metaRecord{}, false, err
489		}
490		object, err := decodeObject(data)
491		if err != nil {
492			return metaRecord{}, false, failure("invalid-agent-mapping")
493		}
494		_, pathPresent := object["worktreePath"]
495		_, snakePathPresent := object["worktree_path"]
496		_, shortPathPresent := object["worktree"]
497		_, spawnedPresent := object["spawnedWithWorktree"]
498		if !pathPresent && !snakePathPresent && !shortPathPresent && !spawnedPresent {
499			return metaRecord{}, false, nil
500		}
501		workflowID := pathWorkflowID
502		if _, present := object["workflowId"]; present {
503			var ok bool
504			workflowID, ok = requiredString(object, "workflowId")
505			if !ok || workflowID != pathWorkflowID {
506				return metaRecord{}, false, failure("invalid-agent-workflow")
507			}
508		}
509		runID := pathWorkflowID
510		if _, present := object["runId"]; present {
511			var ok bool
512			runID, ok = requiredString(object, "runId")
513			if !ok || runID != pathWorkflowID {
514				return metaRecord{}, false, failure("invalid-agent-run")
515			}
516		}
517		agentID := filenameAgentID
518		if _, present := object["agentId"]; present {
519			var ok bool
520			agentID, ok = requiredString(object, "agentId")
521			if !ok {
522				return metaRecord{}, false, failure("invalid-agent-id")
523			}
524		}
525		worktreePath, okPath := oneString(object, "worktreePath", "worktree_path", "worktree")
526		spawned, okSpawned := requiredBool(object, "spawnedWithWorktree")
527		if !okPath || !okSpawned {
528			return metaRecord{}, false, failure("invalid-agent-mapping")
529		}
530		updated, timeKnown := optionalTimestamp(object, "updatedAt")
531		for _, item := range []struct {
532			value  string
533			prefix string
534		}{{workflowID, "wf_"}, {runID, "wf_"}, {agentID, ""}} {
535			if err := validateID(item.value, item.prefix); err != nil {
536				return metaRecord{}, false, failure("invalid-id")
537			}
538		}
539		return metaRecord{
540			workflowID: workflowID, runID: runID, agentID: agentID, path: worktreePath,
541			spawned: spawned, updatedAt: updated, timeKnown: timeKnown, mtime: info.ModTime(),
542		}, true, nil
543	}
544	
545	func (a *Adapter) readJournal(mappingPath, pathWorkflowID string) ([]journalEvent, time.Time, bool, error) {
546		path := filepath.Join(mappingPath, "journal.jsonl")
547		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
548		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
549			return nil, time.Time{}, true, nil
550		}
551		if err != nil {
552			return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("unsafe-metadata")
553		}
554		data, stableInfo, err := a.readStableWithInfo(path, info, a.limits.MaxJournalBytes)
555		if err != nil {
556			return nil, time.Time{}, false, err
557		}
558		lines := bytes.Split(data, []byte{'\n'})
559		if len(lines) > 0 && len(lines[len(lines)-1]) == 0 {
560			lines = lines[:len(lines)-1]
561		}
562		if len(lines) > a.limits.MaxJournalRecords {
563			return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("metadata-bound")
564		}
565		events := make([]journalEvent, 0, len(lines))
566		for _, line := range lines {
567			if len(bytes.TrimSpace(line)) == 0 {
568				continue
569			}
570			object, err := decodeObject(line)
571			if err != nil {
572				return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal")
573			}
574			kind, ok := oneString(object, "type", "event")
575			if !ok {
576				return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal-kind")
577			}
578			kind = strings.ToLower(kind)
579			if kind != "started" && kind != "result" {
580				continue
581			}
582			workflowID := pathWorkflowID
583			if _, present := object["workflowId"]; present {
584				var okWorkflow bool
585				workflowID, okWorkflow = requiredString(object, "workflowId")
586				if !okWorkflow || workflowID != pathWorkflowID {
587					return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal-workflow")
588				}
589			}
590			runID := pathWorkflowID
591			if _, present := object["runId"]; present {
592				var okRun bool
593				runID, okRun = requiredString(object, "runId")
594				if !okRun || runID != pathWorkflowID {
595					return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal-run")
596				}
597			}
598			agentID, okAgent := requiredString(object, "agentId")
599			if !okAgent {
600				return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal-agent")
601			}
602			at, timeKnown := optionalTimestamp(object, "timestamp")
603			if validateID(workflowID, "wf_") != nil || validateID(runID, "wf_") != nil || validateID(agentID, "") != nil {
604				return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-id")
605			}
606			events = append(events, journalEvent{kind: kind, workflowID: workflowID, runID: runID, agentID: agentID, at: at, timeKnown: timeKnown})
607		}
608		return events, stableInfo.ModTime(), true, nil
609	}
610	
611	func journalFacts(events []journalEvent, workflowID, runID, agentID string) (started, result bool, startedAt, resultAt time.Time, timesKnown bool) {
612		timesKnown = true
613		startedCount, resultCount := 0, 0
614		for _, event := range events {
615			if event.workflowID != workflowID || event.runID != runID || event.agentID != agentID {
616				continue
617			}
618			switch event.kind {
619			case "started":
620				startedCount++
621				startedAt = event.at
622			case "result":
623				resultCount++
624				resultAt = event.at
625			}
626			timesKnown = timesKnown && event.timeKnown
627		}
628		started, result = startedCount == 1, resultCount == 1
629		if startedCount > 1 || resultCount > 1 || (started && result && resultAt.Before(startedAt)) {
630			timesKnown = false
631		}
632		return
633	}

635	func resumeExists(sessionPath, agentID string) (bool, time.Time, error) {
636		if err := validateID(agentID, ""); err != nil {
637			return false, time.Time{}, failure("invalid-id")
638		}
639		path := filepath.Join(sessionPath, "subagents", "agent-"+agentID+".jsonl")
640		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
641		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
642			return false, time.Time{}, nil
643		}
644		if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(path, info, false) {
645			return false, time.Time{}, failure("unsafe-metadata")
646		}
647		return true, info.ModTime(), nil
648	}
649	
650	func lastActivity(now time.Time, values []time.Time, known bool) (time.Time, bool) {
651		var last time.Time
652		for _, value := range values {
653			if value.IsZero() {
654				continue
655			}
656			value = value.UTC()
657			if value.After(now.UTC()) {
658				known = false
659			}
660			if value.After(last) {
661				last = value
662			}
663		}
664		if last.IsZero() {
665			known = false
666		}
667		return last, known
668	}
669	
670	func (a *Adapter) readStable(path string, limit int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
671		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
672		if err != nil {
673			return nil, nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
674		}
675		return a.readStableWithInfo(path, info, limit)
676	}
677	
678	func (a *Adapter) readStableWithInfo(path string, before fs.FileInfo, limit int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
679		if !safeMetadataInfo(path, before, false) {
680			return nil, nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
681		}
682		first, opened, err := readBounded(path, limit)
683		if err != nil {
684			return nil, nil, err
685		}
686		if a.afterRead != nil {
687			a.afterRead(path)
688		}
689		after, err := os.Lstat(path)
690		if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(path, after, false) || !os.SameFile(before, after) ||
691			before.Size() != after.Size() || !before.ModTime().Equal(after.ModTime()) ||
692			!os.SameFile(before, opened) {
693			return nil, nil, failure("metadata-mutated")
694		}
695		second, reopened, err := readBounded(path, limit)
696		if err != nil {
697			return nil, nil, err
698		}
699		if !os.SameFile(before, reopened) || !bytes.Equal(first, second) {
700			return nil, nil, failure("metadata-mutated")
701		}
702		return first, after, nil
703	}
704	
705	func readBounded(path string, limit int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
706		file, err := os.Open(path)
707		if err != nil {
708			return nil, nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
709		}
710		defer file.Close()
711		info, err := file.Stat()
712		if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() > limit {
713			if err == nil && info.Size() > limit {
714				return nil, nil, failure("metadata-bound")
715			}
716			return nil, nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
717		}
718		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, limit+1))
719		if err != nil {
720			return nil, nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
721		}
722		if int64(len(data)) > limit {
723			return nil, nil, failure("metadata-bound")
724		}
725		return data, info, nil
726	}
727	
728	func (a *Adapter) directories(path string, total *int, maximum int) ([]string, error) {
729		entries, err := os.ReadDir(path)
730		if err != nil {
731			return nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
732		}
733		var names []string
734		for _, entry := range entries {
735			if !entry.IsDir() {
736				if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
737					return nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
738				}
739				continue
740			}
741			name := entry.Name()
742			if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(name); err != nil {
743				return nil, failure("invalid-id")
744			}
745			child, err := fixedChild(path, name)
746			if err != nil {
747				return nil, failure("invalid-id")
748			}
749			info, err := os.Lstat(child)
750			if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(child, info, true) {
751				return nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
752			}
753			*total++
754			if *total > maximum {
755				return nil, failure("metadata-bound")
756			}
757			names = append(names, name)
758		}
759		sort.Strings(names)
760		return names, nil
761	}
762	
763	func safeOptionalDirectory(path string) (bool, error) {
764		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
765		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
766			return false, nil
767		}
768		if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(path, info, true) {
769			return false, failure("unsafe-metadata")
770		}
771		return true, nil
772	}
773	
774	func safeFixedDirectoryChain(root string, components ...string) (bool, error) {
775		current := root
776		for _, component := range components {
777			if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
778				return false, failure("invalid-id")
779			}
780			current = filepath.Join(current, component)
781			info, err := os.Lstat(current)
782			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
783				return false, nil
784			}
785			if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(current, info, true) {
786				return false, failure("unsafe-metadata")
787			}
788		}
789		return true, nil
790	}
791	
792	func fixedChild(root, component string) (string, error) {
793		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
794			return "", err
795		}
796		return filepath.Join(root, component), nil
797	}
798	
799	func validateID(id, prefix string) error {
800		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(id); err != nil {
801			return err
802		}
803		if prefix != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(id, prefix) {
804			return fmt.Errorf("id lacks prefix")
805		}
806		for _, r := range id {
807			if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9') || strings.ContainsRune("._-", r) {
808				continue
809			}
810			return fmt.Errorf("id contains unsupported character")
811		}
812		return nil
813	}
814	
815	func validateWorktreePath(query ephemeral.SourceQuery, raw string) (string, error) {
816		if raw == "" || strings.ContainsRune(raw, '\x00') || !filepath.IsAbs(raw) || filepath.Clean(raw) != raw {
817			return "", failure("invalid-worktree-path")
818		}
819		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(raw)
820		if err != nil {
821			return "", failure("invalid-worktree-path")
822		}
823		for _, target := range query.Targets {
824			candidate, candidateErr := pathx.Canonical(target.Path)
825			if candidateErr == nil && candidate == canonical {
826				return canonical, nil
827			}
828		}
829		harnessRoot := filepath.Join(query.Repository.Root, ".claude", "worktrees")
830		inside, err := pathx.IsChild(harnessRoot, canonical)
831		if err != nil || !inside {
832			return "", failure("invalid-worktree-path")
833		}
834		return canonical, nil
835	}
836	
837	func decodeObject(data []byte) (map[string]json.RawMessage, error) {
838		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
839		opening, err := decoder.Token()
840		if err != nil || opening != json.Delim('{') {
841			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode object")
842		}
843		object := make(map[string]json.RawMessage)
844		for decoder.More() {
845			token, err := decoder.Token()
846			if err != nil {
847				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode object key")
848			}
849			key, ok := token.(string)
850			if !ok {
851				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode object key")
852			}
853			if _, duplicate := object[key]; duplicate {
854				return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate JSON field")
855			}
856			var raw json.RawMessage
857			if err := decoder.Decode(&raw); err != nil {
858				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode object value")
859			}
860			object[key] = raw
861		}
862		closing, err := decoder.Token()
863		if err != nil || closing != json.Delim('}') {
864			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode object close")
865		}
866		var extra any
867		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
868			return nil, fmt.Errorf("extra JSON value")
869		}
870		return object, nil
871	}
872	
873	func requiredString(object map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) (string, bool) {
874		raw, ok := object[key]
875		if !ok {
876			return "", false
877		}
878		var value string
879		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &value) != nil || value == "" {
880			return "", false
881		}
882		return value, true
883	}
884	
885	func oneString(object map[string]json.RawMessage, keys ...string) (string, bool) {
886		value := ""
887		found := false
888		for _, key := range keys {
889			if _, present := object[key]; !present {
890				continue
891			}
892			candidate, ok := requiredString(object, key)
893			if !ok || (found && candidate != value) {
894				return "", false
895			}
896			value, found = candidate, true
897		}
898		return value, found
899	}
900	
901	func requiredBool(object map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) (bool, bool) {
902		raw, ok := object[key]
903		if !ok {
904			return false, false
905		}
906		var value bool
907		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &value) != nil {
908			return false, false
909		}
910		return value, true
911	}
912	
913	func requiredTimestamp(object map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) (time.Time, bool) {
914		value, ok := requiredString(object, key)
915		if !ok {
916			return time.Time{}, false
917		}
918		parsed, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, value)
919		if err != nil {
920			return time.Time{}, false
921		}
922		return parsed.UTC(), true
923	}
924	
925	func optionalTimestamp(object map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) (time.Time, bool) {
926		if _, present := object[key]; !present {
927			return time.Time{}, true
928		}
929		return requiredTimestamp(object, key)
930	}
931	
932	func normalizeWorkflowState(value string) string {
933		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)) {
934		case "completed":
935			return "completed"
936		case "killed":
937			return "killed"
938		case "progress", "running", "in_progress", "in-progress", "pending":
939			return "progress"
940		default:
941			return "unknown"
942		}
943	}
944	
945	func normalizeAgentState(value string) string {
946		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)) {
947		case "done":
948			return "done"
949		case "progress", "running", "in_progress", "in-progress", "pending", "working":
950			return "progress"
951		default:
952			return "unknown"
953		}
954	}
955	
956	func (a *Adapter) rejectDuplicateClaims(result *ephemeral.SourceResult) {
957		byPath := make(map[string][]int)
958		for i, claim := range result.Claims {
959			byPath[claim.WorktreePath] = append(byPath[claim.WorktreePath], i)
960		}
961		for _, indices := range byPath {
962			if len(indices) < 2 {
963				continue
964			}
965			for _, index := range indices {
966				result.Claims[index].Unique = ephemeral.KnownFact(false)
967			}
968			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ephemeral.Diagnostic{
969				Source: providerName, Code: "duplicate-worktree-claim", Message: "multiple provider claims name one worktree path",
970			})
971		}
972	}
973	
974	func failureCode(err error) string {
975		var typed *scanFailure
976		if errors.As(err, &typed) {
977			return typed.code
978		}
979		return "unsafe-metadata"
980	}

27		CheckTaskUnclaimed    = "task-unclaimed"
28		CheckArtifactsKnown   = "artifacts-known"
29		CheckArtifactsSafe    = "artifacts-safe"
30		CheckCallerOutside    = "caller-outside"
31		CheckRuntimeKnown     = "runtime-known"
32		CheckRuntimeClear     = "runtime-clear"
33	)

35	// Audit applies pure V1 policy to already-collected facts. Known blockers
36	// outrank unknown observations. A structurally absent/prunable/non-provider
37	// target is report-only and therefore not applicable rather than eligible.
38	func Audit(in AuditInput) AuditResult {
39		checks := []Check{
40			booleanCheck(CheckProviderOwned, in.ProviderOwned, "provider ownership is verified", "candidate is not owned by the provider", "provider ownership was not verified", NotApplicable),
41			booleanCheck(CheckProviderUnique, in.ProviderUnique, "provider claim is unique", "provider claims are duplicated or ambiguous", "provider claim uniqueness is unknown", Blocked),
42			booleanCheck(CheckProviderMapping, in.ProviderMapping, "provider mapping exactly matches", "provider mapping does not match", "provider mapping is unknown", Blocked),
43			v1UnknownCheck(CheckWorkflowTerminal, in.WorkflowTerminal, "workflow is terminal", "workflow is non-terminal or has ambiguous terminal state", "workflow terminal state is unknown"),
44			v1UnknownCheck(CheckAgentDone, in.AgentDone, "agent state is done", "agent state is not done", "agent state is unknown"),
45			v1UnknownCheck(CheckJournalStarted, in.JournalStarted, "matching started record exists", "matching started record is absent", "matching started record is unknown"),
46			v1UnknownCheck(CheckJournalResult, in.JournalResult, "matching result record exists", "matching result record is absent", "matching result record is unknown"),
47			v1UnknownCheck(CheckNotResumed, in.NotResumed, "same-ID resumed transcript is absent", "same-ID resumed transcript exists", "same-ID resume state is unknown"),
48			booleanCheck(CheckProviderInactive, in.ProviderInactive, "provider activity is older than the threshold", "provider activity is newer than the threshold", "provider activity time is unknown", Blocked),
49			booleanCheck(CheckRegistered, in.Registered, "checkout is registered", "provider path is not registered", "worktree registration is unknown", NotApplicable),
50			booleanCheck(CheckPathPresent, in.PathPresent, "checkout path is present", "checkout path is missing", "checkout path presence is unknown", NotApplicable),
51			booleanCheck(CheckLinkedWorktree, in.LinkedWorktree, "checkout is a linked worktree", "checkout is not a linked worktree", "linked-worktree identity is unknown", NotApplicable),
52			booleanCheck(CheckNonMain, in.NonMain, "checkout is not canonical", "canonical checkout removal is not applicable", "canonical-checkout identity is unknown", NotApplicable),
53			booleanCheck(CheckBranchNamed, in.BranchNamed, "worktree has a named branch", "worktree is detached or unnamed", "branch identity is unknown", Blocked),
54			booleanCheck(CheckBranchMatches, in.BranchMatches, "registry and live branch agree", "registry and live branch differ", "live branch agreement is unknown", Blocked),
55			booleanCheck(CheckCommonDir, in.CommonDirMatches, "checkout common-dir matches the repository", "checkout belongs to another common-dir", "checkout common-dir is unknown", Blocked),
56			booleanCheck(CheckHeadMatches, in.HeadMatches, "registry and live HEAD agree", "registry and live HEAD differ", "live HEAD agreement is unknown", Blocked),
57			booleanCheck(CheckUnlocked, in.Unlocked, "worktree is unlocked", "worktree is locked", "worktree lock state is unknown", Blocked),
58			booleanCheck(CheckNotPrunable, in.NotPrunable, "worktree registration is not prunable", "worktree registration is prunable", "prunable state is unknown", NotApplicable),
59			booleanCheck(CheckClean, in.Clean, "checkout has no staged, unstaged, conflicted, or untracked paths", "checkout has staged, unstaged, conflicted, or untracked paths", "checkout cleanliness is unknown", Blocked),
60			booleanCheck(CheckIgnoredEmpty, in.IgnoredEmpty, "checkout has no ignored files", "checkout contains ignored files", "ignored-file inventory is unknown", Blocked),
61			booleanCheck(CheckSubmodulesClean, in.SubmodulesClean, "submodule state is clean", "submodule state is dirty or conflicted", "submodule state is unknown", Blocked),
62			booleanCheck(CheckNoGitOperation, in.NoGitOperation, "no Git operation is in progress", "a Git operation is in progress", "Git operation state is unknown", Blocked),
63			booleanCheck(CheckTaskUnclaimed, in.TaskUnclaimed, "no task claims the checkout or branch", "a persisted task claims the checkout or branch", "task claims are unknown", Blocked),
64			knownCheck(CheckArtifactsKnown, in.ArtifactsKnown, "artifact inventory is known", "artifact inventory is unknown"),
65			booleanCheck(CheckArtifactsSafe, in.ArtifactsSafe, "all artifact intents are discarded or finalized and reachable", "an artifact intent is not discarded or finalized and reachable", "artifact safety is unknown", Blocked),
66			booleanCheck(CheckCallerOutside, in.CallerOutside, "caller is outside the target", "caller is inside the target", "caller containment is unknown", Blocked),
67			knownCheck(CheckRuntimeKnown, in.RuntimeKnown, "every available runtime was inventoried", "runtime inventory is unknown"),
68			booleanCheck(CheckRuntimeClear, in.RuntimeClear, "no runtime session covers the target", "a runtime session covers the target", "runtime coverage is unknown", Blocked),
69		}
70	
71		// Explicit report-only structural outcomes dominate ordinary eligibility but
72		// never turn unknown provider evidence into not-applicable.
73		for _, id := range []string{CheckProviderOwned, CheckRegistered, CheckPathPresent, CheckLinkedWorktree, CheckNonMain, CheckNotPrunable} {
74			if status(checks, id) == NotApplicable {
75				return AuditResult{Classification: NotApplicable, Checks: checks}
76			}
77		}
78		return AuditResult{Classification: aggregate(checks), Checks: checks}
79	}
80	
81	func booleanCheck(id string, fact Fact, yes, no, unknown string, falseClass Classification) Check {
82		if !fact.Known {
83			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
84		}
85		if fact.Value {
86			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
87		}
88		return Check{ID: id, Classification: falseClass, Detail: no}
89	}
90	
91	func knownCheck(id string, fact Fact, yes, unknown string) Check {
92		if !fact.Known {
93			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
94		}
95		if !fact.Value {
96			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
97		}
98		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
99	}
100	
101	// V1 refuses to distinguish a known absent liveness record from uncertainty:
102	// both require stronger upstream evidence and have no attestation bypass.
103	func v1UnknownCheck(id string, fact Fact, yes, no, unknown string) Check {
104		if !fact.Known {
105			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
106		}
107		if !fact.Value {
108			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: no}
109		}
110		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
111	}
112	
113	func aggregate(checks []Check) Classification {
114		result := Eligible
115		for _, check := range checks {
116			switch check.Classification {
117			case Blocked:
118				return Blocked
119			case Unknown:
120				result = Unknown
121			}
122		}
123		return result
124	}
125	
126	func status(checks []Check, id string) Classification {
127		for _, check := range checks {
128			if check.ID == id {
129				return check.Classification
130			}
131		}
132		return Unknown
133	}
134

40	func (b *systemBackend) discover(ctx context.Context, path string) (repositoryState, error) {

56		}, nil
57	}

81	func (b *systemBackend) gitFacts(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, target Target) (GitFacts, error) {
82		facts := structuralGitFacts(target, target.RegistrationKnown)
83		facts.NonMain = KnownFact(!target.Main)
84		if target.RegistrationKnown {
85			facts.Registered = KnownFact(target.Registered)
86			facts.LinkedWorktree = KnownFact(target.Registered && !target.Main && !target.Bare)
87			facts.BranchNamed = KnownFact(target.Branch != "" && !target.Detached)
88			facts.Unlocked = KnownFact(!target.Locked)
89			facts.NotPrunable = KnownFact(!target.Prunable)
90		}
91	
92		info, err := os.Lstat(target.Path)
93		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
94			facts.PathPresent = KnownFact(false)
95			return facts, nil
96		}
97		if err != nil {
98			return facts, err
99		}
100		facts.PathPresent = KnownFact(info.IsDir() && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0)
101		if !facts.PathPresent.Value {
102			return facts, fmt.Errorf("checkout path is not a regular directory")
103		}
104		checkoutRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, target.Path)

107		}
108		checkoutCommon, err := pathx.Canonical(checkoutRepo.GitCommonDir)
109		if err != nil {
110			return facts, err
111		}
112		facts.CommonDir = checkoutCommon
113		facts.CommonDirMatches = KnownFact(checkoutCommon == repository.Identity.CommonDir)
114		liveHead, err := gitx.Run(ctx, target.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
115		if err != nil {

117		}
118		facts.LiveHead = liveHead

120		inspection, err := gitx.InspectEphemeralCheckout(ctx, target.Path)
121		if err != nil {
122			return facts, err
123		}
124		facts.Staged, facts.Unstaged = inspection.Status.Staged, inspection.Status.Unstaged
125		facts.Conflicted, facts.Untracked = inspection.Status.Conflicted, inspection.Status.Untracked
126		facts.Ignored, facts.DirtySubmodules = inspection.Ignored, inspection.DirtySubmodules
127		facts.BranchMatches = KnownFact(inspection.Status.Branch == target.Branch && !inspection.Status.Detached)
128		facts.Clean = KnownFact(!inspection.Status.Dirty())
129		facts.IgnoredEmpty = KnownFact(inspection.Ignored == 0)
130		facts.SubmodulesClean = KnownFact(inspection.DirtySubmodules == 0)
131		facts.StateFingerprint = inspection.Fingerprint
132		operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(target.Path)
133		if err != nil {

135		}
136		facts.NoGitOperation = KnownFact(!active)
137		if active {

139		}

144		if b.tasks == nil {
145			return taskEvidence{}, fmt.Errorf("task store unavailable")

172	func strictTaskList(store *task.Store) ([]*task.Task, error) {
173		entries, err := os.ReadDir(store.Dir)
174		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
175			return nil, nil
176		}
177		if err != nil {
178			return nil, err
179		}

184				continue
185			}
186			info, err := entry.Info()
187			if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
188				return nil, fmt.Errorf("task inventory contains an unsafe task entry")
189			}
190			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
191			current, err := store.Get(id)

193				return nil, err
194			}
195			if err := current.Validate(); err != nil {
196				return nil, err
197			}
198			tasks = append(tasks, current)
199		}
200		return tasks, nil
201	}
202	
203	func (b *systemBackend) artifactEvidence(ctx context.Context, target Target) (artifactEvidence, error) {
204		if b.artifacts == nil {
205			return artifactEvidence{}, fmt.Errorf("artifact store unavailable")
206		}
207		inspections, err := artifact.InspectWorktrees(ctx, b.artifacts)
208		if err != nil {
209			return artifactEvidence{}, err
210		}
211		inspection, exists := inspections[target.Path]
212		if !exists {
213			return artifactEvidence{Known: KnownFact(true), Safe: KnownFact(true), Fingerprint: digest("no-artifacts")}, nil
214		}
215		return artifactEvidence{
216			Known: KnownFact(true), Safe: KnownFact(inspection.Ready), Intents: inspection.IntentCount,
217			Fingerprint: digest(inspection),
218		}, nil
219	}
220	
221	func (b *systemBackend) callerEvidence(target Target) (callerEvidence, error) {
222		cwd, err := b.cwd()
223		if err != nil {
224			return callerEvidence{}, err
225		}
226		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(cwd)
227		if err != nil {
228			return callerEvidence{}, err
229		}
230		inside, err := pathx.Contains(target.Path, canonical)
231		if err != nil {
232			return callerEvidence{}, err
233		}
234		return callerEvidence{Outside: KnownFact(!inside), Fingerprint: digest(canonical)}, nil
235	}
236	
237	func (b *systemBackend) runtimeEvidence(ctx context.Context, target Target) (runtimeEvidence, error) {
238		if b.runtimeDisabled {
239			return runtimeEvidence{}, fmt.Errorf("runtime inventory disabled")
240		}
241		type coveringSession struct {
242			Runtime string
243			Handle  string
244			Paths   []string
245		}
246		seenRuntimes := make(map[string]bool)
247		var covering []coveringSession
248		for _, rt := range b.runtimes {
249			if rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" || seenRuntimes[rt.Name()] {
250				continue
251			}
252			seenRuntimes[rt.Name()] = true
253			if !rt.Available() {
254				continue
255			}
256			sessions, err := rt.List(ctx)
257			if err != nil {
258				return runtimeEvidence{}, err
259			}
260			for _, session := range sessions {
261				paths := sessionPaths(session)
262				covers := false
263				for _, path := range paths {
264					inside, err := pathx.Contains(target.Path, path)
265					if err != nil {
266						return runtimeEvidence{}, err
267					}
268					if inside {
269						covers = true
270					}
271				}
272				if covers {
273					sort.Strings(paths)
274					covering = append(covering, coveringSession{Runtime: rt.Name(), Handle: session.Handle, Paths: paths})
275				}
276			}
277		}
278		sort.Slice(covering, func(i, j int) bool {
279			if covering[i].Runtime != covering[j].Runtime {
280				return covering[i].Runtime < covering[j].Runtime
281			}
282			return covering[i].Handle < covering[j].Handle
283		})
284		return runtimeEvidence{
285			Known: KnownFact(true), Clear: KnownFact(len(covering) == 0), Covering: len(covering), Fingerprint: digest(covering),
286		}, nil
287	}
288	
289	func sessionPaths(session runtime.Session) []string {
290		set := make(map[string]bool)
291		for _, path := range session.Dirs {
292			if path != "" {
293				set[path] = true
294			}
295		}
296		for _, pane := range session.Panes {
297			for _, path := range []string{pane.CWD, pane.ShellCWD} {
298				if path != "" {
299					set[path] = true
300				}
301			}
302		}
303		paths := make([]string, 0, len(set))
304		for path := range set {
305			paths = append(paths, path)
306		}
307		return paths
308	}
309	
310	func (b *systemBackend) branchState(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, base, branch string) (branchState, error) {
311		baseHead, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Identity.Root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--end-of-options", base+"^{commit}")
312		if err != nil {
313			return branchState{}, err
314		}
315		branchTip, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Identity.Root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--end-of-options", "refs/heads/"+branch+"^{commit}")
316		if err != nil {
317			return branchState{}, err
318		}
319		relation, err := gitx.CompareBranches(ctx, repository.Identity.Root, baseHead, branchTip)
320		if err != nil {
321			return branchState{}, err
322		}
323		return branchState{BaseHead: baseHead, BranchTip: branchTip, BaseOnly: relation.BaseOnly, BranchOnly: relation.BranchOnly}, nil
324	}
325	
326	func (b *systemBackend) withCleanupLock(ctx context.Context, commonDir string, operation func() error) error {
327		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, filepath.Join(commonDir, "dev-ephemeral-cleanup-v1"), "ephemeral worktree cleanup", operation)
328	}
329	
330	func (b *systemBackend) removeWorktree(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, path string) error {
331		return gitx.RemoveWorktree(ctx, repository.Identity.Root, path, false)
332	}
333	
334	func (b *systemBackend) verifyRemoved(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, path string) error {
335		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
336			return fmt.Errorf("checkout path still exists")
337		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
338			return err
339		}
340		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, repository.Identity.Root)
341		if err != nil {
342			return err
343		}
344		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
345			candidate, err := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
346			if err != nil {
347				return err
348			}
349			if candidate == path {
350				return fmt.Errorf("worktree registration still exists")
351			}
352		}
353		return nil
354	}
355	
356	func (b *systemBackend) deleteBranch(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, branch string) error {
357		_, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Identity.Root, "branch", "-d", "--", branch)
358		return err
359	}
360	
361	func digest(value any) string {
362		encoded, err := json.Marshal(value)
363		if err != nil {
364			return ""
365		}
366		sum := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
367		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
368	}
369

```text
1	---
2	description: Retire an integrated dev-cli worktree and runtime safely, from outside the workspace being removed.
3	authority: project
4	status: stable
5	verified_on: 2026-09-03
6	---
7	
8	# Agent-safe retirement
9	
10	A `dev` change stream reaches full retirement only after an external caller closes its runtime and removes its worktree — a feature agent must never destroy the checkout or runtime containing its own process.
11	
12	## Three milestones, not one
13	
14	Completion is three separate milestones, and the persisted task state `done` now means the middle one, not the last:
15	
16	```text
17	READY     exact final transcript committed after the writer exits
18	MERGED    branch integrated; runtime/worktree may still exist
19	RETIRED   runtime absent, worktree removed, optional branch deleted, task reaped
20	```
21	
22	`hot`, `warm`, `cold`, and `done` remain the only persisted task states — `done` means MERGED, with cleanup possibly still pending. It does **not** mean the runtime or worktree has already been deleted.
23	
24	## Commands
25	
26	| Command | What it does |
27	|---|---|
28	| `dev prepare --session <provider:uuid> --plan <path>` | Arms post-writer artifact finalization without closing the running agent. Product changes must already be committed; the transcript itself is deliberately not staged yet. |
29	| `dev artifact finalize --run-id "$DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID" --if-pending --writer-stopped` | Commits the one exact, stable transcript after its writer has stopped. `--if-pending` no-ops silently when no armed intent matches the run id; `--writer-stopped` confirms the outer wrapper has returned. |
30	| `dev done --ff` | Rebases the task branch onto its base and fast-forwards it locally. Records MERGED; never closes the runtime, removes a worktree, or deletes a branch. |
31	| `dev done --pr` | Pushes the branch and opens a pull/merge request through an available forge CLI. The task stays under review, not MERGED. |
32	| `dev done --merged --base-ref <ref>` | Verifies an externally merged branch is contained in `<ref>` and records MERGED. |
33	| `dev done --merged --base-ref <ref> --confirm-squash <merge-commit>` | Same, but for a squash merge: attests that the named commit, already proven contained in `<ref>`, represents the feature branch. This is an operator assertion dev cannot verify on its own. |
34	| `dev artifact discard <intent> --yes` | Records that an intent can never be finalized — its transcript was never written, or its HEAD is gone after a rebase — so it stops blocking integration and retirement. It commits and recovers nothing, prints exactly what is being abandoned, and refuses an intent that is still `armed`, because finalization is the path that preserves a transcript. |
35	| `dev retire [task-or-worktree] [--close-unknown] [--assume-no-runtime] [--delete-branch] [--timeout <duration>]` | Re-resolves every covering runtime session, refuses active agents and mixed-purpose workspaces, waits for closure, revalidates Git state, and only then removes the linked worktree without force. Deletes the task record only after every requested step succeeds. |
36	| `dev sweep --merged-worktrees [--base <ref>] [--apply] [--yes] [--close-unknown] [--assume-no-runtime] [--delete-branches]` | From the canonical checkout, reports (and, with `--apply`, retires) both task-tracked and unmanaged linked worktrees whose branches are already contained in the base. |
37	| `dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees [--stale-days <n>] [--json]` | From a canonical non-bare checkout, emits a strict Claude Workflow V1 report; JSON schema 1 is report-only. |
38	| `dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --apply [--delete-branches --base <ref>]` | Requires a TTY and per-item confirmation, then revalidates each approved fingerprint under the common-dir cleanup lock before plain non-force removal. |
39	
40	A dirty checkout does not fail here: `dev done` classifies it against the base
41	first, offering commit or discard interactively, or taking an explicit
42	`--dirty` policy from a script. See
43	[Change-stream workflow](change-stream-workflow.md) for that wizard. The
44	`--keep-worktree` and `--delete-branch` flags remain accepted on `dev done`
45	only to fail loudly and point at `dev retire`.
46	
47	For a read-only explanation before acting, render or open the generic
48	`workspace-closeout` recipe from the exact checkout:
49	
50	```bash
51	dev prompt render workspace-closeout .
52	dev prompt open workspace-closeout . --agent my-agent
53	```
54	
55	The recipe includes the full retirement audit, but its result is advisory.
56	`eligible` and a merged PR never authorize cleanup; an external `dev retire`
57	still recollects and revalidates every gate. If `dev done --ff` or
58	`dev git pull-rebase` stops at a conflict, use `prompt open` only to discuss the
59	semantic resolution, then explicitly continue/abort Git and rerun the lifecycle
60	command. See [Prompt handoffs](prompt-handoffs.md).
61	
62	## Normal local flow
63	
64	From the feature worktree:
65	
66	```bash
67	# Commit product changes first. Do not stage the moving transcript.
68	dev prepare --session claude:<uuid> --plan .claude/plans/task.md
69	# Exit the agent normally so SpecStory can write its final Markdown.
70	```
71	
72	The outer `specstory run` wrapper then calls:
73	
74	```bash
75	dev artifact finalize --run-id "$DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID" --if-pending --writer-stopped
76	```
77	
78	An external main/integration workspace finishes the job:
79	
80	```bash
81	dev done <task> --ff
82	dev retire <task> --delete-branch
83	```
84	
85	`dev done` only integrates and records MERGED. `dev retire` re-resolves every runtime pane, closes eligible sessions, waits for them to disappear, revalidates Git, and removes the worktree without force.
86	
87	## Pull-request flow
88	
89	```bash
90	dev done <task> --pr
91	# after CI/review and a commit-preserving merge
92	git fetch origin
93	dev done <task> --merged --base-ref origin/main
94	dev retire <task> --delete-branch
95	```
96	
97	A squash merge is not ancestry-equivalent, so it needs an explicit operator attestation:
98	
99	```bash
100	dev done <task> --merged --base-ref origin/main --confirm-squash <merge-commit>
101	```
102	
103	This proves only that the named squash commit is contained in the base; the operator is asserting that it actually represents the feature branch.
104	
105	## Refusal conditions
106	
107	`retire.Inspect` refuses to proceed whenever any of the following hold, and it re-checks after closing sessions rather than trusting a stale view:
108	
109	- the caller's current directory is the target checkout or below it;
110	- the caller's `HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID`, `HERDR_PANE_ID`, or `TMUX_PANE` identifies a runtime session that covers the target;
111	- a covering runtime workspace also contains panes outside the target (mixed-purpose workspace);
112	- any covering agent status is `working`, `running`, `busy`, `blocked`, or `waiting` — **never overridable, by any flag**;
113	- agent status is empty or `unknown`, **unless** the caller passes `--close-unknown` from outside the target;
114	- agent status is unrecognized (anything outside the known set) — always blocks;
115	- runtime enumeration itself fails, **unless** the caller passes `--assume-no-runtime`.
116	
117	`--close-unknown` and `--assume-no-runtime` only relax fail-closed *observations* (an unreadable status, a runtime list that could not be enumerated). Neither flag ever bypasses caller containment or an active-agent state. `retirement.Service.Retire` also revalidates the target's identity, Git ancestry, in-progress Git operations (`gitx.InProgress`, checking `MERGE_HEAD`, `CHERRY_PICK_HEAD`, `REVERT_HEAD`, `BISECT_LOG`, `rebase-merge`, `rebase-apply`, `sequencer` — not `REBASE_HEAD`, which Git leaves behind after a rebase completes), and worktree cleanliness after runtime sessions close — reality may have changed while a runtime was draining, so no earlier proof carries across that boundary.
118	
119	## Periodic cleanup with sweep
120	
121	```bash
122	dev sweep --merged-worktrees
123	# Present the exact candidates/blockers to the user and ask for approval.
124	dev sweep --merged-worktrees --apply --yes
125	```
126	
127	This surfaces both task-tracked DONE worktrees and unmanaged linked worktrees whose named branches are already contained in the base — run it from the canonical checkout. It reports before applying: containment alone is never permission. Dirty Git state, a pending or unreachable artifact, a locked or prunable worktree registration, an in-progress Git operation, and the same runtime refusal conditions as `dev retire` all still block cleanup. Branches remain after retirement by default; pass `--delete-branches` only when the user separately approved deleting them.
128	
129	### Verified Claude Workflow ephemeral cleanup
130	
131	Claude Workflow turn-scoped worktrees have a separate strict V1 path:
132	
133	```bash
134	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --stale-days 14
135	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --json
136	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --apply
137	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --apply --delete-branches --base main
138	```
139	
140	The command runs only from a canonical non-bare checkout. Its bounded,
141	fixed-depth adapter reads private metadata under `~/.claude/projects`, verifies
142	validated workflow/agent IDs, exact canonical worktree mapping,
143	`spawnedWithWorktree`, `isolation=worktree`, and matching journal linkage, but
144	never decodes or emits prompts, scripts, logs, result bodies, or transcript
145	content. Unknown add-only fields are tolerated; wrong required types, path
146	mismatch, duplicate claims, unsafe/symlink/reparse/group-or-world-writable
147	metadata, source mutation, bound exhaustion, and future/conflicting/unparseable
148	time fail closed.
149	
150	V1 terminal liveness requires workflow `completed|killed`, matching agent `done`,
151	one journal `started` and `result`, and no same-ID resumed transcript. A killed
152	workflow with no result, progress, or a resume is `unknown` regardless of age;
153	there is no attestation bypass. `--stale-days` measures provider inactivity,
154	defaults to 14, and has a minimum of 1.
155	
156	The independent safety audit also requires a present, registered, non-main,
157	named, unlocked, non-prunable linked worktree with exact common-dir, live branch,
158	registry HEAD, and live HEAD agreement. Staged, unstaged, conflicted, untracked,
159	ignored, or recursively inspected submodule content blocks cleanup, as do Git
160	operations, task claims, unsafe artifact intents, caller containment, unknown
161	runtime inventory, or any covering runtime. Missing, prunable, unregistered, and
162	orphan paths remain report only.
163	
164	JSON schema 1 contains only normalized identity/state/time, Git/path/branch/HEAD
165	facts, checks, actions, diagnostics, fingerprints, and counts. It is report-only.
166	Apply rejects `--yes`, `--close-unknown`, `--assume-no-runtime`, `--no-runtime`,
167	and JSON; it requires a terminal and confirms each item. Under a common-dir
168	cleanup lock it rediscovers the repository and recollects provider, Git, task,
169	artifact, runtime, and caller proof immediately before each removal. A changed
170	fingerprint is `skipped-changed`.
171	
172	Removal uses plain `git worktree remove` without force and verifies both path and
173	registration are gone. It never closes sessions, prunes, deletes Claude metadata,
174	or rescues/stashes/commits dirty work. The named branch survives by default, so
175	unique commits remain recoverable. Optional deletion separately requires
176	`--delete-branches --base <ref>`, unchanged base/branch tips, containment, zero
177	unique commits, and ordinary `git branch -d`; any failure after removal keeps the
178	branch and reports partial completion.
179	
180	## Safety boundaries
181	
182	Raw `git worktree remove --force` bypasses dev entirely — never run it from an agent that occupies the target. dev's guarantee is only that no dev-mediated path performs a forced removal; it cannot stop an operator or script from calling Git directly.
183	
184	A real Codex session once deleted its own registered worktree and branch from another checkout. Herdr kept the workspace and terminal alive because a Unix process can hold an open cwd inode after the path is unlinked, and SpecStory then recreated the same path containing only `.specstory/` content. The shell looked alive but was no longer a Git checkout:
185	
186	```text
187	failed to reload config: No such file or directory
188	fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git
189	```
190	
191	Treat `runtime alive + Git registration absent + artifact-only path` as an orphan that needs transcript salvage and external reconciliation — **never** as RETIRED.
192	
193	`dev sweep` now recognises that shape rather than leaving it to be spotted by eye. When a task records a checkout that exists but Git does not register, and the directory holds nothing but agent artifact folders, sweep reports it as an abandoned agent workspace. It offers to remove it only when every file inside is byte-identical to one the repository already has; anything that differs is listed as salvage work and left untouched, including by `--apply`.
194	
195	Byte equality rather than mere presence is the point. A transcript writer that outlives its worktree usually flushes a longer final version than the copy committed earlier, so a same-named file in the repository is not evidence that the tail was saved.
196
