81	func booleanCheck(id string, fact Fact, yes, no, unknown string, falseClass Classification) Check {
82		if !fact.Known {
83			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
84		}
85		if fact.Value {
86			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
87		}
88		return Check{ID: id, Classification: falseClass, Detail: no}
89	}
90	
91	func knownCheck(id string, fact Fact, yes, unknown string) Check {
92		if !fact.Known {
93			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
94		}
95		if !fact.Value {
96			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
97		}
98		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
99	}
100	
101	// V1 refuses to distinguish a known absent liveness record from uncertainty:
102	// both require stronger upstream evidence and have no attestation bypass.
103	func v1UnknownCheck(id string, fact Fact, yes, no, unknown string) Check {
104		if !fact.Known {
105			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
106		}
107		if !fact.Value {
108			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: no}
109		}
110		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
111	}
112	
113	func aggregate(checks []Check) Classification {
114		result := Eligible
115		for _, check := range checks {
116			switch check.Classification {
117			case Blocked:
118				return Blocked
119			case Unknown:
120				result = Unknown
121			}
122		}
123		return result
124	}
125	
126	func status(checks []Check, id string) Classification {
127		for _, check := range checks {
128			if check.ID == id {
129				return check.Classification
130			}
131		}
132		return Unknown
133	}

206	func (s *Service) collectCandidate(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, target Target, claim *Claim,
207		sourceComplete, worktreesKnown bool, request ReportRequest, now time.Time) (Candidate, []Diagnostic, evidenceCapabilities) {

209		candidate := Candidate{Path: target.Path, Branch: target.Branch, RegistryHead: target.RegistryHead}

215		if claim != nil {
216			candidate.Provider, candidate.SessionID, candidate.RunID, candidate.AgentID = claim.Provider, claim.SessionID, claim.RunID, claim.AgentID
217			candidate.WorkflowState, candidate.AgentState = claim.WorkflowState, claim.AgentState
218			candidate.LastActivity, candidate.LastActivityKnown = claim.LastActivity, claim.LastActivityKnown
219			providerOwned, providerUnique, providerMapping = claim.Owned, claim.Unique, claim.Mapping
220			workflowTerminal, agentDone = claim.WorkflowTerminal, claim.AgentDone
221			journalStarted, journalResult, notResumed = claim.JournalStarted, claim.JournalResult, claim.NotResumed
222			if claim.LastActivityKnown {
223				threshold := now.Add(-time.Duration(request.StaleDays) * 24 * time.Hour)
224				inactive = KnownFact(!claim.LastActivity.After(threshold))
225			}
226		} else if sourceComplete {
227			providerOwned = KnownFact(false)
228		}
229	
230		gitFacts, err := s.backend.gitFacts(ctx, repository, target)
231		if err != nil {
232			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("git", "checkout-inspection-failed", "checkout Git facts could not be verified"))
233			gitFacts = mergeStructuralGitFacts(gitFacts, target, worktreesKnown)
234		}
235		candidate.Git = gitFacts
236	
237		tasks, err := s.backend.taskEvidence(ctx, repository, target)
238		if err != nil {
239			states.tasks = false
240			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("task", "task-inventory-failed", "task claims could not be verified"))
241		}
242		artifacts, err := s.backend.artifactEvidence(ctx, target)
243		if err != nil {
244			states.artifacts = false
245			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("artifact", "artifact-inventory-failed", "artifact intents could not be verified"))
246		}
247		caller, err := s.backend.callerEvidence(target)
248		if err != nil {
249			states.caller = false
250			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("caller", "caller-containment-failed", "caller containment could not be verified"))
251		}
252		runtimeFacts, err := s.backend.runtimeEvidence(ctx, target)
253		if err != nil {
254			states.runtime = false
255			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("runtime", "runtime-inventory-failed", "runtime coverage could not be verified"))
256		}
257		candidate.Safety = SafetyFacts{
258			TaskUnclaimed: tasks.Unclaimed, TaskClaims: tasks.Claims, TaskFingerprint: tasks.Fingerprint,
259			ArtifactsKnown: artifacts.Known, ArtifactsSafe: artifacts.Safe, ArtifactIntents: artifacts.Intents, ArtifactFingerprint: artifacts.Fingerprint,
260			CallerOutside: caller.Outside, CallerFingerprint: caller.Fingerprint,
261			RuntimeKnown: runtimeFacts.Known, RuntimeClear: runtimeFacts.Clear,
262			CoveringSessions: runtimeFacts.Covering, RuntimeFingerprint: runtimeFacts.Fingerprint,
263		}
264	
265		audit := Audit(AuditInput{
266			ProviderOwned: providerOwned, ProviderUnique: providerUnique, ProviderMapping: providerMapping,
267			WorkflowState: candidate.WorkflowState, WorkflowTerminal: workflowTerminal,
268			AgentState: candidate.AgentState, AgentDone: agentDone,
269			JournalStarted: journalStarted, JournalResult: journalResult, NotResumed: notResumed, ProviderInactive: inactive,
270			Registered: gitFacts.Registered, PathPresent: gitFacts.PathPresent, LinkedWorktree: gitFacts.LinkedWorktree,
271			NonMain: gitFacts.NonMain, BranchNamed: gitFacts.BranchNamed, BranchMatches: gitFacts.BranchMatches,
272			CommonDirMatches: gitFacts.CommonDirMatches,
273			HeadMatches:      gitFacts.HeadMatches, Unlocked: gitFacts.Unlocked, NotPrunable: gitFacts.NotPrunable,
274			Clean: gitFacts.Clean, IgnoredEmpty: gitFacts.IgnoredEmpty, SubmodulesClean: gitFacts.SubmodulesClean,
275			NoGitOperation: gitFacts.NoGitOperation, TaskUnclaimed: tasks.Unclaimed,
276			ArtifactsKnown: artifacts.Known, ArtifactsSafe: artifacts.Safe, CallerOutside: caller.Outside,
277			RuntimeKnown: runtimeFacts.Known, RuntimeClear: runtimeFacts.Clear,
278		})
279		candidate.Classification, candidate.Checks = audit.Classification, audit.Checks
280		candidate.BranchDeletion = s.auditBranchDeletion(ctx, repository, target, request)
281		candidate.PlannedActions = plannedActions(candidate)
282		candidate.Fingerprint = candidateFingerprint(candidate)
283		return candidate, diagnostics, states
284	}

286	func structuralGitFacts(target Target, worktreesKnown bool) GitFacts {
287		facts := GitFacts{NonMain: KnownFact(!target.Main)}
288		if worktreesKnown && target.RegistrationKnown {
289			facts.Registered = KnownFact(target.Registered)
290			facts.LinkedWorktree = KnownFact(target.Registered && !target.Main && !target.Bare)
291			facts.BranchNamed = KnownFact(target.Branch != "" && !target.Detached)
292			facts.Unlocked = KnownFact(!target.Locked)
293			facts.NotPrunable = KnownFact(!target.Prunable)
294		}
295		return facts
296	}
297	
298	func mergeStructuralGitFacts(facts GitFacts, target Target, worktreesKnown bool) GitFacts {
299		fallback := structuralGitFacts(target, worktreesKnown)
300		for current, replacement := range map[*Fact]Fact{
301			&facts.Registered: fallback.Registered, &facts.LinkedWorktree: fallback.LinkedWorktree,
302			&facts.NonMain: fallback.NonMain, &facts.BranchNamed: fallback.BranchNamed,
303			&facts.Unlocked: fallback.Unlocked, &facts.NotPrunable: fallback.NotPrunable,
304		} {
305			if !current.Known {
306				*current = replacement
307			}
308		}
309		return facts
310	}
311	
312	func (s *Service) auditBranchDeletion(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, target Target, request ReportRequest) BranchDeletion {
313		result := BranchDeletion{Requested: request.DeleteBranches, BaseExplicit: request.BaseExplicit, BaseRef: request.BaseRef, Checks: []Check{}}
314		if !request.DeleteBranches {
315			return result
316		}
317		result.Checks = append(result.Checks, branchCheck("base-explicit", request.BaseExplicit && request.BaseRef != "", "an explicit base was supplied", "branch deletion requires an explicit base"))
318		result.Checks = append(result.Checks, branchCheck("branch-distinct-from-base", target.Branch != "" && target.Branch != request.BaseRef, "branch is named and differs from base", "branch is absent or equals the base"))
319		if !request.BaseExplicit || request.BaseRef == "" || target.Branch == "" || target.Branch == request.BaseRef {
320			result.Checks = append(result.Checks,
321				Check{ID: "base-and-tip-resolve", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "base and branch tips were not resolved"},
322				Check{ID: "branch-contained", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "branch containment is unknown"},
323				Check{ID: "zero-unique-commits", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "unique commit count is unknown"})
324			return result
325		}
326		state, err := s.backend.branchState(ctx, repository, request.BaseRef, target.Branch)
327		if err != nil {
328			result.Checks = append(result.Checks,
329				Check{ID: "base-and-tip-resolve", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "base or branch tip could not be resolved"},
330				Check{ID: "branch-contained", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "branch containment is unknown"},
331				Check{ID: "zero-unique-commits", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "unique commit count is unknown"})
332			return result
333		}
334		result.BaseHead, result.BranchTip = state.BaseHead, state.BranchTip
335		result.RelationKnown, result.BaseOnly, result.BranchOnly = true, state.BaseOnly, state.BranchOnly
336		result.Checks = append(result.Checks,
337			Check{ID: "base-and-tip-resolve", Classification: Eligible, Detail: "base and branch tips resolve"},
338			branchCheck("branch-contained", state.BranchOnly == 0, "branch is contained in the explicit base", "branch is not contained in the explicit base"),
339			branchCheck("zero-unique-commits", state.BranchOnly == 0, "branch has zero commits unique from base", "branch has commits unique from base"))
340		result.Safe = checksEligible(result.Checks)
341		return result
342	}
343	
344	func branchCheck(id string, value bool, yes, no string) Check {
345		if value {
346			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
347		}
348		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Blocked, Detail: no}
349	}
350	
351	func checksEligible(checks []Check) bool {
352		if len(checks) == 0 {
353			return false
354		}
355		for _, check := range checks {
356			if check.Classification != Eligible {
357				return false
358			}
359		}
360		return true
361	}
362	
363	func plannedActions(candidate Candidate) []PlannedAction {
364		removeStatus := "blocked"
365		removeDetail := "candidate is not eligible; report only"
366		if candidate.Classification == Eligible {
367			removeStatus, removeDetail = "planned", "remove with plain non-force git worktree remove after locked revalidation"
368		}
369		actions := []PlannedAction{{Kind: "remove-worktree", Target: candidate.Path, Status: removeStatus, Detail: removeDetail}}
370		if candidate.BranchDeletion.Requested && candidate.BranchDeletion.Safe {
371			actions = append(actions, PlannedAction{Kind: "delete-branch", Target: candidate.Branch, Status: "planned", Detail: "delete with git branch -d after separate post-removal revalidation"})
372		} else {
373			detail := "branch is retained by default"
374			if candidate.BranchDeletion.Requested {
375				detail = "branch deletion proof is incomplete or unsafe; retain the branch"
376			}
377			actions = append(actions, PlannedAction{Kind: "retain-branch", Target: candidate.Branch, Status: "planned", Detail: detail})
378		}
379		return actions
380	}
381	
382	func candidateFingerprint(candidate Candidate) string {
383		candidate.Fingerprint = ""
384		data, err := json.Marshal(candidate)
385		if err != nil {
386			return ""
387		}
388		sum := sha256.Sum256(data)
389		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
390	}

392	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, request ApplyRequest) (ApplyResult, error) {
393		if request.Report.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
394			return ApplyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported ephemeral report schema %d", request.Report.SchemaVersion)
395		}
396		if len(request.Fingerprints) == 0 {
397			return ApplyResult{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Repository: request.Report.Repository, Results: []ApplyCandidateResult{}}, nil
398		}
399		repository, err := s.backend.discover(ctx, request.Report.Repository.Root)
400		if err != nil {
401			return ApplyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("rediscover canonical repository: %w", err)
402		}
403		if repository.Linked || repository.Identity.Bare || repository.Identity.Root != request.Report.Repository.Root ||
404			repository.Identity.CommonDir != request.Report.Repository.CommonDir {
405			return ApplyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("repository identity changed since the report")
406		}
407		selected := make(map[string]bool, len(request.Fingerprints))
408		for _, fingerprint := range request.Fingerprints {
409			selected[fingerprint] = true
410		}
411		result := ApplyResult{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Repository: repository.Identity, Results: []ApplyCandidateResult{}}
412		err = s.backend.withCleanupLock(ctx, repository.Identity.CommonDir, func() error {
413			if s.beforeRevalidate != nil {
414				s.beforeRevalidate()
415			}
416			for _, prior := range request.Report.Candidates {
417				if !selected[prior.Fingerprint] {
418					continue
419				}
420				fresh, err := s.Report(ctx, ReportRequest{
421					RepoPath: request.Report.Repository.Root, StaleDays: request.Report.StaleDays,
422					BaseRef: request.Report.BaseRef, BaseExplicit: request.Report.BaseExplicit,
423					DeleteBranches: request.Report.DeleteBranches,
424				})
425				if err != nil {
426					return fmt.Errorf("recollect cleanup report: %w", err)
427				}
428				current, exists := findCandidate(fresh.Candidates, candidateKey(prior))
429				item := ApplyCandidateResult{Path: prior.Path, Branch: prior.Branch, BranchRetained: prior.Branch != ""}
430				if prior.Classification != Eligible || !exists || current.Classification != Eligible || current.Fingerprint != prior.Fingerprint {
431					item.Status = ApplySkippedChanged
432					item.Detail = "candidate evidence changed after the report; nothing was removed"
433					result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
434					continue
435				}
436				if err := s.backend.removeWorktree(ctx, repository, prior.Path); err != nil {
437					item.Status = ApplyFailed
438					item.Detail = "plain non-force worktree removal was refused"
439					result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
440					continue
441				}
442				item.RemovedWorktree = true
443				if err := s.backend.verifyRemoved(ctx, repository, prior.Path); err != nil {
444					item.Status = ApplyFailed
445					item.Detail = "worktree removal could not be verified; branch was retained"
446					result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
447					continue
448				}
449				if prior.BranchDeletion.Requested {
450					if !prior.BranchDeletion.Safe || !current.BranchDeletion.Safe {
451						item.Status = ApplyPartial
452						item.Detail = "worktree removed; branch retained because deletion proof was unsafe"
453						result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
454						continue
455					}
456					state, stateErr := s.backend.branchState(ctx, repository, prior.BranchDeletion.BaseRef, prior.Branch)
457					if stateErr != nil || state.BaseHead != prior.BranchDeletion.BaseHead || state.BranchTip != prior.BranchDeletion.BranchTip || state.BranchOnly != 0 {
458						item.Status = ApplyPartial
459						item.Detail = "worktree removed; branch or base proof changed, so the branch was retained"
460						result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
461						continue
462					}
463					if err := s.backend.deleteBranch(ctx, repository, prior.Branch); err != nil {
464						item.Status = ApplyPartial
465						item.Detail = "worktree removed; safe branch -d did not complete, so the branch was retained"
466						result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
467						continue
468					}
469					item.DeletedBranch, item.BranchRetained = true, false
470				}
471				item.Status = ApplyRemoved
472				item.Detail = "worktree removed after locked revalidation"
473				result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
474			}
475			return nil
476		})
477		if err != nil {
478			return result, err
479		}
480		return result, nil
481	}

483	func findCandidate(candidates []Candidate, key string) (Candidate, bool) {
484		for _, candidate := range candidates {
485			if candidateKey(candidate) == key {
486				return candidate, true
487			}
488		}
489		return Candidate{}, false
490	}
491	
492	func candidateKey(candidate Candidate) string {
493		return strings.Join([]string{candidate.Provider, candidate.SessionID, candidate.RunID, candidate.AgentID, candidate.Path}, "\x00")
494	}
495	
496	func availabilityDetail(available bool) string {
497		if available {
498			return "available"
499		}
500		return "unavailable"
501	}
502	
503	func diagnostic(source, code, message string) Diagnostic {
504		return Diagnostic{Source: source, Code: code, Message: message}
505	}

507	func mergeEvidenceCapabilities(existing []Capability, states evidenceCapabilities) []Capability {
508		return append(existing,
509			Capability{Name: "task-inventory", Available: states.tasks, Detail: availabilityDetail(states.tasks)},
510			Capability{Name: "artifact-inventory", Available: states.artifacts, Detail: availabilityDetail(states.artifacts)},
511			Capability{Name: "caller-containment", Available: states.caller, Detail: availabilityDetail(states.caller)},
512			Capability{Name: "runtime-inventory", Available: states.runtime, Detail: availabilityDetail(states.runtime)},
513		)
514	}
515	
516	func stableCapabilities(values []Capability) []Capability {
517		byName := make(map[string]Capability)
518		for _, value := range values {
519			if value.Name == "" {
520				continue
521			}
522			current, exists := byName[value.Name]
523			if !exists {
524				byName[value.Name] = value
525				continue
526			}
527			current.Available = current.Available && value.Available
528			if !current.Available {
529				current.Detail = "unavailable"
530			}
531			byName[value.Name] = current
532		}
533		out := make([]Capability, 0, len(byName))
534		for _, value := range byName {
535			out = append(out, value)
536		}
537		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Name < out[j].Name })
538		return out
539	}
540	
541	func stableDiagnostics(values []Diagnostic) []Diagnostic {
542		seen := make(map[string]bool)
543		out := make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(values))
544		for _, value := range values {
545			key := value.Source + "\x00" + value.Code + "\x00" + value.Message
546			if seen[key] {
547				continue
548			}
549			seen[key] = true
550			out = append(out, value)
551		}
552		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
553			if out[i].Source != out[j].Source {
554				return out[i].Source < out[j].Source
555			}
556			if out[i].Code != out[j].Code {
557				return out[i].Code < out[j].Code
558			}
559			return out[i].Message < out[j].Message
560		})
561		return out
562	}

1	// Package ephemeral audits and removes provider-verified, turn-scoped Git
2	// worktrees. Provider metadata is evidence, never authority by itself: mutation
3	// is allowed only after every independent Git, task, artifact, caller, and
4	// runtime proof is freshly re-collected under a repository-scoped lock.

40	func (b *systemBackend) discover(ctx context.Context, path string) (repositoryState, error) {
41		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
42		if err != nil {
43			return repositoryState{}, err
44		}
45		root, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.Root)
46		if err != nil {
47			return repositoryState{}, err
48		}
49		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
50		if err != nil {
51			return repositoryState{}, err
52		}
53		return repositoryState{
54			Identity: RepositoryIdentity{Root: root, CommonDir: commonDir, Name: repository.Name, Bare: repository.Bare},
55			Linked:   repository.IsLinkedWorktree,
56		}, nil
57	}

59	func (b *systemBackend) worktrees(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState) ([]Target, error) {
60		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, repository.Identity.Root)
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, err
63		}
64		targets := make([]Target, 0, len(worktrees))
65		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
66			path, err := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
67			if err != nil {
68				return nil, err
69			}
70			targets = append(targets, Target{
71				Path: path, Branch: worktree.Branch, RegistryHead: worktree.Head,
72				Main: worktree.Main, Bare: worktree.Bare, Detached: worktree.Detached,
73				Locked: worktree.Locked, LockedReason: worktree.LockedReason,
74				Prunable: worktree.Prunable, PrunableReason: worktree.PrunableReason,
75				Registered: true, RegistrationKnown: true, Hint: inventory.LooksEphemeralWorktree(path, worktree.Branch),
76			})
77		}
78		return targets, nil
79	}

81	func (b *systemBackend) gitFacts(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, target Target) (GitFacts, error) {
82		facts := structuralGitFacts(target, target.RegistrationKnown)
83		facts.NonMain = KnownFact(!target.Main)
84		if target.RegistrationKnown {
85			facts.Registered = KnownFact(target.Registered)
86			facts.LinkedWorktree = KnownFact(target.Registered && !target.Main && !target.Bare)
87			facts.BranchNamed = KnownFact(target.Branch != "" && !target.Detached)
88			facts.Unlocked = KnownFact(!target.Locked)
89			facts.NotPrunable = KnownFact(!target.Prunable)
90		}
91	
92		info, err := os.Lstat(target.Path)
93		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
94			facts.PathPresent = KnownFact(false)
95			return facts, nil
96		}
97		if err != nil {
98			return facts, err
99		}
100		facts.PathPresent = KnownFact(info.IsDir() && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0)
101		if !facts.PathPresent.Value {
102			return facts, fmt.Errorf("checkout path is not a regular directory")
103		}
104		checkoutRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, target.Path)
105		if err != nil {
106			return facts, err
107		}
108		checkoutCommon, err := pathx.Canonical(checkoutRepo.GitCommonDir)
109		if err != nil {
110			return facts, err
111		}
112		facts.CommonDir = checkoutCommon
113		facts.CommonDirMatches = KnownFact(checkoutCommon == repository.Identity.CommonDir)
114		liveHead, err := gitx.Run(ctx, target.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
115		if err != nil {
116			return facts, err
117		}
118		facts.LiveHead = liveHead
119		facts.HeadMatches = KnownFact(target.RegistryHead != "" && liveHead == target.RegistryHead)
120		inspection, err := gitx.InspectEphemeralCheckout(ctx, target.Path)
121		if err != nil {
122			return facts, err
123		}
124		facts.Staged, facts.Unstaged = inspection.Status.Staged, inspection.Status.Unstaged
125		facts.Conflicted, facts.Untracked = inspection.Status.Conflicted, inspection.Status.Untracked
126		facts.Ignored, facts.DirtySubmodules = inspection.Ignored, inspection.DirtySubmodules
127		facts.BranchMatches = KnownFact(inspection.Status.Branch == target.Branch && !inspection.Status.Detached)
128		facts.Clean = KnownFact(!inspection.Status.Dirty())
129		facts.IgnoredEmpty = KnownFact(inspection.Ignored == 0)
130		facts.SubmodulesClean = KnownFact(inspection.DirtySubmodules == 0)
131		facts.StateFingerprint = inspection.Fingerprint
132		operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(target.Path)
133		if err != nil {
134			return facts, err
135		}
136		facts.NoGitOperation = KnownFact(!active)
137		if active {
138			facts.Operation = operation
139		}
140		return facts, nil
141	}

143	func (b *systemBackend) taskEvidence(_ context.Context, repository repositoryState, target Target) (taskEvidence, error) {
144		if b.tasks == nil {
145			return taskEvidence{}, fmt.Errorf("task store unavailable")
146		}
147		tasks, err := strictTaskList(b.tasks)
148		if err != nil {
149			return taskEvidence{}, err
150		}
151		type claim struct {
152			ID, Repo, Worktree, Branch, State string
153		}
154		var claims []claim
155		for _, current := range tasks {
156			worktree := ""
157			if current.WorktreePath != "" {
158				worktree, _ = pathx.Canonical(current.WorktreePath)
159			}
160			repo := ""
161			if current.RepoPath != "" {
162				repo, _ = pathx.Canonical(current.RepoPath)
163			}
164			if worktree == target.Path || (repo == repository.Identity.Root && current.Branch != "" && current.Branch == target.Branch) {
165				claims = append(claims, claim{current.ID, repo, worktree, current.Branch, string(current.State)})
166			}
167		}
168		sort.Slice(claims, func(i, j int) bool { return claims[i].ID < claims[j].ID })
169		return taskEvidence{Unclaimed: KnownFact(len(claims) == 0), Claims: len(claims), Fingerprint: digest(claims)}, nil
170	}

172	func strictTaskList(store *task.Store) ([]*task.Task, error) {
173		entries, err := os.ReadDir(store.Dir)
174		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
175			return nil, nil
176		}
177		if err != nil {
178			return nil, err
179		}
180		var tasks []*task.Task
181		for _, entry := range entries {
182			name := entry.Name()
183			if strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") {
184				continue
185			}
186			info, err := entry.Info()
187			if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
188				return nil, fmt.Errorf("task inventory contains an unsafe task entry")
189			}
190			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
191			current, err := store.Get(id)
192			if err != nil {
193				return nil, err
194			}
195			if err := current.Validate(); err != nil {
196				return nil, err
197			}
198			tasks = append(tasks, current)
199		}
200		return tasks, nil
201	}

237	func (b *systemBackend) runtimeEvidence(ctx context.Context, target Target) (runtimeEvidence, error) {
238		if b.runtimeDisabled {
239			return runtimeEvidence{}, fmt.Errorf("runtime inventory disabled")
240		}
241		type coveringSession struct {
242			Runtime string
243			Handle  string
244			Paths   []string
245		}
246		seenRuntimes := make(map[string]bool)
247		var covering []coveringSession
248		for _, rt := range b.runtimes {
249			if rt == nil || rt.Name() == "none" || seenRuntimes[rt.Name()] {
250				continue
251			}
252			seenRuntimes[rt.Name()] = true
253			if !rt.Available() {
254				continue
255			}
256			sessions, err := rt.List(ctx)
257			if err != nil {
258				return runtimeEvidence{}, err
259			}
260			for _, session := range sessions {
261				paths := sessionPaths(session)
262				covers := false
263				for _, path := range paths {
264					inside, err := pathx.Contains(target.Path, path)
265					if err != nil {
266						return runtimeEvidence{}, err
267					}
268					if inside {
269						covers = true
270					}
271				}
272				if covers {
273					sort.Strings(paths)
274					covering = append(covering, coveringSession{Runtime: rt.Name(), Handle: session.Handle, Paths: paths})
275				}
276			}
277		}
278		sort.Slice(covering, func(i, j int) bool {
279			if covering[i].Runtime != covering[j].Runtime {
280				return covering[i].Runtime < covering[j].Runtime
281			}
282			return covering[i].Handle < covering[j].Handle
283		})
284		return runtimeEvidence{
285			Known: KnownFact(true), Clear: KnownFact(len(covering) == 0), Covering: len(covering), Fingerprint: digest(covering),
286		}, nil
287	}
288	
289	func sessionPaths(session runtime.Session) []string {
290		set := make(map[string]bool)
291		for _, path := range session.Dirs {
292			if path != "" {
293				set[path] = true
294			}
295		}
296		for _, pane := range session.Panes {
297			for _, path := range []string{pane.CWD, pane.ShellCWD} {
298				if path != "" {
299					set[path] = true
300				}
301			}
302		}
303		paths := make([]string, 0, len(set))
304		for path := range set {
305			paths = append(paths, path)
306		}
307		return paths
308	}

310	func (b *systemBackend) branchState(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, base, branch string) (branchState, error) {
311		baseHead, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Identity.Root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--end-of-options", base+"^{commit}")
312		if err != nil {
313			return branchState{}, err
314		}
315		branchTip, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Identity.Root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--end-of-options", "refs/heads/"+branch+"^{commit}")
316		if err != nil {
317			return branchState{}, err
318		}
319		relation, err := gitx.CompareBranches(ctx, repository.Identity.Root, baseHead, branchTip)
320		if err != nil {
321			return branchState{}, err
322		}
323		return branchState{BaseHead: baseHead, BranchTip: branchTip, BaseOnly: relation.BaseOnly, BranchOnly: relation.BranchOnly}, nil
324	}

328	}

334	func (b *systemBackend) verifyRemoved(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, path string) error {
335		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
336			return fmt.Errorf("checkout path still exists")
337		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
338			return err
339		}
340		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, repository.Identity.Root)
341		if err != nil {
342			return err
343		}
344		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
345			candidate, err := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
346			if err != nil {
347				return err
348			}
349			if candidate == path {
350				return fmt.Errorf("worktree registration still exists")
351			}
352		}
353		return nil
354	}

357		_, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Identity.Root, "branch", "-d", "--", branch)

361	func digest(value any) string {
362		encoded, err := json.Marshal(value)
363		if err != nil {
364			return ""
365		}
366		sum := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
367		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
368	}

120	func (a *Adapter) Collect(ctx context.Context, query ephemeral.SourceQuery) ephemeral.SourceResult {
121		result := ephemeral.SourceResult{Provider: providerName, Complete: true}
122		capability := ephemeral.Capability{Name: "claude-workflow-metadata", Available: true, Detail: "bounded local metadata"}
123		result.Capabilities = []ephemeral.Capability{capability}
124		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
125			return a.failed(result, "canceled")
126		}
127		if err := a.validateLimits(); err != nil {
128			return a.failed(result, "metadata-bound")
129		}
130		rootInfo, err := os.Lstat(a.root)
131		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
132			result.Capabilities[0].Detail = "metadata root absent"
133			return result
134		}
135		if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(a.root, rootInfo, true) {
136			return a.failed(result, "unsafe-metadata")
137		}
138	
139		var used counts
140		projects, err := a.directories(a.root, &used.projects, a.limits.MaxProjects)
141		if err != nil {
142			return a.failed(result, failureCode(err))
143		}
144		for _, project := range projects {
145			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
146				return a.failed(result, "canceled")
147			}
148			projectPath, err := fixedChild(a.root, project)
149			if err != nil {
150				return a.failed(result, "invalid-id")
151			}
152			sessions, err := a.directories(projectPath, &used.sessions, a.limits.MaxSessions)
153			if err != nil {
154				return a.failed(result, failureCode(err))
155			}
156			for _, session := range sessions {
157				claims, scanErr := a.collectSession(ctx, query, projectPath, session, &used)
158				if scanErr != nil {
159					return a.failed(result, failureCode(scanErr))
160				}
161				result.Claims = append(result.Claims, claims...)
162			}
163		}
164	
165		a.rejectDuplicateClaims(&result)
166		sort.Slice(result.Claims, func(i, j int) bool {
167			left, right := result.Claims[i], result.Claims[j]
168			if left.WorktreePath != right.WorktreePath {
169				return left.WorktreePath < right.WorktreePath
170			}
171			if left.RunID != right.RunID {
172				return left.RunID < right.RunID
173			}
174			return left.AgentID < right.AgentID
175		})
176		return result
177	}
178	
179	func (a *Adapter) failed(result ephemeral.SourceResult, code string) ephemeral.SourceResult {
180		result.Complete = false
181		result.Claims = nil
182		result.Capabilities[0].Available = false
183		result.Capabilities[0].Detail = "metadata could not be safely verified"
184		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ephemeral.Diagnostic{
185			Source: providerName, Code: code, Message: diagnosticMessage(code),
186		})
187		return result
188	}
189	
190	func diagnosticMessage(code string) string {
191		switch code {
192		case "metadata-bound":
193			return "provider metadata exceeded a fixed V1 bound"
194		case "metadata-mutated":
195			return "provider metadata changed while it was inspected"
196		case "unsafe-metadata":
197			return "provider metadata was not a private regular non-link path"
198		case "invalid-workflow":
199			return "workflow metadata has an invalid required field"
200		case "invalid-agent-mapping":
201			return "agent mapping metadata has an invalid required field"
202		case "invalid-journal":
203			return "workflow journal has an invalid required record"
204		case "invalid-worktree-path":
205			return "agent mapping contains an invalid or unrelated worktree path"
206		case "invalid-id":
207			return "provider metadata contains an invalid identifier"
208		case "canceled":
209			return "provider metadata inspection was canceled"
210		default:
211			return "provider metadata could not be safely verified"
212		}
213	}
214	
215	func (a *Adapter) validateLimits() error {
216		values := []int{a.limits.MaxProjects, a.limits.MaxSessions, a.limits.MaxWorkflows, a.limits.MaxAgents, a.limits.MaxJournalRecords}
217		for _, value := range values {
218			if value < 0 {
219				return failure("metadata-bound")
220			}
221		}
222		if a.limits.MaxJSONBytes <= 0 || a.limits.MaxJournalBytes <= 0 {
223			return failure("metadata-bound")
224		}
225		return nil
226	}
227	
228	func (a *Adapter) collectSession(ctx context.Context, query ephemeral.SourceQuery, projectPath, session string, used *counts) ([]ephemeral.Claim, error) {
229		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(session); err != nil {
230			return nil, failure("invalid-id")
231		}
232		sessionPath, err := fixedChild(projectPath, session)
233		if err != nil {
234			return nil, failure("invalid-id")
235		}
236		workflowsPath := filepath.Join(sessionPath, "workflows")
237		if exists, err := safeOptionalDirectory(workflowsPath); err != nil {
238			return nil, err
239		} else if !exists {
240			return nil, nil
241		}
242		entries, err := os.ReadDir(workflowsPath)
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
245		}
246		var claims []ephemeral.Claim
247		for _, entry := range entries {
248			name := entry.Name()
249			if !strings.HasPrefix(name, "wf_") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".json") {
250				continue
251			}
252			used.workflows++
253			if used.workflows > a.limits.MaxWorkflows {
254				return nil, failure("metadata-bound")
255			}
256			runID := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".json")
257			if err := validateID(runID, "wf_"); err != nil {
258				return nil, failure("invalid-id")
259			}
260			workflowPath, err := fixedChild(workflowsPath, name)
261			if err != nil {
262				return nil, failure("invalid-id")
263			}
264			workflow, err := a.readWorkflow(workflowPath, runID)
265			if err != nil {
266				return nil, err
267			}
268			found, err := a.collectWorkflow(ctx, query, sessionPath, session, workflow, used)
269			if err != nil {
270				return nil, err
271			}
272			claims = append(claims, found...)
273		}
274		return claims, nil
275	}
276	
277	func (a *Adapter) collectWorkflow(ctx context.Context, query ephemeral.SourceQuery, sessionPath, session string, workflow workflowRecord, used *counts) ([]ephemeral.Claim, error) {
278		mappingPath := filepath.Join(sessionPath, "subagents", "workflows", workflow.id)
279		if exists, err := safeFixedDirectoryChain(sessionPath, "subagents", "workflows", workflow.id); err != nil {
280			return nil, err
281		} else if !exists {
282			return nil, failure("invalid-agent-mapping")
283		}
284		entries, err := os.ReadDir(mappingPath)
285		if err != nil {
286			return nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
287		}
288		journal, journalMtime, journalTimeKnown, err := a.readJournal(mappingPath, workflow.id)
289		if err != nil {
290			return nil, err
291		}
292		var claims []ephemeral.Claim
293		for _, entry := range entries {
294			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
295				return nil, failure("canceled")
296			}
297			name := entry.Name()
298			if !strings.HasPrefix(name, "agent-") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".meta.json") {
299				continue
300			}
301			used.agents++
302			if used.agents > a.limits.MaxAgents {
303				return nil, failure("metadata-bound")
304			}
305			filenameID := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(name, "agent-"), ".meta.json")
306			if err := validateID(filenameID, ""); err != nil {
307				return nil, failure("invalid-id")
308			}
309			metaPath, err := fixedChild(mappingPath, name)
310			if err != nil {
311				return nil, failure("invalid-id")
312			}
313			meta, mappingEntry, err := a.readMeta(metaPath, workflow.id, filenameID)
314			if err != nil {
315				return nil, err
316			}
317			if !mappingEntry {
318				continue
319			}
320			canonicalPath, related, err := validateWorktreePath(query, meta.path)
321			if err != nil {
322				return nil, failure("invalid-worktree-path")
323			}
324			if !related {
325				continue
326			}
327			progress, progressOK := workflow.progressByID[filenameID]
328			meta.isolation, meta.state = progress.isolation, progress.state
329			mappingOK := filenameID == meta.agentID && workflow.id == meta.workflowID && workflow.id == meta.runID &&
330				meta.spawned && progressOK && progress.valid && meta.isolation == "worktree"
331			started, result, startedAt, resultAt, eventTimesKnown := journalFacts(journal, workflow.id, meta.runID, meta.agentID)
332			resumed, resumeMtime, err := resumeExists(sessionPath, meta.agentID)
333			if err != nil {
334				return nil, err
335			}
336			activity := append([]time.Time(nil), workflow.activity...)
337			activity = append(activity, progress.activity...)
338			activity = append(activity, meta.updatedAt, startedAt, resultAt, workflow.mtime, meta.mtime, journalMtime, resumeMtime)
339			last, timeKnown := lastActivity(query.Now, activity,
340				workflow.timeKnown && progress.timeKnown && meta.timeKnown && journalTimeKnown && eventTimesKnown,
341			)
342			claims = append(claims, ephemeral.Claim{
343				Provider: providerName, SessionID: session, RunID: workflow.id, AgentID: filenameID,
344				WorktreePath: canonicalPath, Owned: ephemeral.KnownFact(true), Unique: ephemeral.KnownFact(true),
345				Mapping: ephemeral.KnownFact(mappingOK), WorkflowState: normalizeWorkflowState(workflow.status),
346				WorkflowTerminal: ephemeral.KnownFact(workflow.status == "completed" || workflow.status == "killed"),
347				AgentState:       normalizeAgentState(meta.state), AgentDone: ephemeral.KnownFact(meta.state == "done"),
348				JournalStarted: ephemeral.KnownFact(started), JournalResult: ephemeral.KnownFact(result),
349				NotResumed: ephemeral.KnownFact(!resumed), LastActivity: last, LastActivityKnown: timeKnown,
350			})
351		}
352		return claims, nil
353	}
354	
355	func (a *Adapter) readWorkflow(path, filenameID string) (workflowRecord, error) {
356		data, info, err := a.readStable(path, a.limits.MaxJSONBytes)
357		if err != nil {
358			return workflowRecord{}, err
359		}
360		object, err := decodeObject(data)
361		if err != nil {
362			return workflowRecord{}, failure("invalid-workflow")
363		}
364		runID, okRun := requiredString(object, "runId")
365		if !okRun || runID != filenameID {
366			return workflowRecord{}, failure("workflow-id-mismatch")
367		}
368		if _, present := object["id"]; present {
369			id, okID := requiredString(object, "id")
370			if !okID || id != filenameID {
371				return workflowRecord{}, failure("workflow-id-mismatch")
372			}
373		}
374		status, okStatus := requiredString(object, "status")
375		if !okStatus {
376			return workflowRecord{}, failure("invalid-workflow-status")
377		}
378		if err := validateID(runID, "wf_"); err != nil {
379			return workflowRecord{}, failure("invalid-id")
380		}
381		activity, timeKnown := timestampFields(object, []string{"timestamp", "updatedAt"}, []string{"startTime"})
382		progressByID, progressActivity, progressTimeKnown, err := decodeProgress(object["workflowProgress"])
383		if err != nil {
384			return workflowRecord{}, err
385		}
386		activity = append(activity, progressActivity...)
387		return workflowRecord{
388			id: runID, status: strings.ToLower(status), activity: activity,
389			timeKnown: timeKnown && progressTimeKnown, mtime: info.ModTime(), progressByID: progressByID,
390		}, nil
391	}
392	
393	func decodeProgress(raw json.RawMessage) (map[string]progressRecord, []time.Time, bool, error) {
394		if len(raw) == 0 {
395			return map[string]progressRecord{}, nil, true, nil
396		}
397		var entries []json.RawMessage
398		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &entries); err != nil {
399			return nil, nil, false, failure("invalid-workflow-progress")
400		}
401		byID := make(map[string]progressRecord, len(entries))
402		var allActivity []time.Time
403		allKnown := true
404		for _, entry := range entries {
405			object, err := decodeObject(entry)
406			if err != nil {
407				allKnown = false
408				continue
409			}
410			agentID, okAgent := requiredString(object, "agentId")
411			if !okAgent || validateID(agentID, "") != nil {
412				allKnown = false
413				continue
414			}
415			isolation, okIsolation := requiredString(object, "isolation")
416			state, okState := requiredString(object, "state")
417			valid := okIsolation && okState
418			if _, duplicate := byID[agentID]; duplicate {
419				return nil, nil, false, failure("duplicate-agent-progress")
420			}
421			queued, queuedKnown := optionalEpochMillis(object, "queuedAt")
422			started, startedKnown := optionalEpochMillis(object, "startedAt")
423			last, lastKnown := optionalEpochMillis(object, "lastProgressAt")
424			known := queuedKnown && startedKnown && lastKnown
425			if !queued.IsZero() && !started.IsZero() && started.Before(queued) {
426				known = false
427			}
428			if !started.IsZero() && !last.IsZero() && last.Before(started) {
429				known = false
430			}
431			activity := nonZeroTimes(queued, started, last)
432			byID[agentID] = progressRecord{
433				agentID: agentID, isolation: strings.ToLower(isolation), state: strings.ToLower(state), valid: valid,
434				activity: activity, timeKnown: known,
435			}
436			allActivity = append(allActivity, activity...)
437			allKnown = allKnown && known
438		}
439		return byID, allActivity, allKnown, nil
440	}
441	
442	func timestampFields(object map[string]json.RawMessage, stringKeys, millisKeys []string) ([]time.Time, bool) {
443		known := true
444		var values []time.Time
445		for _, key := range stringKeys {
446			value, ok := optionalTimestamp(object, key)
447			known = known && ok
448			if !value.IsZero() {
449				values = append(values, value)
450			}
451		}
452		for _, key := range millisKeys {
453			value, ok := optionalEpochMillis(object, key)
454			known = known && ok
455			if !value.IsZero() {
456				values = append(values, value)
457			}
458		}
459		return values, known
460	}
461	
462	func optionalEpochMillis(object map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) (time.Time, bool) {
463		raw, present := object[key]
464		if !present {
465			return time.Time{}, true
466		}
467		var number json.Number
468		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &number); err != nil {
469			return time.Time{}, false
470		}
471		millis, err := strconv.ParseInt(number.String(), 10, 64)
472		if err != nil || millis <= 0 {
473			return time.Time{}, false
474		}
475		return time.UnixMilli(millis).UTC(), true
476	}
477	
478	func nonZeroTimes(values ...time.Time) []time.Time {
479		out := make([]time.Time, 0, len(values))
480		for _, value := range values {
481			if !value.IsZero() {
482				out = append(out, value)
483			}
484		}
485		return out
486	}
487	
488	func (a *Adapter) readMeta(path, pathWorkflowID, filenameAgentID string) (metaRecord, bool, error) {
489		data, info, err := a.readStable(path, a.limits.MaxJSONBytes)
490		if err != nil {
491			return metaRecord{}, false, err
492		}
493		object, err := decodeObject(data)
494		if err != nil {
495			return metaRecord{}, false, failure("invalid-agent-mapping")
496		}
497		_, pathPresent := object["worktreePath"]
498		_, snakePathPresent := object["worktree_path"]
499		_, shortPathPresent := object["worktree"]
500		_, spawnedPresent := object["spawnedWithWorktree"]
501		if !pathPresent && !snakePathPresent && !shortPathPresent && !spawnedPresent {
502			return metaRecord{}, false, nil
503		}
504		workflowID := pathWorkflowID
505		if _, present := object["workflowId"]; present {
506			var ok bool
507			workflowID, ok = requiredString(object, "workflowId")
508			if !ok || workflowID != pathWorkflowID {
509				return metaRecord{}, false, failure("invalid-agent-workflow")
510			}
511		}
512		runID := pathWorkflowID
513		if _, present := object["runId"]; present {
514			var ok bool
515			runID, ok = requiredString(object, "runId")
516			if !ok || runID != pathWorkflowID {
517				return metaRecord{}, false, failure("invalid-agent-run")
518			}
519		}
520		agentID := filenameAgentID
521		if _, present := object["agentId"]; present {
522			var ok bool
523			agentID, ok = requiredString(object, "agentId")
524			if !ok {
525				return metaRecord{}, false, failure("invalid-agent-id")
526			}
527		}
528		worktreePath, okPath := oneString(object, "worktreePath", "worktree_path", "worktree")
529		spawned, okSpawned := requiredBool(object, "spawnedWithWorktree")
530		if !okPath || !okSpawned {
531			return metaRecord{}, false, failure("invalid-agent-mapping")
532		}
533		updated, timeKnown := optionalTimestamp(object, "updatedAt")
534		for _, item := range []struct {
535			value  string
536			prefix string
537		}{{workflowID, "wf_"}, {runID, "wf_"}, {agentID, ""}} {
538			if err := validateID(item.value, item.prefix); err != nil {
539				return metaRecord{}, false, failure("invalid-id")
540			}
541		}
542		return metaRecord{
543			workflowID: workflowID, runID: runID, agentID: agentID, path: worktreePath,
544			spawned: spawned, updatedAt: updated, timeKnown: timeKnown, mtime: info.ModTime(),
545		}, true, nil
546	}
547	
548	func (a *Adapter) readJournal(mappingPath, pathWorkflowID string) ([]journalEvent, time.Time, bool, error) {
549		path := filepath.Join(mappingPath, "journal.jsonl")
550		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
551		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
552			return nil, time.Time{}, true, nil
553		}
554		if err != nil {
555			return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("unsafe-metadata")
556		}
557		data, stableInfo, err := a.readStableWithInfo(path, info, a.limits.MaxJournalBytes)
558		if err != nil {
559			return nil, time.Time{}, false, err
560		}
561		lines := bytes.Split(data, []byte{'\n'})
562		if len(lines) > 0 && len(lines[len(lines)-1]) == 0 {
563			lines = lines[:len(lines)-1]
564		}
565		if len(lines) > a.limits.MaxJournalRecords {
566			return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("metadata-bound")
567		}
568		events := make([]journalEvent, 0, len(lines))
569		for _, line := range lines {
570			if len(bytes.TrimSpace(line)) == 0 {
571				continue
572			}
573			object, err := decodeObject(line)
574			if err != nil {
575				return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal")
576			}
577			kind, ok := oneString(object, "type", "event")
578			if !ok {
579				return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal-kind")
580			}
581			kind = strings.ToLower(kind)
582			if kind != "started" && kind != "result" {
583				continue
584			}
585			workflowID := pathWorkflowID
586			if _, present := object["workflowId"]; present {
587				var okWorkflow bool
588				workflowID, okWorkflow = requiredString(object, "workflowId")
589				if !okWorkflow || workflowID != pathWorkflowID {
590					return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal-workflow")
591				}
592			}
593			runID := pathWorkflowID
594			if _, present := object["runId"]; present {
595				var okRun bool
596				runID, okRun = requiredString(object, "runId")
597				if !okRun || runID != pathWorkflowID {
598					return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal-run")
599				}
600			}
601			agentID, okAgent := requiredString(object, "agentId")
602			if !okAgent {
603				return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal-agent")
604			}
605			at, timeKnown := optionalTimestamp(object, "timestamp")
606			if validateID(workflowID, "wf_") != nil || validateID(runID, "wf_") != nil || validateID(agentID, "") != nil {
607				return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-id")
608			}
609			events = append(events, journalEvent{kind: kind, workflowID: workflowID, runID: runID, agentID: agentID, at: at, timeKnown: timeKnown})
610		}
611		return events, stableInfo.ModTime(), true, nil
612	}
613	
614	func journalFacts(events []journalEvent, workflowID, runID, agentID string) (started, result bool, startedAt, resultAt time.Time, timesKnown bool) {
615		timesKnown = true
616		startedCount, resultCount := 0, 0
617		for _, event := range events {
618			if event.workflowID != workflowID || event.runID != runID || event.agentID != agentID {
619				continue
620			}
621			switch event.kind {
622			case "started":
623				startedCount++
624				startedAt = event.at
625			case "result":
626				resultCount++
627				resultAt = event.at
628			}
629			timesKnown = timesKnown && event.timeKnown
630		}
631		started, result = startedCount == 1, resultCount == 1
632		if startedCount > 1 || resultCount > 1 || (started && result && resultAt.Before(startedAt)) {
633			timesKnown = false
634		}
635		return
636	}
637	
638	func resumeExists(sessionPath, agentID string) (bool, time.Time, error) {
639		if err := validateID(agentID, ""); err != nil {
640			return false, time.Time{}, failure("invalid-id")
641		}
642		path := filepath.Join(sessionPath, "subagents", "agent-"+agentID+".jsonl")
643		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
644		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
645			return false, time.Time{}, nil
646		}
647		if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(path, info, false) {
648			return false, time.Time{}, failure("unsafe-metadata")
649		}
650		return true, info.ModTime(), nil
651	}
652	
653	func lastActivity(now time.Time, values []time.Time, known bool) (time.Time, bool) {
654		var last time.Time
655		for _, value := range values {
656			if value.IsZero() {
657				continue
658			}
659			value = value.UTC()
660			if value.After(now.UTC()) {
661				known = false
662			}
663			if value.After(last) {
664				last = value
665			}
666		}
667		if last.IsZero() {
668			known = false
669		}
670		return last, known
671	}
672	
673	func (a *Adapter) readStable(path string, limit int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
674		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
675		if err != nil {
676			return nil, nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
677		}
678		return a.readStableWithInfo(path, info, limit)
679	}
680	
681	func (a *Adapter) readStableWithInfo(path string, before fs.FileInfo, limit int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
682		if !safeMetadataInfo(path, before, false) {
683			return nil, nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
684		}
685		first, opened, err := readBounded(path, limit)
686		if err != nil {
687			return nil, nil, err
688		}
689		if a.afterRead != nil {
690			a.afterRead(path)
691		}
692		after, err := os.Lstat(path)
693		if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(path, after, false) || !os.SameFile(before, after) ||
694			before.Size() != after.Size() || !before.ModTime().Equal(after.ModTime()) ||
695			!os.SameFile(before, opened) {
696			return nil, nil, failure("metadata-mutated")
697		}
698		second, reopened, err := readBounded(path, limit)
699		if err != nil {
700			return nil, nil, err
701		}
702		if !os.SameFile(before, reopened) || !bytes.Equal(first, second) {
703			return nil, nil, failure("metadata-mutated")
704		}
705		return first, after, nil
706	}
707	
708	func readBounded(path string, limit int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
709		file, err := os.Open(path)
710		if err != nil {
711			return nil, nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
712		}
713		defer file.Close()
714		info, err := file.Stat()
715		if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() > limit {
716			if err == nil && info.Size() > limit {
717				return nil, nil, failure("metadata-bound")
718			}
719			return nil, nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
720		}
721		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, limit+1))
722		if err != nil {
723			return nil, nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
724		}
725		if int64(len(data)) > limit {
726			return nil, nil, failure("metadata-bound")
727		}
728		return data, info, nil
729	}
730	
731	func (a *Adapter) directories(path string, total *int, maximum int) ([]string, error) {
732		entries, err := os.ReadDir(path)
733		if err != nil {
734			return nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
735		}
736		var names []string
737		for _, entry := range entries {
738			if !entry.IsDir() {
739				if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
740					return nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
741				}
742				continue
743			}
744			name := entry.Name()
745			if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(name); err != nil {
746				return nil, failure("invalid-id")
747			}
748			child, err := fixedChild(path, name)
749			if err != nil {
750				return nil, failure("invalid-id")
751			}
752			info, err := os.Lstat(child)
753			if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(child, info, true) {
754				return nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
755			}
756			*total++
757			if *total > maximum {
758				return nil, failure("metadata-bound")
759			}
760			names = append(names, name)
761		}
762		sort.Strings(names)
763		return names, nil
764	}
765	
766	func safeOptionalDirectory(path string) (bool, error) {
767		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
768		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
769			return false, nil
770		}
771		if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(path, info, true) {
772			return false, failure("unsafe-metadata")
773		}
774		return true, nil
775	}
776	
777	func safeFixedDirectoryChain(root string, components ...string) (bool, error) {
778		current := root
779		for _, component := range components {
780			if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
781				return false, failure("invalid-id")
782			}
783			current = filepath.Join(current, component)
784			info, err := os.Lstat(current)
785			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
786				return false, nil
787			}
788			if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(current, info, true) {
789				return false, failure("unsafe-metadata")
790			}
791		}
792		return true, nil
793	}
794	
795	func fixedChild(root, component string) (string, error) {
796		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
797			return "", err
798		}
799		return filepath.Join(root, component), nil
800	}

802	func validateID(id, prefix string) error {
803		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(id); err != nil {
804			return err
805		}
806		if prefix != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(id, prefix) {
807			return fmt.Errorf("id lacks prefix")
808		}
809		for _, r := range id {
810			if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9') || strings.ContainsRune("._-", r) {
811				continue
812			}
813			return fmt.Errorf("id contains unsupported character")
814		}
815		return nil
816	}

818	func validateWorktreePath(query ephemeral.SourceQuery, raw string) (string, bool, error) {
819		if raw == "" || strings.ContainsRune(raw, '\x00') || !filepath.IsAbs(raw) || filepath.Clean(raw) != raw {
820			return "", false, failure("invalid-worktree-path")
821		}
822		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(raw)
823		if err != nil {
824			return "", false, failure("invalid-worktree-path")
825		}
826		for _, target := range query.Targets {
827			candidate, candidateErr := pathx.Canonical(target.Path)
828			if candidateErr == nil && candidate == canonical {
829				return canonical, true, nil
830			}
831		}
832		harnessRoot := filepath.Join(query.Repository.Root, ".claude", "worktrees")
833		insideHarness, err := pathx.IsChild(harnessRoot, canonical)
834		if err != nil {
835			return "", false, failure("invalid-worktree-path")
836		}
837		if insideHarness {
838			return canonical, true, nil
839		}
840		insideRepository, err := pathx.Contains(query.Repository.Root, canonical)
841		if err != nil {
842			return "", false, failure("invalid-worktree-path")
843		}
844		if insideRepository {
845			return "", false, failure("invalid-worktree-path")
846		}
847		return canonical, false, nil
848	}

850	func decodeObject(data []byte) (map[string]json.RawMessage, error) {
851		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
852		opening, err := decoder.Token()
853		if err != nil || opening != json.Delim('{') {
854			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode object")
855		}
856		object := make(map[string]json.RawMessage)
857		for decoder.More() {
858			token, err := decoder.Token()
859			if err != nil {
860				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode object key")
861			}
862			key, ok := token.(string)
863			if !ok {
864				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode object key")
865			}
866			if _, duplicate := object[key]; duplicate {
867				return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate JSON field")
868			}
869			var raw json.RawMessage
870			if err := decoder.Decode(&raw); err != nil {
871				return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode object value")
872			}
873			object[key] = raw
874		}
875		closing, err := decoder.Token()
876		if err != nil || closing != json.Delim('}') {
877			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode object close")
878		}
879		var extra any
880		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
881			return nil, fmt.Errorf("extra JSON value")
882		}
883		return object, nil
884	}
885	
886	func requiredString(object map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) (string, bool) {
887		raw, ok := object[key]
888		if !ok {
889			return "", false
890		}
891		var value string
892		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &value) != nil || value == "" {
893			return "", false
894		}
895		return value, true
896	}
897	
898	func oneString(object map[string]json.RawMessage, keys ...string) (string, bool) {
899		value := ""
900		found := false
901		for _, key := range keys {
902			if _, present := object[key]; !present {
903				continue
904			}
905			candidate, ok := requiredString(object, key)
906			if !ok || (found && candidate != value) {
907				return "", false
908			}
909			value, found = candidate, true
910		}
911		return value, found
912	}

914	func requiredBool(object map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) (bool, bool) {
915		raw, ok := object[key]
916		if !ok {
917			return false, false
918		}
919		var value bool
920		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &value) != nil {
921			return false, false
922		}
923		return value, true
924	}
925	
926	func requiredTimestamp(object map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) (time.Time, bool) {
927		value, ok := requiredString(object, key)
928		if !ok {
929			return time.Time{}, false
930		}
931		parsed, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, value)
932		if err != nil {
933			return time.Time{}, false
934		}
935		return parsed.UTC(), true
936	}
937	
938	func optionalTimestamp(object map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) (time.Time, bool) {
939		if _, present := object[key]; !present {
940			return time.Time{}, true
941		}
942		return requiredTimestamp(object, key)
943	}

945	func normalizeWorkflowState(value string) string {
946		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)) {
947		case "completed":
948			return "completed"
949		case "killed":
950			return "killed"
951		case "progress", "running", "in_progress", "in-progress", "pending":
952			return "progress"
953		default:

955		}
956	}

969	func (a *Adapter) rejectDuplicateClaims(result *ephemeral.SourceResult) {
970		byPath := make(map[string][]int)
971		for i, claim := range result.Claims {
972			byPath[claim.WorktreePath] = append(byPath[claim.WorktreePath], i)
973		}
974		for _, indices := range byPath {
975			if len(indices) < 2 {
976				continue
977			}
978			for _, index := range indices {
979				result.Claims[index].Unique = ephemeral.KnownFact(false)
980			}
981			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ephemeral.Diagnostic{
982				Source: providerName, Code: "duplicate-worktree-claim", Message: "multiple provider claims name one worktree path",
983			})
984		}
985	}

12	func safeMetadataInfo(path string, info fs.FileInfo, wantDir bool) bool {
13		if info == nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
14			return false
15		}
16		pointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
17		if err != nil {
18			return false
19		}
20		attributes, err := windows.GetFileAttributes(pointer)
21		if err != nil || attributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 {
22			return false
23		}
24		if wantDir {
25			return info.IsDir()
26		}
27		return info.Mode().IsRegular()
28	}

170	func suggestFor(app *App, ctx context.Context, r inventory.Row, stale time.Duration, retireOptions sweepRetireOptions) []suggestion {
171		t := r.Task
172		var out []suggestion
173	
174		// A task whose repository is gone cannot be finished, resumed, parked or
175		// retired: every one of those resolves the repository first, and `dev done`
176		// refuses outright once the checkout is missing. Nothing else in this
177		// function reaches it either — the dead-branch rule below excludes direct
178		// mode, and the stale-worktree rule needs a recorded worktree path. Left
179		// alone, the record is unreachable by any command in the binary.
180		//
181		// Reaping removes dev's record of intent and nothing else; the branch, the
182		// commits and the remote are untouched. A live session proves the directory
183		// is there, so it is the one condition that rules this out.
184		if t.RepoPath != "" && !r.Live() && !dirExists(t.RepoPath) {
185			out = append(out, suggestion{
186				row:    r,
187				reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository %s no longer exists", config.Contract(t.RepoPath)),
188				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s (Git keeps any work; this drops only dev's record)", t.ID),
189				apply:  func() error { return app.Tasks.Delete(t.ID) },
190			})
191			return out
192		}
193	
194		out = append(out, orphanSuggestions(app, r)...)
195	
196		switch {
197		// A hot task with no live session is the commonest drift: the session was
198		// closed (or the machine rebooted) without parking.
199		case t.State == task.Hot && !r.Live():
200			out = append(out, suggestion{
201				row:    r,
202				reason: fmt.Sprintf("hot but no live session, idle %s", humanAge(r.Age())),
203				action: fmt.Sprintf("mark %s warm", t.ID),
204				apply: func() error {
205					t.State = task.Warm
206					return app.Tasks.Save(t)
207				},
208			})
209	
210		// A warm task nobody has touched in weeks is a candidate for cold: keeping
211		// the worktree costs disk and clutters every listing.
212		case t.State == task.Warm && r.Age() > stale:
213			reason := fmt.Sprintf("warm and untouched for %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
214			if r.Status.Dirty() {
215				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but has uncommitted work",
216					action: "commit or `dev park --wip` before going cold — not changed automatically"})
217				break
218			}
219			if !r.Status.Synced() {
220				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + fmt.Sprintf(", not pushed (%s)", r.Status.Summary()),
221					action: fmt.Sprintf("push %s so it can go cold: dev park %s --cold --push", t.Branch, t.ID)})
222				break
223			}
224			out = append(out, suggestion{
225				row:    r,
226				reason: reason + ", clean and pushed",
227				action: fmt.Sprintf("go cold: remove %s (branch and remote keep the work)", config.Contract(r.Checkout)),
228				apply: func() error {
229					if t.WorktreePath != "" {
230						if err := ensureArtifactsFinalized(app, t.WorktreePath); err != nil {
231							return err
232						}
233						if err := safeRemoveWorktree(ctx, runtimeForTask(app, t), t.RepoPath, t.WorktreePath,
234							false, false, false, 5*time.Second); err != nil {
235							return err
236						}
237						t.WorktreePath = ""
238					}
239					t.State = task.Cold
240					clearTaskRuntime(t)
241					return app.Tasks.Save(t)
242				},
243			})
244	
245		// DONE means integrated; runtime/worktree cleanup is a separate,
246		// externally coordinated retirement step.
247		case t.State == task.Done:
248			action := fmt.Sprintf("retire runtime/worktree for %s", t.ID)
249			if retireOptions.deleteBranches && t.Branch != "" && t.Branch != t.Base {
250				action += fmt.Sprintf(" and delete %s", t.Branch)
251			}
252			out = append(out, suggestion{
253				row:    r,
254				reason: "merged, cleanup pending",
255				action: action,
256				apply: func() error {
257					if err := ensureArtifactsFinalized(app, checkoutOf(t)); err != nil {
258						return err
259					}
260					target, rt, err := retirementTargetForTask(ctx, app, t)
261					if err != nil {
262						return err
263					}
264					service := &retirement.Service{Runtime: rt, Tasks: app.Tasks}
265					_, err = service.Retire(ctx, retirement.Request{
266						Target: target,
267						Safety: retirement.Options{
268							CloseUnknown: retireOptions.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: retireOptions.assumeNoRuntime,
269						},
270						DeleteBranch: retireOptions.deleteBranches,
271					})
272					return err
273				},
274			})
275		}
276	
277		// A branch-backed task whose branch git no longer has is dead: the branch
278		// was deleted after integration, so the record holds intent for work that
279		// no longer exists anywhere. It cannot be finished, resumed, or retired,
280		// because every one of those paths resolves the branch first.
281		noCheckout := t.WorktreePath == "" || r.WorktreeMissing
282		if noCheckout && t.Branch != "" && t.RepoPath != "" &&
283			t.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeDirect && !gitx.BranchExists(ctx, t.RepoPath, t.Branch) {
284			out = append(out, suggestion{
285				row:    r,
286				reason: fmt.Sprintf("branch %s no longer exists", t.Branch),
287				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s", t.ID),
288				apply:  func() error { return app.Tasks.Delete(t.ID) },
289			})
290			return out
291		}
292	
293		// A cold task keeps no checkout by definition: that is what going cold
294		// means. One still on disk is drift inventory already reports and nothing
295		// could act on.
296		if t.State == task.Cold && t.WorktreePath != "" && r.CheckoutExists && !r.WorktreeMissing &&
297			!r.Live() && !r.Status.Dirty() && r.Status.Synced() {
298			out = append(out, suggestion{
299				row:    r,
300				reason: "cold, but its worktree is still on disk",
301				action: fmt.Sprintf("remove %s (branch and remote keep the work)", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
302				apply: func() error {
303					if err := ensureArtifactsFinalized(app, t.WorktreePath); err != nil {
304						return err
305					}
306					if err := safeRemoveWorktree(ctx, runtimeForTask(app, t), t.RepoPath, t.WorktreePath,
307						false, false, false, 5*time.Second); err != nil {
308						return err
309					}
310					t.WorktreePath = ""
311					clearTaskRuntime(t)
312					return app.Tasks.Save(t)
313				},
314			})
315		}
316	
317		// Drift that is independent of the lifecycle stage.
318		if r.WorktreeMissing && t.WorktreePath != "" {
319			wtPath := t.WorktreePath
320			out = append(out, suggestion{
321				row:    r,
322				reason: "records a worktree that git no longer knows about",
323				action: fmt.Sprintf("clear the stale worktree path %s", config.Contract(wtPath)),
324				apply: func() error {
325					if err := gitx.PruneWorktrees(ctx, t.RepoPath); err != nil {
326						return err
327					}
328					t.WorktreePath = ""
329					if t.State == task.Hot || t.State == task.Warm {
330						t.State = task.Cold
331					}
332					return app.Tasks.Save(t)
333				},
334			})
335		}
336		return out
337	}

339	// dirExists reports whether path is a directory that can be read right now.
340	func dirExists(path string) bool {
341		info, err := os.Stat(path)
342		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
343	}

345	// orphanSuggestions handles the residue of a worktree removed while its
346	// transcript writer was still running: the path exists, Git has no record of
347	// it, and it holds only agent artifacts. Removing it is offered only once every
348	// file in it is proven byte-identical to one the repository already has.
349	func orphanSuggestions(app *App, r inventory.Row) []suggestion {
350		t := r.Task
351		if t.WorktreePath == "" || !r.WorktreeMissing || !r.CheckoutExists {
352			return nil
353		}
354		orphan, ok, err := retirement.InspectOrphan(t.WorktreePath)
355		if err != nil || !ok {
356			return nil
357		}
358		unsalvaged, err := retirement.Unsalvaged(orphan, t.RepoPath)
359		if err != nil {
360			return nil
361		}
362		if len(unsalvaged) > 0 {
363			return []suggestion{{
364				row: r,
365				reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace holding %d file(s) the repository does not have",
366					config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(unsalvaged)),
367				action: fmt.Sprintf("salvage %s first — not removed automatically", strings.Join(unsalvaged, ", ")),
368			}}
369		}
370		return []suggestion{{
371			row:    r,
372			reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace git does not know", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
373			action: fmt.Sprintf("remove the empty shell %s (its %d artifact file(s) are already in the repository)",
374				config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(orphan.Files)),
375			apply: func() error { return os.RemoveAll(t.WorktreePath) },
376		}}
377	}

379	func suggestMergedWorktrees(app *App, ctx context.Context, rows []inventory.Row, requestedBase string, options sweepRetireOptions) ([]suggestion, error) {
380		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, mustGetwd())
381		if err != nil {
382			return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees requires a Git repository: %w", err)
383		}
384		if repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
385			return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees must run from the canonical checkout, not linked worktree %s", config.Contract(repository.Root))
386		}
387		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
388		if err != nil {
389			return nil, err
390		}
391		base := requestedBase
392		if base == "" {
393			base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.Root)
394			if status.Branch != base {
395				return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees defaults to %s; switch the canonical checkout to it or pass --base explicitly", base)
396			}
397		}
398		if !gitx.RefExists(ctx, repository.Root, base) {
399			return nil, fmt.Errorf("merged-worktree base %s does not resolve to a commit", base)
400		}
401	
402		claimed := make(map[string]inventory.Row)
403		for _, row := range rows {
404			if row.Task == nil || row.Checkout == "" {
405				continue
406			}
407			canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(row.Checkout)
408			if canonicalErr == nil {
409				claimed[canonical] = row
410			}
411		}
412		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, repository.Root)
413		if err != nil {
414			return nil, err
415		}
416		var suggestions []suggestion
417		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
418			if worktree.Main || worktree.Bare || worktree.Detached || worktree.Branch == "" || worktree.Branch == base {
419				continue
420			}
421			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", worktree.Branch, base); err != nil {
422				continue
423			}
424			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
425			if err != nil {
426				continue
427			}
428			if row, ok := claimed[canonical]; ok {
429				if row.Task.State == task.Done {
430					suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestFor(app, ctx, row, 0, options)...)
431					continue
432				}
433				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
434					fmt.Sprintf("task is %s; verify integration with `dev done --merged` first", row.Task.State)))
435				continue
436			}
437	
438			synthetic := &task.Task{
439				ID: task.MakeID(repository.Name, worktree.Branch), Name: worktree.Branch,
440				Repo: repository.Name, RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, Branch: worktree.Branch,
441				Base: base, WorktreePath: canonical, Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Done,
442			}
443			row := inventory.Row{Task: synthetic, Checkout: canonical, CheckoutExists: true}
444			if worktree.Locked {
445				reason := "worktree is locked"
446				if worktree.LockedReason != "" {
447					reason += ": " + worktree.LockedReason
448				}
449				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, reason))
450				continue
451			}
452			if worktree.Prunable {
453				reason := "worktree registration is prunable"
454				if worktree.PrunableReason != "" {
455					reason += ": " + worktree.PrunableReason
456				}
457				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, reason))
458				continue
459			}
460			worktreeStatus, statusErr := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, canonical)
461			if statusErr != nil {
462				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, statusErr.Error()))
463				continue
464			}
465			row.Status = worktreeStatus
466			if worktreeStatus.Dirty() {
467				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
468					fmt.Sprintf("worktree is dirty (%s)", worktreeStatus.Breakdown())))
469				continue
470			}
471			if operation, active, operationErr := gitx.InProgress(canonical); operationErr != nil {
472				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, operationErr.Error()))
473				continue
474			} else if active {
475				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
476					fmt.Sprintf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)))
477				continue
478			}
479			if artifactErr := ensureArtifactsFinalized(app, canonical); artifactErr != nil {
480				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, artifactErr.Error()))
481				continue
482			}
483			inspection, inspectErr := retirement.Inspect(ctx, app.Runtime(), canonical, retirement.Options{
484				CloseUnknown: options.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.assumeNoRuntime,
485			})
486			if inspectErr != nil {
487				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, inspectErr.Error()))
488				continue
489			}
490			if !inspection.Ready() {
491				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, strings.Join(inspection.Blockers, "; ")))
492				continue
493			}
494	
495			branch := worktree.Branch
496			checkout := canonical
497			action := fmt.Sprintf("retire merged worktree %s", config.Contract(checkout))
498			if options.deleteBranches {
499				action += fmt.Sprintf(" and delete %s", branch)
500			}
501			suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestion{
502				row: row, reason: fmt.Sprintf("untracked worktree branch is contained in %s", base), action: action,
503				apply: func() error {
504					service := &retirement.Service{Runtime: app.Runtime()}
505					_, err := service.Retire(ctx, retirement.Request{
506						Target: retirement.Target{
507							RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, CheckoutPath: checkout,
508							Branch: branch, Base: base, LinkedWorktree: true,
509						},
510						Safety: retirement.Options{
511							CloseUnknown: options.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.assumeNoRuntime,
512						},
513						DeleteBranch: options.deleteBranches,
514					})
515					return err
516				},
517			})
518		}
519		return suggestions, nil
520	}

522	func mergedWorktreeBlocker(row inventory.Row, base, blocker string) suggestion {
523		return suggestion{

525			action: blocker + " — not changed automatically",

529	func confirm(app *App, in *bufio.Reader, action string) bool {
530		s := app.outStyle()
531		prompt := s.prompt(action + "?")
532		lower := strings.ToLower(action)
533		if strings.Contains(lower, "delete") || strings.Contains(lower, "remove") ||
534			strings.Contains(lower, "discard") || strings.Contains(lower, "drop") {
535			prompt = s.danger(action + "?")
536		}
537		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s ", prompt, s.dim("[y/N]"))
538		line, err := in.ReadString('\n')
539		if err != nil {
540			return false
541		}
542		answer := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(line))
543		return answer == "y" || answer == "yes"
544	}

546	type ephemeralSweepOptions struct {
547		apply                  bool
548		staleDays              int
549		json                   bool
550		baseRef                string
551		baseExplicit           bool
552		yesChanged             bool
553		closeUnknownChanged    bool
554		assumeNoRuntimeChanged bool
555		deleteBranches         bool
556	}
557	
558	func runEphemeralSweep(ctx context.Context, app *App, _ *cobra.Command, options ephemeralSweepOptions) error {
559		switch {
560		case options.staleDays < 1:
561			return fmt.Errorf("--stale-days must be at least 1 for --ephemeral-worktrees")
562		case options.json && options.apply:
563			return fmt.Errorf("--json is report-only and cannot be combined with --apply")
564		case options.yesChanged:
565			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --yes; each item requires confirmation")
566		case options.closeUnknownChanged:
567			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --close-unknown")
568		case options.assumeNoRuntimeChanged:
569			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --assume-no-runtime")
570		case options.apply && app.noRuntime:
571			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees cannot apply with --no-runtime")
572		case options.deleteBranches && !options.apply:
573			return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branches with --ephemeral-worktrees requires --apply")
574		case options.deleteBranches && (!options.baseExplicit || strings.TrimSpace(options.baseRef) == ""):
575			return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branches with --ephemeral-worktrees requires an explicit --base")
576		case options.apply && !app.interactive():
577			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees --apply requires an interactive terminal")
578		}
579	
580		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
581		if err != nil || home == "" {
582			return fmt.Errorf("resolve home directory for Claude Workflow metadata")
583		}
584		service := ephemeral.NewService(
585			claudeworkflow.New(filepath.Join(home, ".claude", "projects")),
586			ephemeral.ServiceOptions{
587				Tasks: app.Tasks, Artifacts: artifactStore(app), Runtimes: ephemeralSweepRuntimes(app),
588				RuntimeDisabled: app.noRuntime,
589			},
590		)
591		report, err := service.Report(ctx, ephemeral.ReportRequest{
592			RepoPath: mustGetwd(), StaleDays: options.staleDays,
593			BaseRef: options.baseRef, BaseExplicit: options.baseExplicit, DeleteBranches: options.deleteBranches,
594		})
595		if err != nil {
596			return err
597		}
598		if options.json {
599			encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
600			encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
601			return encoder.Encode(report)
602		}
603		renderEphemeralReport(app, report)
604		if !options.apply {
605			return nil
606		}
607	
608		reader := bufio.NewReader(app.In)
609		var approved []string
610		for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
611			if candidate.Classification != ephemeral.Eligible {
612				continue
613			}
614			action := "remove ephemeral worktree " + config.Contract(candidate.Path) + " (branch retained)"
615			if candidate.BranchDeletion.Requested && candidate.BranchDeletion.Safe {
616				action = "remove ephemeral worktree " + config.Contract(candidate.Path) + " and delete branch " + candidate.Branch
617			}
618			if confirm(app, reader, action) {
619				approved = append(approved, candidate.Fingerprint)
620			}
621		}
622		if len(approved) == 0 {
623			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, app.outStyle().dim("No eligible worktree was approved; nothing changed."))
624			return nil
625		}
626		result, err := service.Apply(ctx, ephemeral.ApplyRequest{Report: report, Fingerprints: approved})
627		if err != nil {
628			return err
629		}
630		renderEphemeralApply(app, result)
631		return nil
632	}
