634	func ephemeralSweepRuntimes(app *App) []runtime.Runtime {
635		if app.runtimeInstance != nil {
636			return []runtime.Runtime{app.runtimeInstance}
637		}
638		out := make([]runtime.Runtime, 0, 3)
639		for _, name := range []string{"herdr", "tmux", "zellij"} {
640			out = append(out, app.runtimeNamed(name))
641		}
642		return out
643	}
644	
645	func renderEphemeralReport(app *App, report ephemeral.Report) {
646		style := app.outStyle()
647		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%s\n", style.title("Verified ephemeral worktree report (schema v1)"))
648		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "Repository: %s\n", config.Contract(report.Repository.Root))
649		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "Candidates: %d (%d eligible, %d blocked, %d unknown, %d report-only)\n",
650			report.Summary.Total, report.Summary.Eligible, report.Summary.Blocked,
651			report.Summary.Unknown, report.Summary.NotApplicable)
652		for _, capability := range report.Capabilities {
653			if !capability.Available {
654				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  capability unavailable: %s\n", capability.Name)
655			}
656		}
657		for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
658			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n  %-14s %s\n", strings.ToUpper(string(candidate.Classification)), config.Contract(candidate.Path))
659			if candidate.Provider != "" {
660				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    provider=%s run=%s agent=%s workflow=%s agent-state=%s\n",
661					candidate.Provider, candidate.RunID, candidate.AgentID, candidate.WorkflowState, candidate.AgentState)
662			}
663			if candidate.LastActivityKnown {
664				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    last activity: %s\n", candidate.LastActivity.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339))
665			} else {
666				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "    last activity: unknown")
667			}
668			for _, check := range candidate.Checks {
669				if check.Classification != ephemeral.Eligible {
670					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    %s: %s — %s\n", check.ID, check.Classification, check.Detail)
671				}
672			}
673			for _, action := range candidate.PlannedActions {
674				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    %s: %s (%s)\n", action.Kind, action.Status, action.Detail)
675			}
676		}
677		if report.Summary.Eligible == 0 {
678			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("\nNo eligible ephemeral worktree was found; report-only entries were not changed."))
679		} else {
680			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("\nRe-run with --apply from an interactive terminal; every eligible item is confirmed separately."))
681		}
682	}
683	
684	func renderEphemeralApply(app *App, result ephemeral.ApplyResult) {
685		style := app.outStyle()
686		for _, item := range result.Results {
687			switch item.Status {
688			case ephemeral.ApplyRemoved:
689				branch := "branch retained"
690				if item.DeletedBranch {
691					branch = "branch deleted"
692				}
693				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s (%s)\n", style.success("removed:"), config.Contract(item.Path), branch)
694			case ephemeral.ApplyPartial:
695				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s — %s\n", style.warning("partial:"), config.Contract(item.Path), item.Detail)
696			case ephemeral.ApplySkippedChanged:
697				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s — %s\n", style.warning("skipped-changed:"), config.Contract(item.Path), item.Detail)
698			default:
699				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s — %s\n", style.warning("failed:"), config.Contract(item.Path), item.Detail)
700			}
701		}
702	}

18	// EphemeralCheckout is the read-only Git cleanliness evidence needed by the
19	// ephemeral cleanup service. It retains counts and a digest, never pathnames.
20	type EphemeralCheckout struct {
21		Status          Status
22		Ignored         int
23		DirtySubmodules int
24		Fingerprint     string
25	}
26	
27	// InspectEphemeralCheckout reads full porcelain status, including all
28	// untracked files and non-ignored submodule state, plus Git's ignored-file
29	// inventory. Initialized submodules are inspected recursively so ignored files
30	// cannot hide behind the parent repository boundary. No command changes an
31	// index or worktree.
32	func InspectEphemeralCheckout(ctx context.Context, dir string) (EphemeralCheckout, error) {
33		return inspectEphemeralCheckout(ctx, dir, make(map[string]bool))
34	}
35	
36	func inspectEphemeralCheckout(ctx context.Context, dir string, seen map[string]bool) (EphemeralCheckout, error) {
37		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
38		if err != nil {
39			return EphemeralCheckout{}, err
40		}
41		if seen[canonical] {
42			return EphemeralCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("recursive submodule checkout path %s", canonical)
43		}
44		seen[canonical] = true
45		defer delete(seen, canonical)
46	
47		statusOutput, err := run(ctx, canonical,
48			"status", "--porcelain=v2", "--branch", "--untracked-files=all", "--ignore-submodules=none", "-z")
49		if err != nil {
50			return EphemeralCheckout{}, err
51		}
52		ignoredOutput, err := run(ctx, canonical,
53			"ls-files", "--others", "--ignored", "--exclude-standard", "-z")
54		if err != nil {
55			return EphemeralCheckout{}, err
56		}
57		gitlinksOutput, err := run(ctx, canonical, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z")
58		if err != nil {
59			return EphemeralCheckout{}, err
60		}
61	
62		ignored := nonEmptyNULRecords(ignoredOutput)
63		dirtyPaths := submoduleDirtyPaths(statusOutput)
64		dirtySubmodules := 0
65		var childFingerprints []string
66		for _, submodulePath := range gitlinkPaths(gitlinksOutput) {
67			joined := filepath.Join(canonical, filepath.FromSlash(submodulePath))
68			child, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(canonical, joined)
69			if err != nil {
70				return EphemeralCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("validate submodule path: %w", err)
71			}
72			info, err := os.Lstat(child)
73			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
74				dirtySubmodules++
75				childFingerprints = append(childFingerprints, digestEphemeral(submodulePath, "missing"))
76				continue
77			}
78			if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.IsDir() {
79				return EphemeralCheckout{}, fmt.Errorf("inspect submodule checkout")
80			}
81			childInspection, err := inspectEphemeralCheckout(ctx, child, seen)
82			if err != nil {
83				return EphemeralCheckout{}, err
84			}
85			ignored += childInspection.Ignored
86			childDirty := dirtyPaths[submodulePath] || childInspection.Status.Dirty() ||
87				childInspection.Ignored > 0 || childInspection.DirtySubmodules > 0
88			if childDirty {
89				dirtySubmodules++
90			}
91			dirtySubmodules += childInspection.DirtySubmodules
92			childFingerprints = append(childFingerprints, digestEphemeral(submodulePath, childInspection.Fingerprint))
93		}
94		sort.Strings(childFingerprints)
95		fingerprintParts := []string{statusOutput, ignoredOutput, gitlinksOutput}
96		fingerprintParts = append(fingerprintParts, childFingerprints...)
97		return EphemeralCheckout{
98			Status:          statusFromOutput(canonical, statusOutput),
99			Ignored:         ignored,
100			DirtySubmodules: dirtySubmodules,
101			Fingerprint:     digestEphemeral(fingerprintParts...),
102		}, nil
103	}
104	
105	func nonEmptyNULRecords(output string) int {
106		count := 0
107		for _, record := range nulLines(output) {
108			if record != "" {
109				count++
110			}
111		}
112		return count
113	}
114	
115	func submoduleDirtyCount(output string) int { return len(submoduleDirtyPaths(output)) }
116	
117	func submoduleDirtyPaths(output string) map[string]bool {
118		paths := make(map[string]bool)
119		for _, record := range nulLines(output) {
120			if record == "" || (record[0] != '1' && record[0] != '2') {
121				continue
122			}
123			fields := strings.Fields(record)
124			if len(fields) > 2 && strings.HasPrefix(fields[2], "S") {
125				if path := statusPath(record); path != "" {
126					paths[filepath.ToSlash(path)] = true
127				}
128			}
129		}
130		return paths
131	}
132	
133	func gitlinkPaths(output string) []string {
134		var paths []string
135		for _, record := range nulLines(output) {
136			metadata, path, ok := strings.Cut(record, "\t")
137			if !ok || path == "" {
138				continue
139			}
140			fields := strings.Fields(metadata)
141			if len(fields) == 3 && fields[0] == "160000" && fields[2] == "0" {
142				paths = append(paths, filepath.ToSlash(path))
143			}
144		}
145		sort.Strings(paths)
146		return paths
147	}
148	
149	func digestEphemeral(parts ...string) string {
150		hash := sha256.New()
151		for _, part := range parts {
152			hash.Write([]byte(part))
153			hash.Write([]byte{0})
154		}
155		return hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))
156	}

+
+func runEphemeralSweep(ctx context.Context, app *App, _ *cobra.Command, options ephemeralSweepOptions) error {
+	switch {
+	case options.staleDays < 1:
+		return fmt.Errorf("--stale-days must be at least 1 for --ephemeral-worktrees")
+	case options.json && options.apply:
+		return fmt.Errorf("--json is report-only and cannot be combined with --apply")
+	case options.yesChanged:
+		return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --yes; each item requires confirmation")
+	case options.closeUnknownChanged:
+		return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --close-unknown")
+	case options.assumeNoRuntimeChanged:
+		return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --assume-no-runtime")
+	case options.apply && app.noRuntime:
+		return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees cannot apply with --no-runtime")
+	case options.deleteBranches && !options.apply:
+		return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branches with --ephemeral-worktrees requires --apply")
+	case options.deleteBranches && (!options.baseExplicit || strings.TrimSpace(options.baseRef) == ""):
+		return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branches with --ephemeral-worktrees requires an explicit --base")
+	case options.apply && !app.interactive():
+		return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees --apply requires an interactive terminal")
+	}
+
+	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
+	if err != nil || home == "" {
+		return fmt.Errorf("resolve home directory for Claude Workflow metadata")
+	}
+	service := ephemeral.NewService(
+		claudeworkflow.New(filepath.Join(home, ".claude", "projects")),
+		ephemeral.ServiceOptions{
+			Tasks: app.Tasks, Artifacts: artifactStore(app), Runtimes: ephemeralSweepRuntimes(app),
+			RuntimeDisabled: app.noRuntime,
+		},
+	)
+	report, err := service.Report(ctx, ephemeral.ReportRequest{
+		RepoPath: mustGetwd(), StaleDays: options.staleDays,
+		BaseRef: options.baseRef, BaseExplicit: options.baseExplicit, DeleteBranches: options.deleteBranches,
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if options.json {
+		encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
+		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
+		return encoder.Encode(report)
+	}
+	renderEphemeralReport(app, report)
+	if !options.apply {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	reader := bufio.NewReader(app.In)
+	var approved []string
+	for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
+		if candidate.Classification != ephemeral.Eligible {
+			continue
+		}
+		action := "remove ephemeral worktree " + config.Contract(candidate.Path) + " (branch retained)"
+		if candidate.BranchDeletion.Requested && candidate.BranchDeletion.Safe {
+			action = "remove ephemeral worktree " + config.Contract(candidate.Path) + " and delete branch " + candidate.Branch
+		}
+		if confirm(app, reader, action) {
+			approved = append(approved, candidate.Fingerprint)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(approved) == 0 {
+		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, app.outStyle().dim("No eligible worktree was approved; nothing changed."))
+		return nil
+	}
+	result, err := service.Apply(ctx, ephemeral.ApplyRequest{Report: report, Fingerprints: approved})
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	renderEphemeralApply(app, result)
+	return nil
+}

+func ephemeralSweepRuntimes(app *App) []runtime.Runtime {
+	if app.runtimeInstance != nil {
+		return []runtime.Runtime{app.runtimeInstance}
+	}
+	out := make([]runtime.Runtime, 0, 3)
+	for _, name := range []string{"herdr", "tmux", "zellij"} {
+		out = append(out, app.runtimeNamed(name))
+	}
+	return out
+}

+func renderEphemeralReport(app *App, report ephemeral.Report) {
+	style := app.outStyle()
+	fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%s\n", style.title("Verified ephemeral worktree report (schema v1)"))
+	fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "Repository: %s\n", config.Contract(report.Repository.Root))
+	fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "Candidates: %d (%d eligible, %d blocked, %d unknown, %d report-only)\n",
+		report.Summary.Total, report.Summary.Eligible, report.Summary.Blocked,
+		report.Summary.Unknown, report.Summary.NotApplicable)
+	for _, capability := range report.Capabilities {
+		if !capability.Available {
+			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  capability unavailable: %s\n", capability.Name)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
+		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n  %-14s %s\n", strings.ToUpper(string(candidate.Classification)), config.Contract(candidate.Path))
+		if candidate.Provider != "" {
+			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    provider=%s run=%s agent=%s workflow=%s agent-state=%s\n",
+				candidate.Provider, candidate.RunID, candidate.AgentID, candidate.WorkflowState, candidate.AgentState)
+		}
+		if candidate.LastActivityKnown {
+			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    last activity: %s\n", candidate.LastActivity.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339))
+		} else {
+			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "    last activity: unknown")
+		}
+		for _, check := range candidate.Checks {
+			if check.Classification != ephemeral.Eligible {
+				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    %s: %s — %s\n", check.ID, check.Classification, check.Detail)
+			}
+		}
+		for _, action := range candidate.PlannedActions {
+			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    %s: %s (%s)\n", action.Kind, action.Status, action.Detail)
+		}
+	}
+	if report.Summary.Eligible == 0 {
+		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("\nNo eligible ephemeral worktree was found; report-only entries were not changed."))
+	} else {
+		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("\nRe-run with --apply from an interactive terminal; every eligible item is confirmed separately."))
+	}
+}
+
+func renderEphemeralApply(app *App, result ephemeral.ApplyResult) {
+	style := app.outStyle()
+	for _, item := range result.Results {
+		switch item.Status {
+		case ephemeral.ApplyRemoved:
+			branch := "branch retained"
+			if item.DeletedBranch {
+				branch = "branch deleted"
+			}
+			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s (%s)\n", style.success("removed:"), config.Contract(item.Path), branch)
+		case ephemeral.ApplyPartial:
+			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s — %s\n", style.warning("partial:"), config.Contract(item.Path), item.Detail)
+		case ephemeral.ApplySkippedChanged:
+			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s — %s\n", style.warning("skipped-changed:"), config.Contract(item.Path), item.Detail)
+		default:
+			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s — %s\n", style.warning("failed:"), config.Contract(item.Path), item.Detail)
+		}
+	}
+}

36	// Audit applies pure V1 policy to already-collected facts. Known blockers
37	// outrank unknown observations. A structurally absent/prunable/non-provider
38	// target is report-only and therefore not applicable rather than eligible.
39	func Audit(in AuditInput) AuditResult {
40		checks := []Check{
41			booleanCheck(CheckProviderOwned, in.ProviderOwned, "provider ownership is verified", "candidate is not owned by the provider", "provider ownership was not verified", NotApplicable),
42			booleanCheck(CheckProviderUnique, in.ProviderUnique, "provider claim is unique", "provider claims are duplicated or ambiguous", "provider claim uniqueness is unknown", Blocked),
43			booleanCheck(CheckProviderMapping, in.ProviderMapping, "provider mapping exactly matches", "provider mapping does not match", "provider mapping is unknown", Blocked),
44			booleanCheck(CheckProviderIdentity, in.ProviderIdentity, "provider-observed Git identity matches the live registration", "provider-observed Git identity does not match the live registration", "provider metadata does not bind branch, HEAD, common-dir, and registration identity", Blocked),
45			v1UnknownCheck(CheckWorkflowTerminal, in.WorkflowTerminal, "workflow is terminal", "workflow is non-terminal or has ambiguous terminal state", "workflow terminal state is unknown"),
46			v1UnknownCheck(CheckAgentDone, in.AgentDone, "agent state is done", "agent state is not done", "agent state is unknown"),
47			v1UnknownCheck(CheckJournalStarted, in.JournalStarted, "matching started record exists", "matching started record is absent", "matching started record is unknown"),
48			v1UnknownCheck(CheckJournalResult, in.JournalResult, "matching result record exists", "matching result record is absent", "matching result record is unknown"),
49			v1UnknownCheck(CheckNotResumed, in.NotResumed, "same-ID resumed transcript is absent", "same-ID resumed transcript exists", "same-ID resume state is unknown"),
50			booleanCheck(CheckProviderInactive, in.ProviderInactive, "provider activity is older than the threshold", "provider activity is newer than the threshold", "provider activity time is unknown", Blocked),
51			booleanCheck(CheckRegistered, in.Registered, "checkout is registered", "provider path is not registered", "worktree registration is unknown", NotApplicable),
52			booleanCheck(CheckPathPresent, in.PathPresent, "checkout path is present", "checkout path is missing", "checkout path presence is unknown", NotApplicable),
53			booleanCheck(CheckLinkedWorktree, in.LinkedWorktree, "checkout is a linked worktree", "checkout is not a linked worktree", "linked-worktree identity is unknown", NotApplicable),
54			booleanCheck(CheckNonMain, in.NonMain, "checkout is not canonical", "canonical checkout removal is not applicable", "canonical-checkout identity is unknown", NotApplicable),
55			booleanCheck(CheckBranchNamed, in.BranchNamed, "worktree has a named branch", "worktree is detached or unnamed", "branch identity is unknown", Blocked),
56			booleanCheck(CheckBranchMatches, in.BranchMatches, "registry and live branch agree", "registry and live branch differ", "live branch agreement is unknown", Blocked),
57			booleanCheck(CheckCommonDir, in.CommonDirMatches, "checkout common-dir matches the repository", "checkout belongs to another common-dir", "checkout common-dir is unknown", Blocked),
58			booleanCheck(CheckHeadMatches, in.HeadMatches, "registry and live HEAD agree", "registry and live HEAD differ", "live HEAD agreement is unknown", Blocked),
59			booleanCheck(CheckUnlocked, in.Unlocked, "worktree is unlocked", "worktree is locked", "worktree lock state is unknown", Blocked),
60			booleanCheck(CheckNotPrunable, in.NotPrunable, "worktree registration is not prunable", "worktree registration is prunable", "prunable state is unknown", NotApplicable),
61			booleanCheck(CheckClean, in.Clean, "checkout has no staged, unstaged, conflicted, or untracked paths", "checkout has staged, unstaged, conflicted, or untracked paths", "checkout cleanliness is unknown", Blocked),
62			booleanCheck(CheckIgnoredEmpty, in.IgnoredEmpty, "checkout has no ignored files", "checkout contains ignored files", "ignored-file inventory is unknown", Blocked),
63			booleanCheck(CheckSubmodulesClean, in.SubmodulesClean, "submodule state is clean", "submodule state is dirty or conflicted", "submodule state is unknown", Blocked),
64			booleanCheck(CheckNoGitOperation, in.NoGitOperation, "no Git operation is in progress", "a Git operation is in progress", "Git operation state is unknown", Blocked),
65			booleanCheck(CheckTaskUnclaimed, in.TaskUnclaimed, "no task claims the checkout or branch", "a persisted task claims the checkout or branch", "task claims are unknown", Blocked),
66			knownCheck(CheckArtifactsKnown, in.ArtifactsKnown, "artifact inventory is known", "artifact inventory is unknown"),
67			booleanCheck(CheckArtifactsSafe, in.ArtifactsSafe, "all artifact intents are discarded or finalized and reachable", "an artifact intent is not discarded or finalized and reachable", "artifact safety is unknown", Blocked),
68			booleanCheck(CheckCallerOutside, in.CallerOutside, "caller is outside the target", "caller is inside the target", "caller containment is unknown", Blocked),
69			knownCheck(CheckRuntimeKnown, in.RuntimeKnown, "every available runtime was inventoried", "runtime inventory is unknown"),
70			booleanCheck(CheckRuntimeClear, in.RuntimeClear, "no runtime session covers the target", "a runtime session covers the target", "runtime coverage is unknown", Blocked),

73		// Explicit report-only structural outcomes dominate ordinary eligibility but
74		// never turn unknown provider evidence into not-applicable.
75		for _, id := range []string{CheckProviderOwned, CheckRegistered, CheckPathPresent, CheckLinkedWorktree, CheckNonMain, CheckNotPrunable} {
76			if status(checks, id) == NotApplicable {

83	func booleanCheck(id string, fact Fact, yes, no, unknown string, falseClass Classification) Check {
84		if !fact.Known {
85			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
86		}
87		if fact.Value {
88			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
89		}
90		return Check{ID: id, Classification: falseClass, Detail: no}
91	}
92	
93	func knownCheck(id string, fact Fact, yes, unknown string) Check {
94		if !fact.Known {
95			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
96		}
97		if !fact.Value {
98			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
99		}
100		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
101	}
102	
103	// V1 refuses to distinguish a known absent liveness record from uncertainty:
104	// both require stronger upstream evidence and have no attestation bypass.
105	func v1UnknownCheck(id string, fact Fact, yes, no, unknown string) Check {
106		if !fact.Known {
107			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: unknown}
108		}
109		if !fact.Value {
110			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Unknown, Detail: no}
111		}
112		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
113	}
114	
115	func aggregate(checks []Check) Classification {
116		result := Eligible
117		for _, check := range checks {
118			switch check.Classification {
119			case Blocked:
120				return Blocked
121			case Unknown:
122				result = Unknown
123			}
124		}
125		return result
126	}
127	
128	func status(checks []Check, id string) Classification {
129		for _, check := range checks {
130			if check.ID == id {
131				return check.Classification
132			}
133		}
134		return Unknown
135	}

286	func structuralGitFacts(target Target, worktreesKnown bool) GitFacts {
287		facts := GitFacts{NonMain: KnownFact(!target.Main)}
288		if worktreesKnown && target.RegistrationKnown {
289			facts.Registered = KnownFact(target.Registered)
290			facts.LinkedWorktree = KnownFact(target.Registered && !target.Main && !target.Bare)
291			facts.BranchNamed = KnownFact(target.Branch != "" && !target.Detached)
292			facts.Unlocked = KnownFact(!target.Locked)
293			facts.NotPrunable = KnownFact(!target.Prunable)
294		}
295		return facts
296	}
297	
298	func mergeStructuralGitFacts(facts GitFacts, target Target, worktreesKnown bool) GitFacts {
299		fallback := structuralGitFacts(target, worktreesKnown)
300		for current, replacement := range map[*Fact]Fact{
301			&facts.Registered: fallback.Registered, &facts.LinkedWorktree: fallback.LinkedWorktree,
302			&facts.NonMain: fallback.NonMain, &facts.BranchNamed: fallback.BranchNamed,
303			&facts.Unlocked: fallback.Unlocked, &facts.NotPrunable: fallback.NotPrunable,
304		} {
305			if !current.Known {
306				*current = replacement
307			}
308		}
309		return facts
310	}

392	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, request ApplyRequest) (ApplyResult, error) {
393		if request.Report.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
394			return ApplyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported ephemeral report schema %d", request.Report.SchemaVersion)
395		}
396		if len(request.Fingerprints) == 0 {
397			return ApplyResult{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Repository: request.Report.Repository, Results: []ApplyCandidateResult{}}, nil
398		}
399		repository, err := s.backend.discover(ctx, request.Report.Repository.Root)
400		if err != nil {
401			return ApplyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("rediscover canonical repository: %w", err)
402		}
403		if repository.Linked || repository.Identity.Bare || repository.Identity.Root != request.Report.Repository.Root ||
404			repository.Identity.CommonDir != request.Report.Repository.CommonDir {
405			return ApplyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("repository identity changed since the report")
406		}
407		selected := make(map[string]bool, len(request.Fingerprints))
408		for _, fingerprint := range request.Fingerprints {
409			selected[fingerprint] = true
410		}
411		result := ApplyResult{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Repository: repository.Identity, Results: []ApplyCandidateResult{}}
412		err = s.backend.withCleanupLock(ctx, repository.Identity.CommonDir, func() error {
413			if s.beforeRevalidate != nil {
414				s.beforeRevalidate()
415			}
416			for _, prior := range request.Report.Candidates {
417				if !selected[prior.Fingerprint] {
418					continue
419				}
420				fresh, err := s.Report(ctx, ReportRequest{
421					RepoPath: request.Report.Repository.Root, StaleDays: request.Report.StaleDays,
422					BaseRef: request.Report.BaseRef, BaseExplicit: request.Report.BaseExplicit,
423					DeleteBranches: request.Report.DeleteBranches,
424				})
425				if err != nil {
426					return fmt.Errorf("recollect cleanup report: %w", err)
427				}
428				current, exists := findCandidate(fresh.Candidates, candidateKey(prior))
429				item := ApplyCandidateResult{Path: prior.Path, Branch: prior.Branch, BranchRetained: prior.Branch != ""}
430				if prior.Classification != Eligible || !exists || current.Classification != Eligible || current.Fingerprint != prior.Fingerprint {
431					item.Status = ApplySkippedChanged
432					item.Detail = "candidate evidence changed after the report; nothing was removed"
433					result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
434					continue
435				}
436				if err := s.backend.removeWorktree(ctx, repository, prior.Path); err != nil {
437					item.Status = ApplyFailed
438					item.Detail = "plain non-force worktree removal was refused"
439					result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
440					continue
441				}
442				item.RemovedWorktree = true
443				if err := s.backend.verifyRemoved(ctx, repository, prior.Path); err != nil {
444					item.Status = ApplyFailed
445					item.Detail = "worktree removal could not be verified; branch was retained"
446					result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
447					continue
448				}
449				if prior.BranchDeletion.Requested {
450					if !prior.BranchDeletion.Safe || !current.BranchDeletion.Safe {
451						item.Status = ApplyPartial
452						item.Detail = "worktree removed; branch retained because deletion proof was unsafe"
453						result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
454						continue
455					}
456					state, stateErr := s.backend.branchState(ctx, repository, prior.BranchDeletion.BaseRef, prior.Branch)
457					if stateErr != nil || state.BaseHead != prior.BranchDeletion.BaseHead || state.BranchTip != prior.BranchDeletion.BranchTip || state.BranchOnly != 0 {
458						item.Status = ApplyPartial
459						item.Detail = "worktree removed; branch or base proof changed, so the branch was retained"
460						result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
461						continue
462					}
463					if err := s.backend.deleteBranch(ctx, repository, prior.Branch); err != nil {
464						item.Status = ApplyPartial
465						item.Detail = "worktree removed; safe branch -d did not complete, so the branch was retained"
466						result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
467						continue
468					}
469					item.DeletedBranch, item.BranchRetained = true, false
470				}
471				item.Status = ApplyRemoved
472				item.Detail = "worktree removed after locked revalidation"
473				result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
474			}
475			return nil
476		})
477		if err != nil {
478			return result, err
479		}
480		return result, nil
481	}

483	func findCandidate(candidates []Candidate, key string) (Candidate, bool) {
484		for _, candidate := range candidates {
485			if candidateKey(candidate) == key {
486				return candidate, true
487			}
488		}
489		return Candidate{}, false
490	}
491	
492	func candidateKey(candidate Candidate) string {
493		return strings.Join([]string{candidate.Provider, candidate.SessionID, candidate.RunID, candidate.AgentID, candidate.Path}, "\x00")
494	}

830			}

834		if err != nil {
835			return "", false, failure("invalid-worktree-path")
836		}

838			return canonical, true, nil
839		}
840		insideRepository, err := pathx.Contains(query.Repository.Root, canonical)

843		}

845			return "", false, failure("invalid-worktree-path")
846		}
847		return canonical, false, nil
848	}

131		facts.StateFingerprint = inspection.Fingerprint

135		}

137		if active {

558	func runEphemeralSweep(ctx context.Context, app *App, _ *cobra.Command, options ephemeralSweepOptions) error {
559		switch {
560		case options.staleDays < 1:
561			return fmt.Errorf("--stale-days must be at least 1 for --ephemeral-worktrees")
562		case options.json && options.apply:
563			return fmt.Errorf("--json is report-only and cannot be combined with --apply")
564		case options.yesChanged:
565			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --yes; each item requires confirmation")
566		case options.closeUnknownChanged:
567			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --close-unknown")
568		case options.assumeNoRuntimeChanged:
569			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --assume-no-runtime")
570		case options.apply && app.noRuntime:
571			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees cannot apply with --no-runtime")
572		case options.deleteBranches && !options.apply:
573			return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branches with --ephemeral-worktrees requires --apply")
574		case options.deleteBranches && (!options.baseExplicit || strings.TrimSpace(options.baseRef) == ""):
575			return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branches with --ephemeral-worktrees requires an explicit --base")
576		case options.apply && !app.interactive():
577			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees --apply requires an interactive terminal")
578		}
579	
580		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
581		if err != nil || home == "" {
582			return fmt.Errorf("resolve home directory for Claude Workflow metadata")
583		}
584		service := ephemeral.NewService(
585			claudeworkflow.New(filepath.Join(home, ".claude", "projects")),
586			ephemeral.ServiceOptions{
587				Tasks: app.Tasks, Artifacts: artifactStore(app), Runtimes: ephemeralSweepRuntimes(app),
588				RuntimeDisabled: app.noRuntime,
589			},
590		)
591		report, err := service.Report(ctx, ephemeral.ReportRequest{
592			RepoPath: mustGetwd(), StaleDays: options.staleDays,
593			BaseRef: options.baseRef, BaseExplicit: options.baseExplicit, DeleteBranches: options.deleteBranches,
594		})
595		if err != nil {
596			return err
597		}
598		if options.json {
599			encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
600			encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
601			return encoder.Encode(report)
602		}
603		renderEphemeralReport(app, report)
604		if !options.apply {
605			return nil
606		}
607	
608		reader := bufio.NewReader(app.In)
609		var approved []string
610		for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
611			if candidate.Classification != ephemeral.Eligible {
612				continue
613			}
614			action := "remove ephemeral worktree " + config.Contract(candidate.Path) + " (branch retained)"
615			if candidate.BranchDeletion.Requested && candidate.BranchDeletion.Safe {
616				action = "remove ephemeral worktree " + config.Contract(candidate.Path) + " and delete branch " + candidate.Branch
617			}
618			if confirm(app, reader, action) {
619				approved = append(approved, candidate.Fingerprint)
620			}
621		}
622		if len(approved) == 0 {
623			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, app.outStyle().dim("No eligible worktree was approved; nothing changed."))
624			return nil
625		}
626		result, err := service.Apply(ctx, ephemeral.ApplyRequest{Report: report, Fingerprints: approved})
627		if err != nil {
628			return err
629		}
630		renderEphemeralApply(app, result)

102			return facts, fmt.Errorf("checkout path is not a regular directory")
103		}
104		checkoutRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, target.Path)
105		if err != nil {
106			return facts, err
107		}

119		liveHead, err := gitx.Run(ctx, target.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
120		if err != nil {

122		}
123		facts.LiveHead = liveHead
124		facts.HeadMatches = KnownFact(target.RegistryHead != "" && liveHead == target.RegistryHead)
125		inspection, err := gitx.InspectEphemeralCheckout(ctx, target.Path)
126		if err != nil {

128		}
129		facts.Staged, facts.Unstaged = inspection.Status.Staged, inspection.Status.Unstaged
130		facts.Conflicted, facts.Untracked = inspection.Status.Conflicted, inspection.Status.Untracked
131		facts.Ignored, facts.DirtySubmodules = inspection.Ignored, inspection.DirtySubmodules
132		facts.BranchMatches = KnownFact(inspection.Status.Branch == target.Branch && !inspection.Status.Detached)
133		facts.Clean = KnownFact(!inspection.Status.Dirty())
134		facts.IgnoredEmpty = KnownFact(inspection.Ignored == 0)
135		facts.SubmodulesClean = KnownFact(inspection.DirtySubmodules == 0)
136		facts.StateFingerprint = inspection.Fingerprint
137		operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(target.Path)
138		if err != nil {

140		}

142		if active {

144		}
145		return facts, nil
146	}

## Verdict

**Not a qualifying HIGH/MEDIUM security finding.** The pathname-reuse ownership confusion is real and reproducible, but under the requested impact criteria it is a **Low-severity correctness/data-safety issue**, not a concrete Medium security impact.

**Confidence: 9/10**

## Reasoning

- **Concrete without concurrency:** Yes. A sequential scenario is sufficient:
  1. A provider worktree reaches terminal state and is removed while its metadata remains.
  2. A different linked worktree is later registered at the same path.
  3. The stale claim joins to the new target by pathname.
  4. Stable branch, HEAD, common-dir, cleanliness, and fingerprint checks all describe the replacement and therefore do not detect the ownership substitution.

  The join occurs by pathname in `/Users/zhouhanru/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-pr-ci-scan/internal/ephemeral/service.go:148-159`. The provider adapter accepts any matching registered target before checking the Claude namespace in `/Users/zhouhanru/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-pr-ci-scan/internal/ephemeral/claudeworkflow/adapter.go:818-839`.

- **Why this remains below Medium:** Applying cleanup requires an interactive terminal, rejects `--yes`, displays the target, and requires per-item confirmation in `/Users/zhouhanru/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-pr-ci-scan/internal/cli/sweep.go:558-577` and `:608-620`. Removal is also limited to a clean checkout with no ignored files or dirty submodules and uses non-force `git worktree remove`.

- **Branch retention materially lowers severity:** Yes. The named branch is retained by default in `/Users/zhouhanru/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-pr-ci-scan/internal/ephemeral/service.go:365-379`. Optional deletion is allowed only after an explicit base and proof of zero unique commits at `:314-343`. Consequently, the wrong-target directory/registration removal is real, but tracked work remains reconstructible. Once resource/availability effects are excluded, there is no demonstrated confidentiality loss or meaningful irreversible integrity loss supporting Medium severity.

## Fix assessment

The **proposed design is sufficient only if “registration identity” is genuinely non-replayable**. The latest snapshot correctly makes current Claude 2.1.259 claims `unknown`:

- `provider-git-identity` is mandatory in `/Users/zhouhanru/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-pr-ci-scan/internal/ephemeral/audit.go:39-45`.
- Identity is compared and included through the candidate/fingerprint/revalidation path in `/Users/zhouhanru/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-pr-ci-scan/internal/ephemeral/service.go:206-253` and `:283-295`.
- The Claude adapter supplies no such identity at `/Users/zhouhanru/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-pr-ci-scan/internal/ephemeral/claudeworkflow/adapter.go:342-350`, so current claims remain report-only and cannot be applied.

However, the implementation is **not yet sufficient for a future identity-capable provider**:

1. Namespace containment still occurs after the registered-target fast path, allowing registered paths outside `.claude/worktrees`.
2. `/Users/zhouhanru/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-pr-ci-scan/internal/ephemeral/service_system.go:112-118` uses the canonical GitDir pathname as `RegistrationID`. That pathname can be reused when a worktree with the same basename/path is removed and recreated; with the retained branch, branch and HEAD can also remain identical. It is not a registration generation.

## Necessary correction

- Enforce canonical provider-namespace containment **before** accepting any `query.Targets` match.
- Replace the GitDir pathname with an independently live-verifiable, fresh, never-reused registration nonce or equivalent generation handle recorded by the provider at creation.
- Keep current Claude 2.1.259 claims `unknown`/report-only until that identity exists.

Thus, the stale-binding diagnosis is correct, but the claimed security severity should be downgraded below Medium, and a GitDir pathname must not be described as non-replayable registration identity.

98	func (s *Service) Report(ctx context.Context, request ReportRequest) (Report, error) {
99		if request.StaleDays < 1 {
100			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("stale-days must be at least 1")
101		}
102		if s == nil || s.backend == nil {
103			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("ephemeral service has no live-state backend")
104		}
105		repository, err := s.backend.discover(ctx, request.RepoPath)
106		if err != nil {
107			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("discover canonical repository: %w", err)
108		}
109		if repository.Identity.Bare {
110			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("ephemeral worktree sweep requires a non-bare canonical checkout")
111		}
112		if repository.Linked {
113			return Report{}, fmt.Errorf("ephemeral worktree sweep must run from the canonical checkout")
114		}
115		now := time.Now().UTC()
116		if s.now != nil {
117			now = s.now().UTC()
118		}
119		report := Report{
120			SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, GeneratedAt: now, Repository: repository.Identity,
121			StaleDays: request.StaleDays, BaseRef: request.BaseRef, BaseExplicit: request.BaseExplicit,
122			DeleteBranches: request.DeleteBranches, Capabilities: []Capability{}, Diagnostics: []Diagnostic{}, Candidates: []Candidate{},
123		}
124	
125		targets, worktreeErr := s.backend.worktrees(ctx, repository)
126		worktreesKnown := worktreeErr == nil
127		report.Capabilities = append(report.Capabilities, Capability{
128			Name: "git-worktree-inventory", Available: worktreesKnown, Detail: availabilityDetail(worktreesKnown),
129		})
130		if worktreeErr != nil {
131			report.Diagnostics = append(report.Diagnostics, diagnostic("git", "worktree-inventory-failed", "Git worktree inventory could not be verified"))
132			targets = nil
133		}
134		for i := range targets {
135			targets[i].Registered = true
136			targets[i].RegistrationKnown = true
137		}
138	
139		source := SourceResult{Complete: false}
140		if s.source != nil {
141			source = s.source.Collect(ctx, SourceQuery{Repository: repository.Identity, Targets: targets, Now: now})
142		} else {
143			source.Diagnostics = append(source.Diagnostics, diagnostic("provider", "provider-unavailable", "provider ownership metadata is unavailable"))
144		}
145		report.Capabilities = append(report.Capabilities, source.Capabilities...)
146		report.Diagnostics = append(report.Diagnostics, source.Diagnostics...)
147	
148		byPath := make(map[string]Target, len(targets))
149		for _, target := range targets {
150			byPath[target.Path] = target
151		}
152		claimedPaths := make(map[string]bool)
153		for _, claim := range source.Claims {
154			target, exists := byPath[claim.WorktreePath]
155			if !exists {
156				target = Target{Path: claim.WorktreePath, Registered: false, RegistrationKnown: worktreesKnown, Hint: true}
157			}
158			claimedPaths[claim.WorktreePath] = true
159			candidate, diagnostics, states := s.collectCandidate(ctx, repository, target, &claim, source.Complete, worktreesKnown, request, now)
160			report.Candidates = append(report.Candidates, candidate)
161			report.Diagnostics = append(report.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
162			report.Capabilities = mergeEvidenceCapabilities(report.Capabilities, states)
163		}
164		for _, target := range targets {
165			if !target.Hint || claimedPaths[target.Path] {
166				continue
167			}
168			candidate, diagnostics, states := s.collectCandidate(ctx, repository, target, nil, source.Complete, worktreesKnown, request, now)
169			report.Candidates = append(report.Candidates, candidate)
170			report.Diagnostics = append(report.Diagnostics, diagnostics...)
171			report.Capabilities = mergeEvidenceCapabilities(report.Capabilities, states)
172		}
173	
174		sort.Slice(report.Candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
175			left, right := report.Candidates[i], report.Candidates[j]
176			if left.Path != right.Path {
177				return left.Path < right.Path
178			}
179			if left.RunID != right.RunID {
180				return left.RunID < right.RunID
181			}
182			return left.AgentID < right.AgentID
183		})
184		report.Capabilities = stableCapabilities(report.Capabilities)
185		report.Diagnostics = stableDiagnostics(report.Diagnostics)
186		for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
187			report.Summary.Total++
188			switch candidate.Classification {
189			case Eligible:
190				report.Summary.Eligible++
191			case Blocked:
192				report.Summary.Blocked++
193			case Unknown:
194				report.Summary.Unknown++
195			case NotApplicable:
196				report.Summary.NotApplicable++
197			}
198		}
199		return report, nil
200	}

206	func (s *Service) collectCandidate(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, target Target, claim *Claim,
207		sourceComplete, worktreesKnown bool, request ReportRequest, now time.Time) (Candidate, []Diagnostic, evidenceCapabilities) {
208	
209		candidate := Candidate{Path: target.Path, Branch: target.Branch, RegistryHead: target.RegistryHead}
210		var diagnostics []Diagnostic
211		states := evidenceCapabilities{tasks: true, artifacts: true, caller: true, runtime: true}
212		providerOwned := Fact{}
213		providerUnique, providerMapping, providerIdentity := Fact{}, Fact{}, Fact{}
214		workflowTerminal, agentDone, journalStarted, journalResult, notResumed, inactive := Fact{}, Fact{}, Fact{}, Fact{}, Fact{}, Fact{}
215		if claim != nil {
216			candidate.Provider, candidate.SessionID, candidate.RunID, candidate.AgentID = claim.Provider, claim.SessionID, claim.RunID, claim.AgentID
217			candidate.ProviderBranch, candidate.ProviderHead = claim.ObservedBranch, claim.ObservedHead
218			candidate.ProviderCommonDir, candidate.ProviderGeneration = claim.ObservedCommonDir, claim.ObservedGeneration
219			candidate.WorkflowState, candidate.AgentState = claim.WorkflowState, claim.AgentState
220			candidate.LastActivity, candidate.LastActivityKnown = claim.LastActivity, claim.LastActivityKnown
221			providerOwned, providerUnique, providerMapping = claim.Owned, claim.Unique, claim.Mapping
222			workflowTerminal, agentDone = claim.WorkflowTerminal, claim.AgentDone
223			journalStarted, journalResult, notResumed = claim.JournalStarted, claim.JournalResult, claim.NotResumed
224			if claim.LastActivityKnown {
225				threshold := now.Add(-time.Duration(request.StaleDays) * 24 * time.Hour)
226				inactive = KnownFact(!claim.LastActivity.After(threshold))
227			}
228		} else if sourceComplete {
229			providerOwned = KnownFact(false)
230		}
231	
232		gitFacts, err := s.backend.gitFacts(ctx, repository, target)
233		if err != nil {
234			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("git", "checkout-inspection-failed", "checkout Git facts could not be verified"))
235			gitFacts = mergeStructuralGitFacts(gitFacts, target, worktreesKnown)
236		}
237		if claim != nil && claim.GitIdentity.Known {
238			if !claim.GitIdentity.Value {
239				providerIdentity = KnownFact(false)
240			} else if claim.ObservedBranch == "" || claim.ObservedHead == "" || claim.ObservedCommonDir == "" ||
241				claim.ObservedGeneration == "" || target.Branch == "" || target.RegistryHead == "" ||
242				gitFacts.LiveHead == "" || gitFacts.CommonDir == "" || gitFacts.RegistrationGeneration == "" {
243				providerIdentity = Fact{}
244			} else {
245				providerIdentity = KnownFact(
246					claim.ObservedBranch == target.Branch &&
247						claim.ObservedHead == target.RegistryHead && claim.ObservedHead == gitFacts.LiveHead &&
248						claim.ObservedCommonDir == repository.Identity.CommonDir && claim.ObservedCommonDir == gitFacts.CommonDir &&
249						claim.ObservedGeneration == gitFacts.RegistrationGeneration,
250				)
251			}
252		}
253		candidate.Git = gitFacts
254	
255		tasks, err := s.backend.taskEvidence(ctx, repository, target)
256		if err != nil {
257			states.tasks = false
258			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("task", "task-inventory-failed", "task claims could not be verified"))
259		}
260		artifacts, err := s.backend.artifactEvidence(ctx, target)
261		if err != nil {
262			states.artifacts = false
263			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("artifact", "artifact-inventory-failed", "artifact intents could not be verified"))
264		}
265		caller, err := s.backend.callerEvidence(target)
266		if err != nil {
267			states.caller = false
268			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("caller", "caller-containment-failed", "caller containment could not be verified"))
269		}
270		runtimeFacts, err := s.backend.runtimeEvidence(ctx, target)
271		if err != nil {
272			states.runtime = false
273			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, diagnostic("runtime", "runtime-inventory-failed", "runtime coverage could not be verified"))
274		}
275		candidate.Safety = SafetyFacts{
276			TaskUnclaimed: tasks.Unclaimed, TaskClaims: tasks.Claims, TaskFingerprint: tasks.Fingerprint,
277			ArtifactsKnown: artifacts.Known, ArtifactsSafe: artifacts.Safe, ArtifactIntents: artifacts.Intents, ArtifactFingerprint: artifacts.Fingerprint,
278			CallerOutside: caller.Outside, CallerFingerprint: caller.Fingerprint,
279			RuntimeKnown: runtimeFacts.Known, RuntimeClear: runtimeFacts.Clear,
280			CoveringSessions: runtimeFacts.Covering, RuntimeFingerprint: runtimeFacts.Fingerprint,
281		}
282	
283		audit := Audit(AuditInput{
284			ProviderOwned: providerOwned, ProviderUnique: providerUnique, ProviderMapping: providerMapping,
285			ProviderIdentity: providerIdentity, WorkflowState: candidate.WorkflowState, WorkflowTerminal: workflowTerminal,
286			AgentState: candidate.AgentState, AgentDone: agentDone,
287			JournalStarted: journalStarted, JournalResult: journalResult, NotResumed: notResumed, ProviderInactive: inactive,
288			Registered: gitFacts.Registered, PathPresent: gitFacts.PathPresent, LinkedWorktree: gitFacts.LinkedWorktree,
289			NonMain: gitFacts.NonMain, BranchNamed: gitFacts.BranchNamed, BranchMatches: gitFacts.BranchMatches,
290			CommonDirMatches: gitFacts.CommonDirMatches,
291			HeadMatches:      gitFacts.HeadMatches, Unlocked: gitFacts.Unlocked, NotPrunable: gitFacts.NotPrunable,
292			Clean: gitFacts.Clean, IgnoredEmpty: gitFacts.IgnoredEmpty, SubmodulesClean: gitFacts.SubmodulesClean,
293			NoGitOperation: gitFacts.NoGitOperation, TaskUnclaimed: tasks.Unclaimed,
294			ArtifactsKnown: artifacts.Known, ArtifactsSafe: artifacts.Safe, CallerOutside: caller.Outside,
295			RuntimeKnown: runtimeFacts.Known, RuntimeClear: runtimeFacts.Clear,
296		})
297		candidate.Classification, candidate.Checks = audit.Classification, audit.Checks
298		candidate.BranchDeletion = s.auditBranchDeletion(ctx, repository, target, request)
299		candidate.PlannedActions = plannedActions(candidate)
300		candidate.Fingerprint = candidateFingerprint(candidate)
301		return candidate, diagnostics, states
302	}
303	
304	func structuralGitFacts(target Target, worktreesKnown bool) GitFacts {
305		facts := GitFacts{NonMain: KnownFact(!target.Main)}
306		if worktreesKnown && target.RegistrationKnown {
307			facts.Registered = KnownFact(target.Registered)
308			facts.LinkedWorktree = KnownFact(target.Registered && !target.Main && !target.Bare)
309			facts.BranchNamed = KnownFact(target.Branch != "" && !target.Detached)
310			facts.Unlocked = KnownFact(!target.Locked)
311			facts.NotPrunable = KnownFact(!target.Prunable)
312		}
313		return facts
314	}
315	
316	func mergeStructuralGitFacts(facts GitFacts, target Target, worktreesKnown bool) GitFacts {
317		fallback := structuralGitFacts(target, worktreesKnown)
318		for current, replacement := range map[*Fact]Fact{
319			&facts.Registered: fallback.Registered, &facts.LinkedWorktree: fallback.LinkedWorktree,
320			&facts.NonMain: fallback.NonMain, &facts.BranchNamed: fallback.BranchNamed,
321			&facts.Unlocked: fallback.Unlocked, &facts.NotPrunable: fallback.NotPrunable,
322		} {
323			if !current.Known {
324				*current = replacement
325			}
326		}
327		return facts
328	}

330	func (s *Service) auditBranchDeletion(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, target Target, request ReportRequest) BranchDeletion {
331		result := BranchDeletion{Requested: request.DeleteBranches, BaseExplicit: request.BaseExplicit, BaseRef: request.BaseRef, Checks: []Check{}}
332		if !request.DeleteBranches {

337		if !request.BaseExplicit || request.BaseRef == "" || target.Branch == "" || target.Branch == request.BaseRef {

347				Check{ID: "base-and-tip-resolve", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "base or branch tip could not be resolved"},
348				Check{ID: "branch-contained", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "branch containment is unknown"},
349				Check{ID: "zero-unique-commits", Classification: Unknown, Detail: "unique commit count is unknown"})
350			return result
351		}
352		result.BaseHead, result.BranchTip = state.BaseHead, state.BranchTip
353		result.RelationKnown, result.BaseOnly, result.BranchOnly = true, state.BaseOnly, state.BranchOnly
354		result.Checks = append(result.Checks,
355			Check{ID: "base-and-tip-resolve", Classification: Eligible, Detail: "base and branch tips resolve"},
356			branchCheck("branch-contained", state.BranchOnly == 0, "branch is contained in the explicit base", "branch is not contained in the explicit base"),
357			branchCheck("zero-unique-commits", state.BranchOnly == 0, "branch has zero commits unique from base", "branch has commits unique from base"))
358		result.Safe = checksEligible(result.Checks)
359		return result
360	}

362	func branchCheck(id string, value bool, yes, no string) Check {
363		if value {
364			return Check{ID: id, Classification: Eligible, Detail: yes}
365		}
366		return Check{ID: id, Classification: Blocked, Detail: no}
367	}

369	func checksEligible(checks []Check) bool {
370		if len(checks) == 0 {
371			return false
372		}
373		for _, check := range checks {
374			if check.Classification != Eligible {
375				return false
376			}
377		}
378		return true

381	func plannedActions(candidate Candidate) []PlannedAction {
382		removeStatus := "blocked"
383		removeDetail := "candidate is not eligible; report only"
384		if candidate.Classification == Eligible {
385			removeStatus, removeDetail = "planned", "remove with plain non-force git worktree remove after locked revalidation"
386		}
387		actions := []PlannedAction{{Kind: "remove-worktree", Target: candidate.Path, Status: removeStatus, Detail: removeDetail}}
388		if candidate.BranchDeletion.Requested && candidate.BranchDeletion.Safe {
389			actions = append(actions, PlannedAction{Kind: "delete-branch", Target: candidate.Branch, Status: "planned", Detail: "delete with git branch -d after separate post-removal revalidation"})
390		} else {
391			detail := "branch is retained by default"
392			if candidate.BranchDeletion.Requested {
393				detail = "branch deletion proof is incomplete or unsafe; retain the branch"
394			}
395			actions = append(actions, PlannedAction{Kind: "retain-branch", Target: candidate.Branch, Status: "planned", Detail: detail})
396		}
397		return actions
398	}

400	func candidateFingerprint(candidate Candidate) string {
401		candidate.Fingerprint = ""
402		data, err := json.Marshal(candidate)
403		if err != nil {
404			return ""
405		}
406		sum := sha256.Sum256(data)
407		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
408	}

410	func (s *Service) Apply(ctx context.Context, request ApplyRequest) (ApplyResult, error) {
411		if request.Report.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
412			return ApplyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported ephemeral report schema %d", request.Report.SchemaVersion)
413		}
414		if len(request.Fingerprints) == 0 {
415			return ApplyResult{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Repository: request.Report.Repository, Results: []ApplyCandidateResult{}}, nil
416		}
417		repository, err := s.backend.discover(ctx, request.Report.Repository.Root)
418		if err != nil {
419			return ApplyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("rediscover canonical repository: %w", err)
420		}
421		if repository.Linked || repository.Identity.Bare || repository.Identity.Root != request.Report.Repository.Root ||
422			repository.Identity.CommonDir != request.Report.Repository.CommonDir {
423			return ApplyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("repository identity changed since the report")
424		}
425		selected := make(map[string]bool, len(request.Fingerprints))
426		for _, fingerprint := range request.Fingerprints {
427			selected[fingerprint] = true
428		}
429		result := ApplyResult{SchemaVersion: SchemaVersion, Repository: repository.Identity, Results: []ApplyCandidateResult{}}
430		err = s.backend.withCleanupLock(ctx, repository.Identity.CommonDir, func() error {
431			if s.beforeRevalidate != nil {
432				s.beforeRevalidate()
433			}
434			for _, prior := range request.Report.Candidates {
435				if !selected[prior.Fingerprint] {
436					continue
437				}
438				fresh, err := s.Report(ctx, ReportRequest{
439					RepoPath: request.Report.Repository.Root, StaleDays: request.Report.StaleDays,
440					BaseRef: request.Report.BaseRef, BaseExplicit: request.Report.BaseExplicit,
441					DeleteBranches: request.Report.DeleteBranches,
442				})
443				if err != nil {
444					return fmt.Errorf("recollect cleanup report: %w", err)
445				}
446				current, exists := findCandidate(fresh.Candidates, candidateKey(prior))
447				item := ApplyCandidateResult{Path: prior.Path, Branch: prior.Branch, BranchRetained: prior.Branch != ""}
448				if prior.Classification != Eligible || !exists || current.Classification != Eligible || current.Fingerprint != prior.Fingerprint {
449					item.Status = ApplySkippedChanged
450					item.Detail = "candidate evidence changed after the report; nothing was removed"
451					result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
452					continue
453				}
454				if err := s.backend.removeWorktree(ctx, repository, prior.Path); err != nil {
455					item.Status = ApplyFailed
456					item.Detail = "plain non-force worktree removal was refused"
457					result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
458					continue
459				}
460				item.RemovedWorktree = true
461				if err := s.backend.verifyRemoved(ctx, repository, prior.Path); err != nil {
462					item.Status = ApplyFailed
463					item.Detail = "worktree removal could not be verified; branch was retained"
464					result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
465					continue
466				}
467				if prior.BranchDeletion.Requested {
468					if !prior.BranchDeletion.Safe || !current.BranchDeletion.Safe {
469						item.Status = ApplyPartial
470						item.Detail = "worktree removed; branch retained because deletion proof was unsafe"
471						result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
472						continue
473					}
474					state, stateErr := s.backend.branchState(ctx, repository, prior.BranchDeletion.BaseRef, prior.Branch)
475					if stateErr != nil || state.BaseHead != prior.BranchDeletion.BaseHead || state.BranchTip != prior.BranchDeletion.BranchTip || state.BranchOnly != 0 {
476						item.Status = ApplyPartial
477						item.Detail = "worktree removed; branch or base proof changed, so the branch was retained"
478						result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
479						continue
480					}
481					if err := s.backend.deleteBranch(ctx, repository, prior.Branch); err != nil {
482						item.Status = ApplyPartial
483						item.Detail = "worktree removed; safe branch -d did not complete, so the branch was retained"
484						result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
485						continue
486					}
487					item.DeletedBranch, item.BranchRetained = true, false
488				}
489				item.Status = ApplyRemoved
490				item.Detail = "worktree removed after locked revalidation"
491				result.Results = append(result.Results, item)
492			}
493			return nil
494		})
495		if err != nil {
496			return result, err
497		}
498		return result, nil
499	}

501	func findCandidate(candidates []Candidate, key string) (Candidate, bool) {
502		for _, candidate := range candidates {
503			if candidateKey(candidate) == key {
504				return candidate, true
505			}
506		}
507		return Candidate{}, false
508	}

511		return strings.Join([]string{candidate.Provider, candidate.SessionID, candidate.RunID, candidate.AgentID, candidate.Path}, "\x00")
512	}

534	func stableCapabilities(values []Capability) []Capability {
535		byName := make(map[string]Capability)
536		for _, value := range values {
537			if value.Name == "" {
538				continue
539			}
540			current, exists := byName[value.Name]
541			if !exists {
542				byName[value.Name] = value
543				continue
544			}
545			current.Available = current.Available && value.Available
546			if !current.Available {
547				current.Detail = "unavailable"
548			}
549			byName[value.Name] = current
550		}
551		out := make([]Capability, 0, len(byName))
552		for _, value := range byName {
553			out = append(out, value)
554		}
555		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Name < out[j].Name })
556		return out
557	}
558	
559	func stableDiagnostics(values []Diagnostic) []Diagnostic {
560		seen := make(map[string]bool)
561		out := make([]Diagnostic, 0, len(values))
562		for _, value := range values {
563			key := value.Source + "\x00" + value.Code + "\x00" + value.Message
564			if seen[key] {
565				continue
566			}
567			seen[key] = true
568			out = append(out, value)
569		}
570		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
571			if out[i].Source != out[j].Source {
572				return out[i].Source < out[j].Source
573			}
574			if out[i].Code != out[j].Code {
575				return out[i].Code < out[j].Code
576			}
577			return out[i].Message < out[j].Message
578		})
579		return out
580	}

40	func (b *systemBackend) discover(ctx context.Context, path string) (repositoryState, error) {

43			return repositoryState{}, err
44		}
45		root, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.Root)
46		if err != nil {

49		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
50		if err != nil {
51			return repositoryState{}, err
52		}
53		return repositoryState{
54			Identity: RepositoryIdentity{Root: root, CommonDir: commonDir, Name: repository.Name, Bare: repository.Bare},
55			Linked:   repository.IsLinkedWorktree,
56		}, nil
57	}

74				Prunable: worktree.Prunable, PrunableReason: worktree.PrunableReason,

81	func (b *systemBackend) gitFacts(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, target Target) (GitFacts, error) {
82		facts := structuralGitFacts(target, target.RegistrationKnown)
83		facts.NonMain = KnownFact(!target.Main)
84		if target.RegistrationKnown {
85			facts.Registered = KnownFact(target.Registered)
86			facts.LinkedWorktree = KnownFact(target.Registered && !target.Main && !target.Bare)
87			facts.BranchNamed = KnownFact(target.Branch != "" && !target.Detached)
88			facts.Unlocked = KnownFact(!target.Locked)
89			facts.NotPrunable = KnownFact(!target.Prunable)
90		}
91	
92		info, err := os.Lstat(target.Path)
93		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
94			facts.PathPresent = KnownFact(false)
95			return facts, nil
96		}
97		if err != nil {
98			return facts, err
99		}
100		facts.PathPresent = KnownFact(info.IsDir() && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink == 0)
101		if !facts.PathPresent.Value {
102			return facts, fmt.Errorf("checkout path is not a regular directory")
103		}
104		checkoutRepo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, target.Path)
105		if err != nil {
106			return facts, err
107		}
108		checkoutCommon, err := pathx.Canonical(checkoutRepo.GitCommonDir)
109		if err != nil {
110			return facts, err
111		}
112		facts.CommonDir = checkoutCommon
113		// Git exposes a reusable administrative pathname, not a non-replayable
114		// registration generation. Leave RegistrationGeneration empty unless a future
115		// live registry supplies an opaque generation that a provider also recorded.
116		facts.CommonDirMatches = KnownFact(checkoutCommon == repository.Identity.CommonDir)
117		liveHead, err := gitx.Run(ctx, target.Path, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
118		if err != nil {
119			return facts, err
120		}
121		facts.LiveHead = liveHead
122		facts.HeadMatches = KnownFact(target.RegistryHead != "" && liveHead == target.RegistryHead)
123		inspection, err := gitx.InspectEphemeralCheckout(ctx, target.Path)
124		if err != nil {
125			return facts, err
126		}
127		facts.Staged, facts.Unstaged = inspection.Status.Staged, inspection.Status.Unstaged
128		facts.Conflicted, facts.Untracked = inspection.Status.Conflicted, inspection.Status.Untracked
129		facts.Ignored, facts.DirtySubmodules = inspection.Ignored, inspection.DirtySubmodules
130		facts.BranchMatches = KnownFact(inspection.Status.Branch == target.Branch && !inspection.Status.Detached)
131		facts.Clean = KnownFact(!inspection.Status.Dirty())
132		facts.IgnoredEmpty = KnownFact(inspection.Ignored == 0)
133		facts.SubmodulesClean = KnownFact(inspection.DirtySubmodules == 0)
134		facts.StateFingerprint = inspection.Fingerprint
135		operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(target.Path)
136		if err != nil {
137			return facts, err
138		}
139		facts.NoGitOperation = KnownFact(!active)
140		if active {
141			facts.Operation = operation
142		}
143		return facts, nil
144	}

175	func strictTaskList(store *task.Store) ([]*task.Task, error) {
176		entries, err := os.ReadDir(store.Dir)
177		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
178			return nil, nil
179		}
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, err
182		}
183		var tasks []*task.Task
184		for _, entry := range entries {
185			name := entry.Name()
186			if strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".toml") {
187				continue
188			}
189			info, err := entry.Info()
190			if err != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
191				return nil, fmt.Errorf("task inventory contains an unsafe task entry")
192			}
193			id := strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".toml")
194			current, err := store.Get(id)
195			if err != nil {
196				return nil, err
197			}
198			if err := current.Validate(); err != nil {
199				return nil, err
200			}
201			tasks = append(tasks, current)
202		}
203		return tasks, nil
204	}

292	func sessionPaths(session runtime.Session) []string {
293		set := make(map[string]bool)
294		for _, path := range session.Dirs {
295			if path != "" {
296				set[path] = true
297			}
298		}
299		for _, pane := range session.Panes {
300			for _, path := range []string{pane.CWD, pane.ShellCWD} {
301				if path != "" {
302					set[path] = true
303				}
304			}
305		}
306		paths := make([]string, 0, len(set))
307		for path := range set {
308			paths = append(paths, path)
309		}
310		return paths
311	}

313	func (b *systemBackend) branchState(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, base, branch string) (branchState, error) {
314		baseHead, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Identity.Root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--end-of-options", base+"^{commit}")
315		if err != nil {
316			return branchState{}, err
317		}
318		branchTip, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Identity.Root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--end-of-options", "refs/heads/"+branch+"^{commit}")
319		if err != nil {
320			return branchState{}, err
321		}
322		relation, err := gitx.CompareBranches(ctx, repository.Identity.Root, baseHead, branchTip)
323		if err != nil {
324			return branchState{}, err
325		}
326		return branchState{BaseHead: baseHead, BranchTip: branchTip, BaseOnly: relation.BaseOnly, BranchOnly: relation.BranchOnly}, nil
327	}

337	func (b *systemBackend) verifyRemoved(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, path string) error {
338		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil {
339			return fmt.Errorf("checkout path still exists")
340		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
341			return err
342		}
343		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, repository.Identity.Root)
344		if err != nil {
345			return err
346		}
347		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
348			candidate, err := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
349			if err != nil {
350				return err
351			}
352			if candidate == path {
353				return fmt.Errorf("worktree registration still exists")
354			}
355		}
356		return nil
357	}
358	
359	func (b *systemBackend) deleteBranch(ctx context.Context, repository repositoryState, branch string) error {
360		_, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Identity.Root, "branch", "-d", "--", branch)
361		return err
362	}

364	func digest(value any) string {
365		encoded, err := json.Marshal(value)
366		if err != nil {
367			return ""
368		}
369		sum := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
370		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
371	}

120	func (a *Adapter) Collect(ctx context.Context, query ephemeral.SourceQuery) ephemeral.SourceResult {
121		result := ephemeral.SourceResult{Provider: providerName, Complete: true}
122		capability := ephemeral.Capability{Name: "claude-workflow-metadata", Available: true, Detail: "bounded local metadata"}
123		result.Capabilities = []ephemeral.Capability{capability}
124		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
125			return a.failed(result, "canceled")
126		}
127		if err := a.validateLimits(); err != nil {
128			return a.failed(result, "metadata-bound")
129		}
130		rootInfo, err := os.Lstat(a.root)
131		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
132			result.Capabilities[0].Detail = "metadata root absent"
133			return result
134		}
135		if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(a.root, rootInfo, true) {
136			return a.failed(result, "unsafe-metadata")
137		}
138	
139		var used counts
140		projects, err := a.directories(a.root, &used.projects, a.limits.MaxProjects)
141		if err != nil {
142			return a.failed(result, failureCode(err))
143		}
144		for _, project := range projects {
145			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
146				return a.failed(result, "canceled")
147			}
148			projectPath, err := fixedChild(a.root, project)
149			if err != nil {
150				return a.failed(result, "invalid-id")
151			}
152			sessions, err := a.directories(projectPath, &used.sessions, a.limits.MaxSessions)
153			if err != nil {
154				return a.failed(result, failureCode(err))
155			}
156			for _, session := range sessions {
157				claims, scanErr := a.collectSession(ctx, query, projectPath, session, &used)
158				if scanErr != nil {
159					return a.failed(result, failureCode(scanErr))
160				}
161				result.Claims = append(result.Claims, claims...)
162			}
163		}
164	
165		a.rejectDuplicateClaims(&result)
166		sort.Slice(result.Claims, func(i, j int) bool {
167			left, right := result.Claims[i], result.Claims[j]
168			if left.WorktreePath != right.WorktreePath {
169				return left.WorktreePath < right.WorktreePath
170			}
171			if left.RunID != right.RunID {
172				return left.RunID < right.RunID
173			}
174			return left.AgentID < right.AgentID
175		})
176		return result
177	}

358	func (a *Adapter) readWorkflow(path, filenameID string) (workflowRecord, error) {
359		data, info, err := a.readStable(path, a.limits.MaxJSONBytes)
360		if err != nil {
361			return workflowRecord{}, err
362		}
363		object, err := decodeObject(data)
364		if err != nil {
365			return workflowRecord{}, failure("invalid-workflow")
366		}
367		runID, okRun := requiredString(object, "runId")
368		if !okRun || runID != filenameID {
369			return workflowRecord{}, failure("workflow-id-mismatch")
370		}
371		if _, present := object["id"]; present {
372			id, okID := requiredString(object, "id")
373			if !okID || id != filenameID {
374				return workflowRecord{}, failure("workflow-id-mismatch")
375			}
376		}
377		status, okStatus := requiredString(object, "status")
378		if !okStatus {
379			return workflowRecord{}, failure("invalid-workflow-status")
380		}
381		if err := validateID(runID, "wf_"); err != nil {
382			return workflowRecord{}, failure("invalid-id")
383		}
384		activity, timeKnown := timestampFields(object, []string{"timestamp", "updatedAt"}, []string{"startTime"})
385		progressByID, progressActivity, progressTimeKnown, err := decodeProgress(object["workflowProgress"])
386		if err != nil {
387			return workflowRecord{}, err
388		}
389		activity = append(activity, progressActivity...)
390		return workflowRecord{
391			id: runID, status: strings.ToLower(status), activity: activity,
392			timeKnown: timeKnown && progressTimeKnown, mtime: info.ModTime(), progressByID: progressByID,
393		}, nil
394	}
395	
396	func decodeProgress(raw json.RawMessage) (map[string]progressRecord, []time.Time, bool, error) {
397		if len(raw) == 0 {
398			return map[string]progressRecord{}, nil, true, nil
399		}
400		var entries []json.RawMessage
401		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &entries); err != nil {
402			return nil, nil, false, failure("invalid-workflow-progress")
403		}
404		byID := make(map[string]progressRecord, len(entries))
405		var allActivity []time.Time
406		allKnown := true
407		for _, entry := range entries {
408			object, err := decodeObject(entry)
409			if err != nil {
410				allKnown = false
411				continue
412			}
413			agentID, okAgent := requiredString(object, "agentId")
414			if !okAgent || validateID(agentID, "") != nil {
415				allKnown = false
416				continue
417			}
418			isolation, okIsolation := requiredString(object, "isolation")
419			state, okState := requiredString(object, "state")
420			valid := okIsolation && okState
421			if _, duplicate := byID[agentID]; duplicate {
422				return nil, nil, false, failure("duplicate-agent-progress")
423			}
424			queued, queuedKnown := optionalEpochMillis(object, "queuedAt")
425			started, startedKnown := optionalEpochMillis(object, "startedAt")
426			last, lastKnown := optionalEpochMillis(object, "lastProgressAt")
427			known := queuedKnown && startedKnown && lastKnown
428			if !queued.IsZero() && !started.IsZero() && started.Before(queued) {
429				known = false
430			}
431			if !started.IsZero() && !last.IsZero() && last.Before(started) {
432				known = false
433			}
434			activity := nonZeroTimes(queued, started, last)
435			byID[agentID] = progressRecord{
436				agentID: agentID, isolation: strings.ToLower(isolation), state: strings.ToLower(state), valid: valid,
437				activity: activity, timeKnown: known,
438			}
439			allActivity = append(allActivity, activity...)
440			allKnown = allKnown && known
441		}
442		return byID, allActivity, allKnown, nil
443	}
444	
445	func timestampFields(object map[string]json.RawMessage, stringKeys, millisKeys []string) ([]time.Time, bool) {
446		known := true
447		var values []time.Time
448		for _, key := range stringKeys {
449			value, ok := optionalTimestamp(object, key)
450			known = known && ok
451			if !value.IsZero() {
452				values = append(values, value)
453			}
454		}
455		for _, key := range millisKeys {
456			value, ok := optionalEpochMillis(object, key)
457			known = known && ok
458			if !value.IsZero() {
459				values = append(values, value)
460			}
461		}
462		return values, known
463	}
464	
465	func optionalEpochMillis(object map[string]json.RawMessage, key string) (time.Time, bool) {
466		raw, present := object[key]
467		if !present {
468			return time.Time{}, true
469		}
470		var number json.Number
471		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &number); err != nil {
472			return time.Time{}, false
473		}
474		millis, err := strconv.ParseInt(number.String(), 10, 64)
475		if err != nil || millis <= 0 {
476			return time.Time{}, false
477		}
478		return time.UnixMilli(millis).UTC(), true
479	}
480	
481	func nonZeroTimes(values ...time.Time) []time.Time {
482		out := make([]time.Time, 0, len(values))
483		for _, value := range values {
484			if !value.IsZero() {
485				out = append(out, value)
486			}
487		}
488		return out
489	}

504		if !pathPresent && !snakePathPresent && !shortPathPresent && !spawnedPresent {
505			return metaRecord{}, false, nil

507		workflowID := pathWorkflowID

510			workflowID, ok = requiredString(object, "workflowId")
511			if !ok || workflowID != pathWorkflowID {

516		if _, present := object["runId"]; present {

551	func (a *Adapter) readJournal(mappingPath, pathWorkflowID string) ([]journalEvent, time.Time, bool, error) {
552		path := filepath.Join(mappingPath, "journal.jsonl")
553		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
554		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
555			return nil, time.Time{}, true, nil
556		}
557		if err != nil {
558			return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("unsafe-metadata")
559		}
560		data, stableInfo, err := a.readStableWithInfo(path, info, a.limits.MaxJournalBytes)
561		if err != nil {
562			return nil, time.Time{}, false, err
563		}
564		lines := bytes.Split(data, []byte{'\n'})
565		if len(lines) > 0 && len(lines[len(lines)-1]) == 0 {
566			lines = lines[:len(lines)-1]
567		}
568		if len(lines) > a.limits.MaxJournalRecords {
569			return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("metadata-bound")
570		}
571		events := make([]journalEvent, 0, len(lines))
572		for _, line := range lines {
573			if len(bytes.TrimSpace(line)) == 0 {
574				continue
575			}
576			object, err := decodeObject(line)
577			if err != nil {
578				return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal")
579			}
580			kind, ok := oneString(object, "type", "event")
581			if !ok {
582				return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal-kind")
583			}
584			kind = strings.ToLower(kind)
585			if kind != "started" && kind != "result" {
586				continue
587			}
588			workflowID := pathWorkflowID
589			if _, present := object["workflowId"]; present {
590				var okWorkflow bool
591				workflowID, okWorkflow = requiredString(object, "workflowId")
592				if !okWorkflow || workflowID != pathWorkflowID {
593					return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal-workflow")
594				}
595			}
596			runID := pathWorkflowID
597			if _, present := object["runId"]; present {
598				var okRun bool
599				runID, okRun = requiredString(object, "runId")
600				if !okRun || runID != pathWorkflowID {
601					return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal-run")
602				}
603			}
604			agentID, okAgent := requiredString(object, "agentId")
605			if !okAgent {
606				return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-journal-agent")
607			}
608			at, timeKnown := optionalTimestamp(object, "timestamp")
609			if validateID(workflowID, "wf_") != nil || validateID(runID, "wf_") != nil || validateID(agentID, "") != nil {
610				return nil, time.Time{}, false, failure("invalid-id")
611			}
612			events = append(events, journalEvent{kind: kind, workflowID: workflowID, runID: runID, agentID: agentID, at: at, timeKnown: timeKnown})
613		}
614		return events, stableInfo.ModTime(), true, nil
615	}

617	func journalFacts(events []journalEvent, workflowID, runID, agentID string) (started, result bool, startedAt, resultAt time.Time, timesKnown bool) {
618		timesKnown = true
619		startedCount, resultCount := 0, 0
620		for _, event := range events {
621			if event.workflowID != workflowID || event.runID != runID || event.agentID != agentID {
622				continue
623			}
624			switch event.kind {
625			case "started":
626				startedCount++
627				startedAt = event.at
628			case "result":
629				resultCount++
630				resultAt = event.at
631			}
632			timesKnown = timesKnown && event.timeKnown
633		}
634		started, result = startedCount == 1, resultCount == 1
635		if startedCount > 1 || resultCount > 1 || (started && result && resultAt.Before(startedAt)) {
636			timesKnown = false
637		}
638		return
639	}

658		for _, value := range values {

660				continue
661			}
662			value = value.UTC()

664				known = false

672		}
673		return last, known

676	func (a *Adapter) readStable(path string, limit int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
677		info, err := os.Lstat(path)

684	func (a *Adapter) readStableWithInfo(path string, before fs.FileInfo, limit int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
685		if !safeMetadataInfo(path, before, false) {
686			return nil, nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
687		}
688		first, opened, err := readBounded(path, limit)
689		if err != nil {
690			return nil, nil, err
691		}
692		if a.afterRead != nil {
693			a.afterRead(path)
694		}
695		after, err := os.Lstat(path)
696		if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(path, after, false) || !os.SameFile(before, after) ||
697			before.Size() != after.Size() || !before.ModTime().Equal(after.ModTime()) ||
698			!os.SameFile(before, opened) {
699			return nil, nil, failure("metadata-mutated")
700		}
701		second, reopened, err := readBounded(path, limit)
702		if err != nil {
703			return nil, nil, err
704		}
705		if !os.SameFile(before, reopened) || !bytes.Equal(first, second) {
706			return nil, nil, failure("metadata-mutated")
707		}
708		return first, after, nil
709	}
710	
711	func readBounded(path string, limit int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
712		file, err := os.Open(path)
713		if err != nil {
714			return nil, nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
715		}
716		defer file.Close()
717		info, err := file.Stat()
718		if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() > limit {
719			if err == nil && info.Size() > limit {
720				return nil, nil, failure("metadata-bound")
721			}
722			return nil, nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
723		}
724		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, limit+1))
725		if err != nil {
726			return nil, nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
727		}
728		if int64(len(data)) > limit {
729			return nil, nil, failure("metadata-bound")
730		}
731		return data, info, nil
732	}

734	func (a *Adapter) directories(path string, total *int, maximum int) ([]string, error) {
735		entries, err := os.ReadDir(path)
736		if err != nil {
737			return nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
738		}
739		var names []string
740		for _, entry := range entries {
741			if !entry.IsDir() {
742				if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
743					return nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
744				}
745				continue
746			}
747			name := entry.Name()
748			if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(name); err != nil {
749				return nil, failure("invalid-id")
750			}
751			child, err := fixedChild(path, name)
752			if err != nil {
753				return nil, failure("invalid-id")
754			}
755			info, err := os.Lstat(child)
756			if err != nil || !safeMetadataInfo(child, info, true) {
757				return nil, failure("unsafe-metadata")
758			}
759			*total++
760			if *total > maximum {
761				return nil, failure("metadata-bound")
762			}
763			names = append(names, name)
764		}
765		sort.Strings(names)
766		return names, nil
767	}

805	func validateID(id, prefix string) error {
806		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(id); err != nil {
807			return err
808		}
809		if prefix != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(id, prefix) {
810			return fmt.Errorf("id lacks prefix")
811		}
812		for _, r := range id {
813			if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9') || strings.ContainsRune("._-", r) {
814				continue

817		}
